text: - ACC-MDL-001: Define legal entity, partner, program, internal fund, account, currency, period, restriction, counterparty, asset/security, custody account, transaction source, event ID and posting-policy version independently. Every posted line has valid required dimensions.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-002: Authoritative journals are strictly append-only. A correction is a new reversal/reclassification/adjustment with explicit linkage, reason, evidence, authorization and bitemporal dates; no update/delete of posted entries.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-003: Every journal balances in its defined book, currency and accounting basis. Multicurrency postings must balance in transaction and functional currencies under an approved FX methodology; never pretend two unlike currencies can be summed.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-004: Distinguish cash/assets held, fund net asset balances, available-to-recommend amounts, grant commitments, legally restricted net assets, and operational reserves. Available-to-recommend is a controlled projection, **not a general-ledger account**.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-005: Enforce fund/account authorization and restrictions at posting and query boundaries, and tenant isolation across schemas, databases, agents, caches and exports.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-006: Every business event maps to zero or more authorized journals under a versioned posting policy. Some events (recommendations, invitations, plan approvals) are **nonposting**; posting requires a separate recognized accounting trigger.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-007: Posting is idempotent per event, accounting book and posting-rule version, with explicit treatment of restatements; event replay must not create duplicate journals or external effects.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-008: Separate financial statement classification from fund advisory designation and reporting dimensions. Accounting-policy review must determine donor restriction classification; DAF subfund designation does not automatically imply donor-restricted net assets.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - ACC-MDL-009: Control accounts reconcile to detailed subsidiary ledgers and independent bank/custody/payment evidence; unbalanced or unexplained breaks block unsupported close certifications.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)

text: | AUTH-I1 | An authority change takes effect at command execution. Sessions, widget instances, cached projections, partner tokens and delegated agent privileges derived from the old authority are invalidated, or re-checked on next use. The maximum staleness window is a stated requirement, not an emergent property ([TVF-015](../16-registers/findings.csv)). |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I2 | Delegated grants (advisor, agent, partner user) derive from a parent authority. When the parent ends, the children end at the same effective time. |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I3 | When the triggering fact is effective in the past (date of death reported two weeks later), actions taken in between under the dead principal's authority are **flagged for review**, not reversed automatically. Approved grants are governed by GR-8 [C]. |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I4 | Two successors with joint authority: the policy must define quorum. Without it, recommendations require all. |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I5 | **Death or incapacity notice from an unauthenticated channel** is a flag, not a fact (red team B7). The immediate effect is limited to holding *new* recommendations and template instances from the named person. The person is notified through their verified channel. Approved grants continue (GR-8). A false notice therefore delays at most the person's own new requests, and the false notice is itself recorded. |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I6 | **Third-party authority registers** (custodian trading authorizations, bank-portal approvers, provider user lists) are in scope for AUTH-I1, with a revocation SLA and evidence (TVF-123). |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I7 | **Authority-relevant credential changes** need step-up and a cooling-off period, plus notice to the prior channel. Examples: enrolling a new authenticator or passkey, changing email or phone, changing a recovery factor. Grants to recipients added during that cooling-off period need sponsor-direct confirmation (red team B1; round 2 S-7). |

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: | AUTH-I8 | Partner identity mapping uses a permanent identifier (issuer plus subject, or the SCIM external ID), never an email or reusable login ID. A mapping change needs dual control and notice to the donor (TVF-138). |

text: ### REQ-X-001: Authority and agent delegation **Source questions:** OD-01, OD-14, OD-17, OD-21, TVC-003, TVC-026, TVC-041, TVF-047, TVF-153, TVF-251. **Normative proposed requirement:** Every agent/staff/advisor command has verified principal, scope, policy version and authorization at execution. No person, agent or automated process may approve an item it originated, submitted, prepared or materially changed; separate logins do not establish independence. Donor confirmation authenticates recommendation intent, not sponsor approval. Independently governed sponsor-delegated deterministic policy may authorize routine grants only when board and counsel validate delegation, publication segregation and independent control. Material changes invalidate prior approval. Advisor-originated agent delegation remains disabled until validated. **Acceptance scenario (not executed):** Given a revoked donor delegation, when an agent submits a new recipient grant, then the command is rejected, no reservation or payment is created, and evidence identifies the revocation. **Open dependencies:** Board/counsel authorization of deterministic approvals, independence control design and adversarial testing.

text: ### REQ-X-004: Payment unknown and non-receipt proof **Source questions:** OD-20, TVC-024, TVC-035, TVC-039, TVR-PAY-001-Q, TVR-PAY-002-Q, TVR-PAY-007-Q, TVF-003, TVF-024, TVF-231, TVF-249. **Normative proposed requirement:** Unknown payment state blocks duplicate submission until contractually sufficient independently controlled evidence proves non-receipt; durable payment identity survives restore. **Acceptance scenario (not executed):** Given provider timeout and subsequent restore, when an operator retries without qualifying proof, then no second instruction is sent and original identity remains intact. **Open dependencies:** Formal owner validation, evidence, test implementation and source migration.

text: ### REQ-X-005: Payee and external destination integrity **Source questions:** OD-22, TVF-222, TVF-223, TVF-233, TVF-234, TVF-236, TVF-250, TVR-PAY-005-Q. **Normative proposed requirement:** Every automated payment requires independently verifiable proof both that the destination is authorized and controlled by the intended charity and that the actual execution destination matches the sponsor-controlled authorization, including cryptographically or independently bound tokenized rails. Provider self-attestation alone is insufficient. Changes require independent authorization without self-approval. Missing or conflicting proof blocks automatic execution; noncompliant providers/rails are ineligible for fully automated payment. Reconcile authorization, execution and settlement evidence. **Acceptance scenario (not executed):** Given a provider-substituted account, when provider returns a self-issued matching fingerprint but sponsor-controlled evidence differs, then release is blocked. **Open dependencies:** Rail/provider-specific independently verifiable destination proof and contract testing.

text: ### REQ-X-006: Outage, restoration and emergency safeguards **Source questions:** OD-22, TVF-139, TVF-227, TVF-228, TVF-230, TVF-254, TVR-DR-001-Q, TVR-PAY-004-Q. **Normative proposed requirement:** Critical financial and security commits must be durably quorum-replicated before success acknowledgment (RPO zero for acknowledged authoritative commits). Use globally collision-resistant business IDs, stable intent/idempotency keys, a fenced single writer, quorum-based leadership and replica catch-up before failback; suspend authoritative financial writes without safe quorum. An independently durable non-authoritative intake plane may acknowledge queued requests, never approvals, reservations or payments; otherwise submissions fail closed. Replay only after reconciliation, deduplication and current-state revalidation, prioritizing protective holds and cancellations. A separately durable protective-only emergency plane may freeze releases, impose holds, revoke access and capture incident evidence but may not approve, change payees/balances or move funds. Independent authorization is required to remove holds after recovery. External payment outcomes remain Unknown until independently reconciled; no automatic duplicate execution. **Acceptance scenario (not executed):** Given backup predating a hold and cancellation, when restored, then payment release remains disabled until later security events and protective requests are reconciled. **Open dependencies:** DR quorum topology, RTO target, independent queue durability, emergency-plane threat model, fault injection and provider reconciliation.

text: ### REQ-X-007: Charity verification and sanctions **Source questions:** OD-02, TVC-006, TVC-007, TVC-040, TVA-009, TVA-028, TVR-SAN-001-Q, TVR-SAN-002-Q, TVF-027, TVF-048. **Normative proposed requirement:** Unbound maintains one authoritative, standardized charity-vetting framework and reusable evidence/status across sponsors. A vetted charity does not undergo duplicate routine vetting solely because another sponsor uses it. Record scope, evidence provenance, effective date and expiry; reverify at least every 180 days, on material changes, and check current sanctions/eligibility at execution. Adverse findings propagate to all affected sponsors. Sponsor-specific grant restrictions and approvals remain distinct from common charity vetting; no self-approved vetting exceptions. Cross-sponsor legal reliance, liability, jurisdictions and recipient classes require counsel validation; model never clears holds. **Acceptance scenario (not executed):** Given a recipient verified 30 days ago and sanctioned today, when payment releases, then the current adverse signal holds the grant despite valid periodic review. **Open dependencies:** Formal owner validation, evidence, test implementation and source migration.

text: ### REQ-X-013: Third-party dependency and assumptions **Source questions:** TVA-002, TVA-003, TVA-004, TVA-005, TVA-006, TVA-014, TVA-018, TVA-020, TVA-021, TVA-022, TVA-024, EXT-01, EXT-02, EXT-03, EXT-04, EXT-05, EXT-09, TVF-237, TVF-238. **Normative proposed requirement:** Do not treat provider capabilities, economic projections, cross-sponsor legal reliance or deprovisioning latency as facts until supported by primary evidence and enforceable terms. text: ## REQ-X-017: Rules-first, AI-second, independent-human-third decision routing (2026-11-23) **User-selected principle:** Tier 1 version-pinned deterministic policy evaluates every eligible case first, resolving safely routine approvals/rejections/holds without AI or human intervention. Tier 2 invokes AI only for ambiguous, unstructured or conflicting evidence and only within explicitly delegated authority; default AI output is an evidence-backed recommendation or request for more information, never unilateral approval of consequential grants, payments, sanctions exceptions or hold removal. Tier 3 routes remaining cases to independently authorized human reviewers who cannot approve their own or materially modified work. Hard prohibitions and unsafe states remain held regardless of tier. All tiers preserve rule traces, provenance, authority, status semantics, bounded costs, audit evidence and case-specific escalation reasons. Sponsor-delegated automated approvals require independent board-approved policy governance and legal validation. **Acceptance (not executed):** A complete low-risk grant passes deterministic rules and incurs zero AI calls and zero human touches; ambiguous recipient documentation invokes a bounded evidence-only AI investigation; a sanctions match remains blocked even when AI confidently recommends release; a human who originated the case cannot approve it; repeated AI failure routes to a safe hold or independently authorized human, never a fail-open decision. **Sources:** User directive 2026-11-23, OD-01, OD-02, OD-14, OD-17, OD-21, TVC-003, TVC-006, TVC-007, TVC-041, TVF-153. text: ## REQ-X-084: Sponsor-approved double-entry journal contracts, recognition gates and numerical fixtures (2026-11-23) **Proposed:** Require balanced, sponsor/fund-scoped, immutable, versioned double-entry journal batches, with explicit source evidence, posting/effective/known-at times, corrections and accounting policy. Separate legal gift acceptance, revenue recognition, grant reservation, unconditional grant payable recognition, bank settlement, investment valuation, fund liquidity, fee accrual and late-period returns. Capacity is a derived controlled projection, not a directly editable ledger balance. **Acceptance (illustrative, not accounting-certified):** `ILLUSTRATIVE-FUND-ACCOUNTING-JOURNAL-CONTRACTS-AND-REVERSALS-2026-11-23.md` and `ILLUSTRATIVE-LEDGER-JOURNAL-FIXTURES-2026-11-23.csv` document ten balanced synthetic journal examples. A qualified nonprofit fund accountant/CPA must approve actual chart of accounts, recognition timing, reversal treatment and regulatory reporting. No accounting engine or runtime tests executed.

text: **UNB-DATA-001 (MANDATORY):** The authoritative business database SHALL be append-only. No UPDATE or DELETE of committed authoritative business events, decisions, facts, journal entries, policy versions, approvals or evidence. Corrections SHALL append a new correction, reversal, supersession, or compensating record, referencing the original and explaining why. This is a non-negotiable design constraint unless the owner explicitly changes it.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-002:** Every authoritative record SHALL have a durable identity, actor/authority, event/recorded time, applicable effective time, provenance, schema version, correlation/causation, and integrity metadata. Where meaningful, record source hash and policy version.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-003:** Bitemporal queries SHALL distinguish what was effective in the world from what the enterprise knew at a particular time; backdated corrections must not rewrite knowledge history.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-004:** Current state SHALL be computed as a deterministic projection of immutable authoritative records. Projection caches, materialized views, search indexes and read replicas MAY be rebuilt or replaced, but are explicitly non-authoritative. Their updates do not constitute modification of the append-only record.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-005:** Corrections SHALL preserve the original, correction reason, authorized corrector, linked evidence and effect on derived balances, grants, filings and notices. Financial corrections SHALL use balanced reversal/adjustment entries, never silent journal mutation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-006:** Published policies and approval records SHALL be immutable; changing a policy appends a newly approved version and explicit effective period.

text: **UNB-DATA-007:** Legal retention, privacy rights, data minimization and erasure requests SHALL be addressed through reviewed architecture (e.g., segregated encrypted identity vault and documented cryptographic erasure where lawful) without falsely promising that immutable sensitive payloads can be deleted. Avoid putting unnecessary PII into the immutable event payload. Legal counsel must resolve jurisdictional retention/deletion conflicts before production.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: **UNB-DATA-008:** The system SHALL prevent ordinary application roles, administrators and agent tools from rewriting history; investigate physical immutability, database permissions, tamper-evident digests, backups and independently verifiable checkpoints. Append-only at the application API alone is insufficient.

text: **UNB-DATA-009:** Replay SHALL be deterministic and side-effect-free. External effects (payments, emails, orders, acknowledgments) SHALL use durable issuance receipts and idempotency controls so replay cannot repeat them.

text: **UNB-DATA-010:** Data migration and schema evolution SHALL preserve old events and apply versioned upcasters or equivalent interpretation; no destructive rewrite of historical authoritative payloads.

text: - **UNB-IMM-001:** An authorized append transaction creates an immutable authoritative event and durable sequence position. All existing authoritative event bytes remain unchanged; reject UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE and destructive schema migration through normal operational roles.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: - **UNB-IMM-002:** A correction must specify target event/record, reason, actor, effective time, recorded time, evidence and correction kind. Reject an orphan correction and preserve the original in all audit queries.

text: - **UNB-IMM-004:** Historical queries support (a) actual effective date and (b) what was known by recorded date. A backdated correction does not retroactively alter an earlier as-known view.

text: - **UNB-IMM-008:** A privacy or retention request is handled through an approved policy preserving legally required evidence while honoring applicable rights. Do not claim cryptographic erasure works if plaintext exists in backups, logs or exports.

release_scope: R1
text: Posting MUST be idempotent per (source event ID, accounting book): at most one original journal may exist for each pair, whatever the posting-rule version. A posting-rule version change MUST NOT re-post events already posted; its effect on posted history MUST be handled only by an AccountingChangeRecord (UNB-XIN-ACC-004) producing new adjusting journals. Event replay, outage recovery and projection rebuild MUST locate the existing journal by (source event ID, book) and MUST NOT create journals or external effects.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: DAF establishment intake MUST collect only the facts required by (a) each participant role's classified checks under RR-UNB-PART-007-r1, (b) the fund's program terms and (c) the first funding method. Every field for which Unbound already holds a fact about the same PartyId with freshness Fresh for that purpose (UNB-XIN-CLM-003), or which a configured verified identity provider supplies, MUST be prefilled and shown for confirmation rather than re-entered. Intake MUST support save-and-resume and funding in the same session. The program agreement, including the statement that the sponsor has exclusive legal control over contributed assets, MUST be accepted once by click-accept recording agreement version, timestamp, authenticated principal and channel; wet signatures MUST NOT be required. View-only participants MUST NOT be required to complete identity proofing (RCD-023). Facts the donor declines to confirm MUST be re-entered and re-verified under the normal checks.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The fund lifecycle MUST record Drafted, Accepted, Created and InvestmentActive as distinct states. Acceptance MUST be evaluated by a versioned deterministic sponsor rule: standard fund type in the account-type register (UNB-RCN-ENT-011); all participant checks required by RR-UNB-PART-007-r1 passed; sanctions clear; current agreement version accepted; no policy-defined risk signal. Where the sponsor board has recorded a delegation of fund acceptance, a passing rule outcome MUST be the acceptance (A3); otherwise it MUST be AcceptRecommended and accepted by an A4 sponsor officer in batch. Non-standard fund types, failed or Unknown checks and risk signals MUST create a WorkItem under RR-REQ-X-048-r2 and MUST NOT be auto-accepted. A Created fund MUST have zero grantable capacity until accepted contributions are final (RR-TVR-CON-001-r1).

release_scope: R1
text: A household MUST be a display grouping only: membership MUST NOT grant access to any fund, MUST NOT change authority, contributor of record or acknowledgments, and MUST NOT aggregate balances for fee tiers unless a sponsor-approved schedule rule and each affected fund's holders' consent exist.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST classify instructions as conflicting when their scopes overlap and cannot both execute, and MUST resolve them by the precedence rules: explicit author-confirmed supersession for the same author; the fund's declared joint-authority mode (default AllRequired) for different holders; invalidity after verified death/incapacity; latest sponsor-approved plan version. Unresolvable conflicts MUST hold the consequential effect and open a sponsor case.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Sponsor policy configuration MUST be obtained by the Outcome Questionnaire (UNB-SMP-CFG-001) and Policy Packs (UNB-SMP-CFG-002). Sponsor-specific values MUST be limited to items with disposition retain-configurable or controlled-override in the Configuration Register (UNB-SMP-CFG-003): eligibility restrictions stricter than law, fees, limits and delegated authority, brand, terminology, affirmations (counsel-approved), statement cadence and operating-model differences. Every value MUST be versioned and effective-dated, MUST record whether it is pack-default, derived or sponsor-set, and MUST NOT loosen a pack item whose override direction forbids it.

release_scope: R1
text: Fee administration MUST execute as an idempotent run per (fund, schedule, period, segment set) through the states Accrued, Assessed, Posted, and optionally Waived or Reversed; waivers MUST be approved schedule exceptions with expiry; corrections MUST be compensating entries; replaying a run MUST NOT post additional entries.

release_scope: R1
text: Every case profile and decision type MUST declare its clocks (Response, Resolution, Decision) with explicit start, stop and pause events, a sponsor business calendar and a target. A clock MAY pause only while an InformationRequest to the requesting party is open or the party has requested a delay. Each sponsor-facing decision type MUST have a Decision clock target, and the system MUST report on-time rate and p50/p90 elapsed decision time per type and quarter; publication to donors is a sponsor option.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST compute, per sponsor and month: contacts per 1,000 accounts by reason and channel; repeat-contact rate (same principal and reason within 7 calendar days); deflection as informational intents resolved without a human contact on the same reason within 7 days; time-to-resolution distribution and handoffs per closed case by case kind; human touches per outcome. Optional effort surveys MUST be reported with response rate. Individual handle time MUST NOT be used for ranking without complexity adjustment.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: In addition to RR-ADM-042-r1, Unbound MUST compute per sponsor, journey and month: (1) customer effort per completed journey = sum of active seconds on required interaction steps, from instrumented step timings (median, p90); (2) abandonment by step = journeys entering step s and not completing within 7 days / journeys entering s; (3) repeat-interaction rate = completed journeys in which the same fact was requested more than once from the same principal; (4) resolution time = first customer contact or submission to outcome communicated; (5) unnecessary data entry rate = facts asked of the customer that were held or retrievable at the time (per RR-AIN-007-r1 source log) / facts asked. Each metric MUST be defined in the metric registry (RR-REQ-X-043-r1) with numerator, denominator, eligible population and privacy rule; individual-level data MUST NOT be used to rank staff.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before a configuration or policy change is approved, Unbound MUST (a) detect conflicts between the proposed value and: platform hard controls; binding law encoded in packs; the item's pack baseline and override direction; and other active sponsor settings via declared conflict rules in the Configuration Register; (b) resolve each conflict by the precedence in REQ-X-018 (stricter applicable law and platform safety prevail; sponsor may only tighten) and show the outcome; (c) simulate the change against all open items it affects (open grants, schedules, holds, payment instructions, fee accruals, pending statements) and against the last 90 days of decisions replayed under the proposed version, reporting changed outcomes; (d) block approval when any unresolved conflict or simulated outcome breaches a platform-safety parameter (UNB-RCN-WF-021). The approver MUST be a principal other than the author.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Decisions classified A4 (reserved human authority) MUST be approved by an authorized human who did not originate, prepare or materially modify the item. Decisions classified A3 MAY be executed by board-delegated deterministic policy only when OD-01 is approved for that decision type; otherwise they require an authorized human. An AI agent MUST NOT approve any A3, A4 or A5 decision; it MAY prepare proposals (A1) and perform A2 actions listed in the authority matrix.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before any customer-facing surface, agent or staff workflow asks a donor, advisor, charity, sponsor or partner for a fact, it MUST query (a) facts already held for that principal and subject within consent and tenant scope, (b) facts retrievable from registered sources the caller is authorized to use (charity registry, verified destinations, identity provider results, custody and firm feeds), and (c) inference or default rules registered in the Interaction Register (UNB-SMP-CXP-001). It MUST present held or retrieved values as prefilled for review rather than as blank input, MUST ask only for facts that remain missing or whose freshness policy has expired, and MUST record which source satisfied each fact. Cross-sponsor facts about a charity MAY be reused as input only (RCD-006) and MUST NOT be re-requested from the charity when a current common observation exists.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Models, prompts, tools and policies used by agents MUST be versioned. Every change MUST pass the frozen evaluation set and adversarial (prompt-injection and authority-escalation) suite in CI before deployment. Human approval MUST be required only when the change expands an agent's tools, data scope or authority ceiling, or when any suite result regresses beyond its stated tolerance; other changes deploy on passing suites with the results recorded.

release_scope: R1
text: Bound token, tool, time and external-service budgets per agent run and per purpose. Each run SHALL meter cost per invocation and attach it to its cost object (UNB-XIN-ECO-009). On budget exhaustion the run SHALL stop model calls, persist partial state, return Incomplete-BudgetExhausted (never a passing result) and route the item to a human queue; deterministic controls continue. Runs estimated above a configured threshold SHALL log a CostQuote before execution (UNB-XIN-ECO-008), which never skips a required control.

release_scope: R1
text: Service QA MUST sample closed Contacts monthly by stratified random selection over channel and answer source with a recorded seed, score them against a versioned rubric (factual, policy, disclosure, tax-advice boundary), have humans adjudicate every AI/human score disagreement, and measure inter-rater agreement quarterly on a double-scored subset.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST derive expected observations per control from transactions, schedules, triggers and tenant scope. For a period with no triggering activity the system MUST record ZeroActivity with evidence that the producing collector was healthy for the whole period; it MUST NOT require a human zero-activity attestation. ZeroActivity with an unhealthy or silent collector MUST be recorded InsufficientEvidence.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each active control MUST have an owner role and a backup role, each resolving to at least one named person at all times. Controls classified Key (money movement, authority and delegation, financial close and reconciliation, access management) and all Manual controls MUST also have an independent reviewer role whose holders are disjoint from the owner role's holders for that control, enforced by the authorization engine. A control with no resolvable owner or required reviewer MUST raise a deficiency.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Grant approval and fund reservation MUST commit in one authoritative transaction against net grantable capacity, serialised on every constrained ancestor (fund, pool, legal entity, custodial account). The reservation unit MUST match the funding source: currency for settled cash, and units with a configured valuation haircut for pooled or positional sources. A grant that needs liquidation MUST be Approved and Reserved and then enter FundingPlanned/LiquidationPending (UNB-RCN-FIN-008 names, RCD-049), which creates no external commitment and no payment instruction, until redemption settles. If proceeds fall short, the sponsor-configured shortfall rule MUST apply and MUST NOT draw on capacity reserved for other grants.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: When a payment's dispatch or provider outcome is Unknown, the system MUST block any new dispatch, reissue or settlement posting for that payment chain. The Unknown MUST be resolved only through the rail's published UnknownResolutionProtocol, and declaring NotReceived MUST require the protocol's evidence combination plus approval by a principal independent of the dispatcher. The payment identity, idempotency key and attempt history MUST survive restore and failover. Unknown items MUST escalate through configured aging tiers.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Automated release MUST require destination evidence that meets the rail's minimum combination in the Treasury-published DestinationEvidence table, and the pinned destination version MUST match the version bound at authorization. Any destination change, including a corrected ACH Notification of Change, MUST create a new destination version through an independently authorized verification. The change requester and the verifier MUST be different principals. Rails or providers that cannot meet the minimum MUST be ineligible for automated release.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For every grant, the system MUST evaluate recipient eligibility at two points, approval and payment release, against (a) a current IRS-status observation (TEOS/Pub 78 or EO BMF, plus the Auto-Revocation List) whose retrieval timestamp is no older than the sponsor-configured status-freshness window, and (b) current sanctions screening. It MUST store a per-sponsor, per-grant immutable snapshot of that observation containing the fields required by Rev. Proc. 2018-32 §8.01. A shared cross-sponsor charity evidence record MAY be reused as an input, but each sponsor's reliance snapshot MUST be written to that sponsor's partition. A comprehensive charity review (deep vetting) MUST occur at the sponsor-configured deep-review interval (default 180 days, a sponsor policy and not a legal safe harbor) and on any material-change signal. An expired deep review MUST hold new approvals but MUST NOT be the sole basis for payment-time eligibility.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: In addition to RR-REQ-X-007-r1: (1) A scheduled deep review that finds all required evidence current and passing under the active policy version SHALL renew the common verification automatically, recording the policy version as the approving authority, with no human sign-off where the sponsor's delegated policy permits (OD-01). (2) Renewal SHALL start no later than the FreshnessPolicy refresh lead time, with load-spreading, so that an expired deep review holds new approvals only when renewal has failed. (3) Event-triggered revalidation (RR-UNB-EXT-028-r1) SHALL reset the deep-review clock only when it performs a full review. (4) A verification reused by a second sponsor SHALL NOT trigger new routine vetting; that sponsor's policy overlay and per-grant reliance snapshot SHALL still be evaluated. (5) A stratified sample of automatically renewed verifications SHALL be independently reviewed after the fact (UNB-XIN-CLM-005) without blocking grants. (6) The platform SHALL report renewal success rate, evidence reuse ratio (grants per verification), time-to-detect material adverse events, false-hold and false-clear rates.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A comprehensive charity revalidation whose evidence satisfies the published FreshnessPolicy (UNB-RCN-GRT-014) and the sponsor's versioned eligibility rules with no contradictory, stale-critical or adverse signal MUST renew assurance with no human action. A grant whose recipient has current assurance, a passing per-sponsor reliance snapshot at approval and at release (RR-REQ-X-007-r1), no hold, and which falls within a board-delegated routine policy (OD-01) MUST proceed without human vetting review. Human review MUST be created only with a reason code from {MissingEvidence, ContradictoryEvidence, AdverseSignal, IdentityAmbiguity, NonStandardClass (ED/ER/SO/fiscal sponsor/non-filer), PolicyAmbiguity, SourceUnavailableBeyondPolicy} after bounded automated evidence gathering, and each item MUST carry its HumanInterventionClass (UNB-SMP-ORG-001). Fully passing renewals and grants MUST be included in the independent stratified sample (UNB-XIN-CLM-005) without blocking. When a completed grant is later found to have gone to an ineligible recipient or for a prohibited purpose, the platform MUST open an ExciseTaxIncident (UNB-XIN-NPG-008), invalidate the affected assurance for all sponsors relying on the shared factual claim, hold unfulfilled grants to that recipient, and record recovery actions; it MUST NOT reverse fund accounting except through the governed correction path.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: On verified death of a party, the disposition of that party's pending items MUST follow the sponsor's versioned death_pending_grant_policy. The policy sets one value for sponsor-approved unpaid grants (complete | hold_for_review | cancel_by_sponsor_decision), one for unapproved recommendations (lapse | hold), and one for recurring templates (suspend). Each recurring instance MUST re-check current authority and eligibility at release. Rights of other participants that do not derive from the deceased MUST NOT be suspended. Default (RCD-022, RCD-039): sponsor-approved unpaid grants complete unless the sponsor policy value is hold_for_review or cancel_by_sponsor_decision. (Integration amendment 2026-11-23; replaces the interim hold_for_review default.)

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: When a contribution that contributed to capacity is returned or reversed, Unbound MUST record a ReturnedContributionExposure fact linked to the original receipt, reduce capacity immediately, preserve all downstream disbursements, and post entries selected by the CPA-approved returned-contribution policy; it MUST NOT presume a donor receivable unless counsel has confirmed an enforceable claim for that rail and case.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each global hold (charity, sanctions, recipient) MUST be committed in the hold registry with a strictly increasing HoldPublicationVersion. A payment release in any cell MUST, inside the release transaction, obtain the registry's current HoldPublicationVersion and verify that the recipient has no active hold at that version; it MUST record that version on the release. If the registry is unreachable or the cell's replicated watermark is behind the registry version, the release MUST remain in ReleaseBlocked and MUST NOT be dispatched. Dispatch MUST re-check holds immediately before irreversible external submission.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For the initial release, sponsors SHOULD customise communications through a constrained template model: each communication event has a platform-defined block layout; sponsors MAY edit permitted text slots, select approved Brand Kit theme variants, insert typed tokens from the event's allowlist and add locale variants; mandatory clauses are locked. Templates MUST have draft/review/publish, synthetic preview (desktop, mobile, plain text), accessibility checks and version pinning for as-sent reconstruction. A free-form visual designer or raw HTML mode MUST NOT be provided until a documented sponsor demand decision approves it.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST generate a statement for every eligible fund for each sponsor-configured statement period (default monthly) as a pure query over the certified close snapshot (REQ-X-040), and MUST publish it to the Document Center (REQ-X-035) without human review unless the close recorded an exception affecting that fund. Notification of availability MUST follow the recipient's communication preference; the sponsor default MUST be selectable and, unless the sponsor decides otherwise, MUST be a quarterly digest plus an immediate notice for any statement that contains a correction to a previously issued statement. Physical mail MUST be sent only when the recipient requests it or has no electronic-delivery consent; accessible formats and mail MUST be available on request as an accommodation without charge. Statements MUST NOT be presented as or substitute for contribution acknowledgments. Statement data MUST NOT derive from unverified portal caches or AI; NAV and available-to-grant remain distinct; as-issued history and governed corrections are retained.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every stored record MUST be assigned exactly one retention class at creation. Each class MUST declare its authority (statute, regulation, contract, sponsor policy), trigger event, and minimum period. The effective retention of a record MUST be the maximum over all applicable classes, the platform floor (7 years from trigger, sponsor policy) and any legal hold. At minimum the catalog MUST include: OFAC/sanctions records (10 years from the transaction or screening decision, 31 CFR 501.601); tax-reliance snapshots (≥ the platform floor and until the related return period is closed, per counsel Q5); cost-basis and carryover records (until 7 years after the final disposition the record substantiates); and personal data not required as a financial record (deletable on request after its financial-record role ends). Expiry MUST create a disposition review task; deletion MUST NOT occur automatically.

release_scope: R1
text: Disposition MUST operate on DispositionBatches defined by (tenant, record class, retention trigger period) rather than per-record review. When records in a batch reach EligibleForReview, the retention engine MUST compute the batch, excluding records under hold, with Unknown facts, or with unexpired dependencies; one authorized records owner (not the requester) MUST approve the batch; execution MUST re-check holds and safety epochs per record in the same authoritative transaction and skip (not fail) any record newly held. Per-record human review MUST be required only for records flagged by a deterministic exception rule. Expired records not yet approved MUST remain preserved; deletion MUST never be automatic.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: One versioned Metric Registry MUST be the single source of metric definitions for every dashboard tile, work-queue view, export (CSV/JSON/API), Folio-printed report and statement summary figure. Each registered metric MUST declare: id and version; audience; definition; numerator, denominator and eligible population; authoritative source component; snapshot type (live estimate, or sealed FinancialSnapshot per UNB-XIN-EVA-003); freshness rule; decision supported and decision owner; expected action; thresholds with basis label; counter-metric where one applies; limitations; misleading interpretations; incentive risks; privacy and small-group suppression rule for cross-sponsor views. A metric without a decision supported MUST NOT be registered. Every rendered or exported figure MUST carry metric id, version, snapshot id or watermark, and as-of time, so that a dashboard, an export and a printed report of the same scope and snapshot show identical values. Economics metrics (UNB-XIN-ECO-007) and work-queue metrics (REQ-X-049) MUST be entries in this registry, not separate registries.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A WorkItem MUST be created only when a deterministic process cannot complete because of (a) a rule-defined hold, (b) missing or conflicting evidence, (c) a decision requiring human authority, or (d) a provider Unknown requiring reconciliation. Each WorkItem MUST reference the blocked outcome, the rule or event that created it and the exit condition. Assignment MUST use the sponsor's routing policy (round robin, sticky owner, skill, capacity, hybrid) and MUST NOT confer decision authority. WorkItems MUST auto-close when their exit condition is met by system events.

release_scope: R1
text: A WorkItem MUST be created only when (a) a rule-defined hold, (b) missing or conflicting evidence, (c) a decision requiring human authority, (d) a provider Unknown requiring reconciliation, or (e) a request, complaint, dispute or reconsideration from an identified external party that requires a human response and was promoted from a Contact under UNB-XIN-SVC-001 prevents an outcome from completing. Each WorkItem MUST reference the blocked or requested outcome, the creating rule or Contact, and its exit condition. Assignment MUST follow the sponsor routing policy and MUST NOT confer decision authority. Items of causes (a)-(d) MUST auto-close when system events meet the exit condition where the case profile permits; items of cause (e) MUST NOT close until the outcome has been communicated to the requesting party and recorded.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each (sponsor, case kind, task type) MUST have one versioned AssignmentPolicy with: primary mode ∈ {RoundRobin, SkillBased, StickyRelationship, CradleToGrave, CapacityWeighted, Escalation}; an ordered fallback chain ending in Escalation to a named authority level; and a reassignment rule set. Assignment MUST first compute the eligible set (valid DoA for the action class, required skill, sponsor scope, active and not absent, no recorded conflict, and SoD-eligible against the subject's history: not originator, preparer, modifier, or decider of a prior step that requires independence); the mode only chooses within that set. If the eligible set is empty the item MUST move to the next fallback within the policy's maximum unassigned time (default 1 business hour) and, at Escalation, notify the next authority level; it MUST NOT be held silently, assigned to an ineligible person, or approved. Reassignment MUST occur on: assignee absence beyond the policy threshold, departure or DoA expiry, newly recorded conflict, SLA risk, or specialist completion (return to case owner); reassignment MUST preserve the CradleToGrave case owner unless the owner is the cause. Workload for CapacityWeighted and fairness reporting MUST use effort-weighted units from time equations (UNB-XIN-ECO-006), not item counts. Manual override requires reason, cannot select an SoD-ineligible person, and is reported per supervisor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every public API operation, configuration property and workflow action MUST publish an AssistanceContract conforming to the Unbound AssistanceContract JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) version-pinned with the API contract. Required core fields: contractId (stable URN), version (semver), ownerComponent, kind (enum: apiOperation|configProperty|workflowAction|uiField|templateToken), purpose (text, max 280 chars), inputSchemaRef, outputSchemaRef, sideEffects (enum list: none|createsDraft|changesConfig|changesAuthoritativeState|externalEffect), authorityClass (A0..A5 per GOV authority tiers), confirmationRequired (bool), reversibility (enum: reversible|compensatable|irreversible), unknownStates (list), errors (list of error codes), visibility (enum: public|tenantScoped|roleScoped|restricted). Editorial annotations (examples, troubleshooting, policy source) are optional. A surface is 'assistant-ready' only when its contract validates and matches the deployed API schema hash. (Integration amendment, mission section 10.) The following fields are also REQUIRED, not optional: validationRules (machine-readable constraints, generated from the input schema plus policy references), businessConstraints (policy IDs and versions that can block the operation), permittedActorTypes (deterministic policy, AI agent, human role; from the authority matrix UNB-RCN-PLT-005), safeActions and prohibitedActions for AI callers, humanApprovalBoundary (text plus authorityClass), outcomeExplanation (template mapping each result and error code to a plain-language explanation with the evidence fields to cite), and at least one example (request, response and one error).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: RR-REQ-X-051-r1 applies, with these changes. (1) The kind enum MUST also include policyRule, policyPack, configItem, metricDefinition, dashboardWidget, reportDefinition and emailBlock, which restores the scope of REQ-X-051. (2) Every configItem, policyRule and policyPack contract MUST carry: legalBasis (statute | regulation | guidance | contract | sponsorPolicy | convention, with citation); reviewedBy (role, date); packId and version; defaultValue with defaultRationale; overrideDirection (tightenOnly | lengthenOnly | sponsorChoice | none); dependsOn and affects (contract IDs); conflictRules; consequenceModel (the simulation entry point and the object types it affects); changeFrequency; owner; disposition (Configuration Register). (3) Every metricDefinition and dashboardWidget contract MUST carry: decisionSupported, decisionOwner, expectedAction, counterMetric, thresholds with their basis label ([S]/[A]), knownLimitations and misleadingInterpretations. (4) An AI explanation of any configuration value MUST cite the contract version and legalBasis. Where legalBasis is absent, the AI MUST say that the basis is not documented rather than infer one.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST be one codebase implementing one domain model, one ledger and policy engine, one authorization model and one case model, released as one version to every deployment cell. A deployment cell is a running instance of that release with its tenant-bound authoritative stores. Operating models MUST differ only by declarative configuration, role assignments, adapters and view composition. Cross-cell interactions (shared charity facts, global holds, sponsor-level consolidation) MUST use versioned inter-cell contracts with idempotency and reconciliation; no cell may hold a second authoritative copy of another cell's financial state.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For each legal sponsor and tax year, the system MUST produce a reproducible DAF annual reporting data package from the locked ledger. Contents: count of donor-advised funds held at year end; aggregate contributions to, grants from, and year-end value of those funds (each defined in a CPA-approved data dictionary that maps to the current form lines); the DAF_TRANSFER_OUT subset; and evidence supporting the donor written-disclosure questions. Synthetic and canary items MUST be excluded. Which account types count as donor-advised funds MUST come from a counsel-approved account-type classification register. The package MUST carry an as-of and known-at snapshot. Preparation, review, signature, filing and acceptance MUST be distinct states, with no AI signing or filing authority.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Institutional migration MUST run as a MigrationRun through Contracted > Inventoried > Mapped > ImportedToStaging > Reconciled > ParallelValidated > CutoverAuthorized > SingleWriterActive > PostCutoverVerified > Archived. Every imported standing-data record (payee and bank, successor, advisor, contact) MUST carry source system, source record id, import batch, and verification_status=imported_unverified. A payment MUST NOT be released to an imported_unverified destination. Cutover MUST fence the legacy writer before Unbound posts. Every migration MUST declare in advance a rollback boundary and the compensation procedure that applies after the first live posting.

release_scope: R1
text: Grant-outcome and restriction monitoring MUST be sponsor-configurable and OFF by default for grants to §170(b)(1)(A) organizations (other than disqualified supporting organizations), because such distributions are excepted from §4966 taxable distributions whatever their stated purpose (XID-NPG-006). Monitoring MUST be mandatory only for expenditure-responsibility grants (reports per §53.4945-5) and for grants the sponsor itself conditions. §4967 benefit screens apply to every grant regardless of monitoring settings.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST maintain a critical-vendor register recording assurance type, legal entity and report period; MUST require a bridge letter when the period end is more than 3 months old and mark assurance Expired after 12 months; and MUST map every complementary user entity control to an internal control owner before the vendor is marked Assured. AI may extract report metadata for human confirmation only.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The payment aggregate MUST persist six orthogonal dimensions (Authorization, Dispatch, ProviderKnowledge, SettlementEvidence, AccountingReconciliation, RecipientAcknowledgement) plus a WorkCase. ProviderKnowledge and SettlementEvidence MUST include Blocked. The check rail MUST include Outstanding, AgedOutreach, StaleDated, VoidRequested, VoidConfirmed and UnclaimedPropertyReportable. Provider callbacks MUST be authenticated and deduplicated on (provider, providerEventId) and on a semantic key. This model supersedes UNB-GRANT-022, UNB-PAY-001 and UNB-PAY-009 and the TX-13 merged state.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each control in the control register MUST list the requirement IDs it enforces, reviewed by the control owner and an independent reviewer. Each requirement classified as risk-bearing (money, authority, eligibility, tenant isolation, evidence integrity, privacy, AI tool use) MUST link to at least one validated control or record a reviewed gap. Requirements classified presentation-only MUST record 'no control required' with reviewer. Machine-generated candidate links MUST NOT count toward coverage.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each control in the register MUST list the requirement IDs it enforces. Links for requirements classified risk-bearing (money, authority, eligibility, tenant isolation, evidence integrity, privacy, AI tool use) MUST be reviewed by the control owner and an independent reviewer; other links by the control owner; requirements classified presentation-only MAY be classified in bulk by one reviewer and record "no control required". Machine-generated candidate links MUST NOT count toward coverage. Pull requests MUST NOT require manual control mapping: the CI pipeline MUST derive the affected controls from the code paths changed (path-to-control map maintained with the register) and attach them to the change record; a PR that changes a risk-bearing path with no mapped control MUST fail CI until the path is mapped or classified.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each control in the register MUST be classified MachineEvaluated or Manual. A MachineEvaluated control MUST be evaluated continuously by MON-005 over its complete expected population (MON-002), and its owner MUST act on every Fail, InsufficientEvidence or StaleEvidence result within the control's due period; no periodic owner attestation is required for its passing results. A Manual control (e.g. board approvals, related-party review, vendor due diligence, policy approval) MUST be attested by its owner at its stated frequency. An independent reviewer MUST, at least quarterly, review coverage metrics (MON-009), open deficiencies and a reviewer-selected sample of Manual-control attestations, and MUST NOT be the owner of any control in that sample.

release_scope: R1
text: Contribution provisional status MUST be governed by a versioned ReversalWindow table keyed by (rail, SEC code or card network, account type consumer/business, direction push/pull) with fields availability delay, basis (settlement date), source citation and owner. Contributions MUST be recognized as revenue when funds settle to the sponsor; reversibility affects grantable availability, not recognition. Default availability: ACH consumer debit 5 banking days after settlement; ACH business (CCD) debit 3 banking days; card on settlement up to the donor's provisional limit, remainder 60 calendar days after settlement; wires, donor push credits and cleared checks on settlement. The per-donor provisional limit defaults to $0 for donors with less than 90 days of history and $10,000 thereafter (illustrative, sponsor-configurable). A return or chargeback after acceptance MUST reverse contribution revenue against the fund up to the fund's available balance; any shortfall MUST post as sponsor operating loss and MUST NOT create a receivable from the donor. A missing table row MUST fail closed as Provisional.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Any one authorized operator MUST be able to activate a kill switch (per-agent disable, enterprise payments pause) immediately; activation MUST only move toward a safe state (stop new commands) and MUST notify the security owner and the second authorized role at once. Release of a kill switch (resuming money movement or agent operation) MUST require two authorized people, neither of whom may be an agent, with the reason recorded.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every posted journal MUST balance (sum of debits = sum of credits, in exact decimal) separately for each combination of accounting entity, transaction currency and every balancing segment declared in the posting policy; fund and restriction MUST be declared balancing segments for DAF books. A journal failing any check MUST be rejected, not posted.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST maintain the general-ledger accounts and subsidiary ledgers for DAF program activity: fund balances, cash and bank, custody and securities, contributions, grants payable, investments and units, and fees, each tied to its control account. Operating accounts payable, accounts receivable (except partner fee billing when enabled), payroll and fixed assets MUST NOT be native subledgers; they are reached through the balanced summarized journal export of RR-UNB-ACC-012-r1.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST record each contribution as distinct, timestamped facts: Intent, Received (by rail), CompletedGiftDetermined, SponsorAccepted, Valued (separate typed values: sponsor book value, custody receipt value, optional informational acknowledgment value, sale proceeds), Acknowledged, Settled/Final, and Disposed. Acknowledged MUST NOT occur before CompletedGiftDetermined and SponsorAccepted. Grantable capacity MUST NOT increase before Final (RCD-019, RCD-033; provisional credit is not offered in release 1).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST keep one accrual-basis (US GAAP) book per legal entity. Any other basis required by a named filing or contract MUST be produced as a derived report with typed reconciling items to the GAAP book, not as a parallel posted book.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST NOT natively implement sponsor operating accounts payable, purchasing, vendor master, reimbursements or prepaid accounting in the initial scope. It MUST export balanced, summarized, dimension-complete journals for DAF program activity to the sponsor's system of record for operating finance, and reconcile the receiving control accounts. A native AP module MAY be added only by a recorded owner decision with a demonstrated outcome need.

release_scope: R1
text: Support budgeting, forecasts, actual-versus-budget reporting, cost centers and scenario models while distinguishing forecasts from posted actuals. Management cost allocation and activity-based attribution SHALL be computed as a non-posting projection (UNB-XIN-ECO-001) that never creates journals or changes fund balances or available-to-grant; only CPA-approved functional expense allocations (UNB-ACC-019) and approved fee/billing entries (UNB-ACC-010) may post. Every management allocation SHALL reconcile monthly to GL actuals with an explicit unallocated residual (UNB-XIN-ECO-004). Functional expense allocation and management attribution share one activity dataset with separately governed mappings (XID-ECO-005).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Management cost allocation and activity-based attribution MUST be computed as a non-posting projection (UNB-XIN-ECO-001) that never creates journals or changes fund balances or available-to-grant; only CPA-approved functional expense allocations and approved fee/billing entries may post. Budgets and forecasts MUST NOT be authored natively; they MAY be imported from the sponsor FP&A system as labelled non-posting comparison data.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each legal entity MUST have accounting periods with soft and hard close, period locks (UNB-XIN-EVA-002) and late-event routing (XID-EVA-002) without modifying posted journals. Close certification MUST be granted when continuous invariants (UNB-ACC-030) pass, reconciliation breaks above materiality are resolved (RR-UNB-ACC-018-r1) and the period sample is attested (RCD-037); the system MUST generate the certification evidence package. Manual close checklists MUST NOT be required.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Reconciliation differences MUST be classified against three versioned thresholds per reconciliation class and scope: RoundingTolerance (auto-clear with evidence), Materiality (blocks close certification, NAV publication and new reservations for the affected scope only), and an AgingLimit for unexplained immaterial differences (escalate on expiry regardless of amount). Loosening any threshold MUST require a second approver.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Segregation of duties MUST be enforced for: posting-rule version approval, manual journals, bank and payee master changes, reconciliation sign-off, close certification and payment release; the approver of each MUST differ from its preparer. Journals generated by an approved posting-rule version from authoritative events MUST NOT require per-journal human approval. AI cannot approve its own accounting actions or any action listed above.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The ledger component MUST provide immutable posting, correction links, bitemporal (effective and recorded) queries, tenant isolation, replay-safe projections and integrity checkpoints on the approved PostgreSQL persistence. Strata MAY be used only for declarative schema management of these stores, and its deployment MUST refuse destructive changes (drop, truncate, type narrowing, removal of append-only triggers or privilege revocations) to ledger tables. No requirement may claim these guarantees come from Strata.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST preserve gift-lot identity (contribution ID, quantity, receipt date, sponsor carrying amount at receipt) for every contributed security until disposition. Donor cost basis and holding period MUST be recorded only for lots classified with UBTIExposure other than None (UNB-XIN-ACC-008) or where counsel requires it. Lot relief on sale MUST be specific identification for lots linked to a Form8283Signed record or a §4943 business-enterprise holding, and MAY be pool-average otherwise. Sponsor GAAP gain/loss MUST be measured from the sponsor carrying amount, never from donor basis; donor acknowledgment value MUST remain a separate field.

release_scope: R1
text: Each program document version and each fund-intake agreement (including legacy imports and sponsor-to-sponsor transfers-in) MUST record a CPA-reviewed VariancePowerEvidence (clause reference, effective date) or its absence. Net asset classification of contributions MUST be derived from it: with variance power and no donor-imposed purpose/time restriction -> without donor restrictions (DAF designation shown as an internal designation); with an explicit donor restriction -> with donor restrictions; without variance power and with a specified beneficiary -> evaluated under UNB-XIN-ACC-001 (agency/pass-through). A contribution whose agreement lacks recorded evidence MUST post to a suspense classification and open an exception before period close. Advisory privileges alone MUST NOT be treated as a donor restriction (XID-INV-002).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every advisory-privilege holder and every professional advisor MUST act only through role grants that are explicit, scoped (fund set, command set, amount limits) and effective-dated. Grants MUST be revocable by the granting party or the sponsor, effective at the next authorization check, at most the policy-defined propagation bound. Advisory privileges MUST NOT confer trading, payment or approval authority (UNB-LEG-002).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For every AI-assisted output the system MUST capture evidence references, stated uncertainty, model and prompt version and policy version. Human sign-off MUST be required according to the authority-matrix class of the decision the output supports (UNB-RCN-PLT-005, RR-AIN-003-r1), and MUST NOT be required solely because AI was involved. Outputs supporting A0-A2 actions (drafts, summaries, flags, case preparation) MUST NOT require sign-off; outputs supporting A3-A5 decisions are signed off as part of that decision's existing approval.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Money movement, access grants, eligibility gates, hold lifting and policy publication MUST be decided only by versioned deterministic rules or authorized humans. AI outputs MUST be typed as Proposal, Finding or Explanation and MUST NOT be accepted as input to these gates except as evidence attached for a human reviewer. No agent may resolve, suppress or close an alert, case or finding that it raised or that concerns its own action.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every API and event contract MUST declare a tier (Internal, Partner, Public) and a semantic version. Breaking changes, detected in CI from generated schemas (UNB-RCN-ARC-001) plus annotated semantic changes, MUST increment the major version. A superseded major version of a Partner or Public contract MUST remain available for at least 12 months after the successor is generally available, with Deprecation and Sunset metadata on every response and notice to every registered consumer at announcement, 90 days and 30 days before sunset. A sunset MUST NOT strand in-flight objects: requests accepted under the old version MUST be completed and their status remain queryable. Rate limits MUST be declared per tier and per tenant and returned in response metadata.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system SHALL provide stewardship cases (on the shared case kernel, UNB-XIN-SVC-002) only for: identity candidates that deterministic EIN-first matching with calibrated thresholds (UNB-KNOW-019) cannot resolve; conflicting registrations that change an eligibility or payee outcome; suspect documents; and recommended grantees that cannot be matched. Attestations and evidence that become stale SHALL be refreshed automatically from source or by an automated request to the charity; a stewardship case SHALL be opened for staleness only if automated refresh fails before the evidence expires.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A grant MUST NOT reach PaymentInstructionAuthorized unless the grant is Funded: settled, unencumbered cash equal to the fixed amount is allocated to it in the paying account. Liquidation-dependent grants MUST pass through FundingPlanned and LiquidationPending, and enter FundingShortfall when a source cannot deliver. A sponsor-approved liquidity advance MAY fund a grant before redemption settles only if recorded as an interfund receivable within an approved limit.

release_scope: R1
text: Records MUST be classified into storage classes. (1) Authoritative financial and authority facts (journal, reservations, grant/payment/contribution decisions, holds, policy versions, authority grants) MUST be append-only; their current state MAY be maintained in current-state tables updated in the same transaction as the fact append and MUST be deterministically rebuildable from the facts. (2) Engagement and relationship data (contact details, preferences, interactions, notes) MAY be stored as mutable rows with system-versioned history and is not required to be rebuildable from events; it is eligible for privacy redaction. (3) Operational coordination state (outbox delivery status, process-manager step and timers, leases, work-queue assignment) MAY be updated in place with audit of material transitions and is not authoritative. Projections, caches and search indexes remain non-authoritative as originally stated.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST maintain a versioned correction impact registry that maps each correctable fact type to the derived records computed from it (e.g., contribution valuation -> acknowledgment amount, Form 8283/8282 obligations, unit purchase, fee basis; NAV -> unit allocations, fee accruals, statements; journal batch -> snapshots, statements, Schedule D aggregates, capacity; payee destination -> pending payment intents). When a correction (reversal, re-post, restatement) commits, the system MUST deterministically enumerate impacted derived records as of the correction's effective date, create a linked task or automatic recomputation per registry rule (automatic only for deterministic recomputations such as fee delta postings; human for legal documents such as acknowledgments), and MUST NOT mark the correction case closed until every impacted item is resolved or explicitly waived with authority. Financial corrections continue to use balanced reversal/adjustment entries. For donor fund statements the registry rule MUST produce an amended statement whenever an acknowledgment or tax-relevant figure changes, and otherwise an explained adjustment on the next statement (XID-EVA-002).

release_scope: R1
text: Model accounts, AUM, average balance, grants (by rail), contributions (by type), exception rate by type, review minutes per exception type, complex-asset volume, service contacts and resolutions, reconciliation breaks, AI runs and charity verifications (new vs reuse) as separate drivers; at runtime each driver SHALL be measured from domain events (ActivityEvent) and stored in a versioned parameter register with provenance (measured / benchmark / assumption), replacing planning estimates only via an Observation source.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: In addition to the drivers in RR-UNB-ECO-001-r1, model as separate drivers: the distribution of accounts across activity/balance segments (not only the average balance), the number of sponsors and accounts per sponsor, sponsor-level cost per sponsor, advisors and accounts per advisor, funding-rail mix including payroll batches, the year-end daily arrival multiplier, and determination reuse share. Sponsor-level and account-level costs SHALL be reported separately and never spread into a single per-account figure without also showing both components.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Separate measured inputs, sourced industry benchmarks, scenarios and assumptions; every sensitivity output must expose parameter provenance. Any economic figure used as a design target, pricing input or comparison SHALL come from an executed, reproducible model run: a versioned parameter register (value, range, label measured/sourced/assumption/derived, source), a recorded seed and command, and outputs that report P10/P50/P90 alongside any modal estimate. Headline figures SHALL state their quantile and cost scope (acquisition, custody and fund-borne costs included or excluded). A figure that cannot be reproduced from a recorded run SHALL NOT be used as a target.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The economic model and each sponsor's staffing plan MUST express the minimum responsible staffing as three separately reported terms: (1) AuthorityFloor — for each reserved decision class, the number of distinct named DoA holders required to satisfy its SoD distinctness rule on any day given the declared coverage depth (single or double absence), computed by UNB-SMP-ORG-002; (2) WorkloadFTE — Σ(activity volume × human minutes per unit) ÷ (productive hours × practical-capacity factor), with a December-peak variant; (3) PurchasedServices — roles fulfilled by contracted firms (counsel, independent assurance, tax preparation, platform operation), with their FTE-equivalent and cost. Sponsor staff FTE = max(AuthorityFloor persons × minimum time share, WorkloadFTE). Every figure MUST carry its operating structure (solo on shared services, fractional, AI-native core team, conventional, multi-sponsor operator) and [S]/[A]/[D]/[M] labels. Cost-reduction ratchets (UNB-XIN-ECO-015) MUST NOT set targets that imply staff below AuthorityFloor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Run stress scenarios for year-end surge, high exception rates, market drawdown, custodian outage, data-rights denial, fraud and policy change, and additionally for sudden growth, sponsor onboarding, charity revocation waves, payment failures, contribution reversals, complex-asset surges, staff absence, vendor outage, AI outage, incorrect AI outputs, bank reconciliation discrepancies, cyber incident, data corruption, sponsor termination, major migration and simultaneous failures. Each scenario SHALL report, as paired differences against a normal year using common random numbers, not only cost per account but SLA attainment per queue, p90 wait, peak backlog, recovery time, backlog remaining after the year, gross and uncontained financial exposure by kind, human interventions and customer friction per 1,000 accounts.

release_scope: R1
text: The organization SHALL maintain a documented sponsor business model and revenue/fee policy, and unit economics that are (a) computed monthly from measured attributed costs reconciled to GL (UNB-XIN-ECO-004) once operating data exists, (b) labelled by attribution grade, and (c) stress-tested for December surge, high exception rates and market drawdown via ScenarioRun (UNB-XIN-ECO-013), with illustrative inputs explicitly labelled and replaced by measured values as they become available.

release_scope: R1
text: The governed event catalog MUST record, for every event type: owning module; authority class (authoritative-financial, authoritative-nonfinancial, derived, informational, observation-ai); source-of-truth store; required consistency with the state it describes (synchronous or eventual); ordering scope (per aggregate, per fund, per sponsor ledger commit position, global hold version, or none); idempotency key formula; correction pattern; tenant scoping; retention class; producers; consumers; and crosswalk to equivalent names in other catalogs. A consumer that issues a consequential command MUST NOT be subscribed to an event whose authority class is derived, informational or observation-ai unless that command re-reads the authoritative fact in its own transaction; CI MUST reject such subscriptions.

release_scope: R1
text: The F# domain model MUST define distinct types Observation (any source including AI; no authority), Proposal (a suggested command with evidence; no authority), Command (an authenticated principal's request) and Fact (an authoritative recorded outcome). Fact values MUST be constructible only inside owning-module command handlers (private constructors) after deterministic validation of an authorized Command. The AI workbench principal MUST be able to create only Observation and Proposal records, and its database role MUST hold INSERT only on the ai_observation schema. An AI Observation MAY influence a Fact only through an EvidencePromoted record created by a deterministic validator or an authorized human principal, which the Fact then cites.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Sanctions screening MUST follow the counsel-approved ScreeningScope matrix (subjects, lists, triggers, match rules, owners). It MUST run at onboarding, approval and release, and on every list update for all unreleased payment chains and outstanding checks. Name similarity alone MUST NOT cause an adverse determination, and an unresolved potential match MUST hold release. A true match MUST lead to Blocked handling.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: In addition to RR-UNB-EXT-004-r1: a potential match dispositioned as a false positive by an authorized human SHALL be recorded with the subject's identity attributes, the list entry identifier and the list-entry version, and SHALL be reused automatically for subsequent screenings of the same subject against the same list-entry version. The reuse SHALL be invalidated when the subject's identity attributes (name, address, country, identifiers) or the list entry change, or after a counsel-set maximum age. Reuse SHALL NOT apply to true matches, unresolved potential matches, or a different list entry. Name similarity alone SHALL NOT cause an adverse determination. Reuse of a human false-positive disposition is limited to the sponsor legal entity that made it, unless counsel records a cross-sponsor reliance basis (SPD-ADV-002, SPF-ADV-007).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system SHALL monitor source updates, status changes, leadership changes, financial-filing changes, enforcement events and entity relationships for every charity with an open grant, active schedule, unreleased payment or grant in the prior 24 months. Each detected change SHALL be classified by a versioned, counsel-approved MaterialityTable into: (a) Material-Adverse (e.g. revocation, sanctions listing, dissolution, bankruptcy, EIN change, successor designation, supporting-organization type change, change matching a sponsor DiscretionaryGrantPolicy criterion) -> publish a hold to the hold registry within the policy's detection SLA, re-evaluate only impacted grants and schedules (UNB-GEX-019), apply UNB-XIN-NPG-005 effects, and open one case per charity and reason; (b) Material-Neutral (name change same EIN, address change) -> apply deterministic effects without a case; (c) Informational (leadership change, routine filing) -> update evidence with no hold, no case and no human task. Classification rules SHALL be deterministic; AI may propose a classification only for unstructured sources and the proposal SHALL NOT publish or clear a hold.

release_scope: R1
