text: Every inbound receipt (cash or securities) that cannot be matched deterministically to one contribution intent MUST be held in an Unidentified suspense state with no fund credit, no capacity and no acknowledgment; suspense items MUST age through configured thresholds with outreach to the sending institution/remitter; resolution MUST be one of MatchedToIntent (with evidence), ReturnedToSender (pre-acceptance only, as ReturnOfUnacceptedProperty to the originating account), or counsel-approved alternative; AI may propose candidate matches only as A1 suggestions; any match where amount, reference and sender are not all exact MUST require human confirmation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A funding plan MUST be generated only when a grant cannot be funded from settled, unencumbered cash including the pool liquidity buffer (RCD-017); such a grant enters FundingPlanned under RR-UNB-CUST-015-r1. The plan MUST account for redemption cutoffs, gates, settlement dates and market holidays. Routine grants funded from cash or the buffer MUST NOT generate a plan or a human review task.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The sponsor MAY approve, modify under policy with a recorded explanation, or reject/hold a proposed funding allocation. Renewed advisor consent MUST be requested only when the modification changes the recipient, the award amount or the payment timing beyond policy tolerance; a change limited to which sponsor-held assets fund an unchanged grant MUST be recorded and notified to the advisor, not submitted for consent.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every grant amount mode MUST have exactly one FixingEvent at which it becomes a fixed currency amount: FixedAmount at recommendation; Percentage at the sponsor-configured fixing point (default: sponsor approval using the latest approved NAV/valuation snapshot); ResidualSweep and ProceedsLinked after the last relevant settlement. After fixing, the amount MUST NOT change; later valuation corrections MUST NOT re-fix it.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A grant reservation MUST be created only within one serializable transaction that computes reservable capacity from authoritative ledger, reservation and hold records for the fund and every constrained ancestor (pool cash buffer, custody account, legal entity, restricted sub-balance), acquiring locks in a deterministic order. Display projections MUST NOT be used for this check.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every policy parameter that changes approval, eligibility, agent permissions, financial limits or risk MUST be versioned and automatically back-tested against the historical corpus before publication. A change that loosens a control (per CTL-010 monotonic classification) MUST require independent approval with author different from approver; a change that only tightens a control, or adopts an unchanged platform default pack version, MUST require one authorized approver. Classification of a change as tightening MUST be computed, not self-declared.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before sponsor approval and again at release, every grant MUST pass a BenefitAndPurposeGate evaluating: (1) the recipient class (UNB-RCN-GRT-001); (2) related-party payee or beneficiary (UNB-RCN-GRT-002); (3) the donor's AffirmationEvidence (UNB-RCN-GRT-010); (4) the declared purpose and host context, against a counsel-approved catalogue of benefit types (tickets, tables, auction items, memberships with more-than-incidental benefits, personal goods or services, tuition, political campaign purposes); (5) the sponsor's pledge policy (UNB-RCN-GRT-009). The gate's deterministic outcomes are Pass, Reject or Hold. Only Hold cases go to qualified review.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Grant approval authority MUST be routed under REQ-X-017. Tier 1 is deterministic board-delegated sponsor policy, permitted only where OD-01 is validated for that sponsor. Tier 3 is the human routing matrix by role, amount, risk, relationship and exception, with dual control where the sponsor policy requires it. The approver MUST be independent of the originator and of anyone who materially edited the grant.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Grants MUST be made only to recipients whose RecipientClass maps to Permitted, or to ERRequired with a completed ER case, under the counsel-approved RecipientClass rule. Natural persons and non-charitable purposes MUST be rejected. Disqualified supporting organizations and recipients needing expenditure responsibility MUST NOT use the routine path. Recipients absent from IRS files MUST be verifiable through the EntityTypeEvidence matrix.

release_scope: R1
text: Each grant MUST be assigned one GrantTermsTier by a counsel-approved deterministic rule: Tier 0 (routine grant to a Permitted recipient with no conditions) — no agreement; sponsor-standard award terms (charitable use, no goods or services to donor, return if not used for charitable purposes or if recipient status is lost before use) printed in remittance; Tier 1 (sponsor-imposed restriction, condition, milestone or multi-year schedule) — unilateral award letter recording the terms, with grantee acceptance optional unless the sponsor requires it; Tier 2 (ERRequired, or any grant counsel designates) — written commitment signed by an authorized grantee officer containing the counsel-approved §53.4945-5(b)(3) terms, captured electronically. Payment for Tier 2 MUST NOT be released before the signed commitment is recorded. Purpose amendments MUST create a new terms version and re-run the BenefitAndPurposeGate. A distribution to a §170(b)(1)(A) organization other than a disqualified supporting organization is not a §4966 taxable distribution whatever its stated purpose; purpose monitoring of such grants is optional sponsor policy, while §4967 benefit screens remain mandatory (XID-NPG-006).

release_scope: R1
text: Grantee onboarding MUST NOT be a precondition for a routine grant when an existing verified destination or a check/approved disbursement-partner path is available. Payment-destination verification and change controls follow REQ-X-005/RR-REQ-X-005-r1 and UNB-RCN-GRT-017. Grantee acknowledgment of receipt MUST be optional, MUST NOT block grant completion, and MUST NOT be used as payment proof; grant completion MUST rest on settlement evidence. Any acknowledgment content the platform supplies to the grantee MUST state that no goods or services were provided and that the donor may not claim a deduction (UNB-RCN-GRT-011).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each recurring occurrence MUST be evaluated as a new grant at its due time against current authority, affirmation validity, common status, sanctions, sponsor policy and capacity, keyed by (scheduleId, scheduleVersion, periodKey). Held occurrences MUST resolve within OccurrenceHoldWindow or become Skipped. There is no catch-up unless policy allows it. After ConsecutiveAdverseHolds the schedule MUST be Suspended.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Straight-through (Tier-1 policy) approval MUST be enabled per rule version only. Each enabled rule version MUST declare: the low-risk criteria it applies; its DoA entry; monitoring signals (STP rate, post-approval hold/reversal rate, sampled error rate from UNB-XIN-CLM-005 with confidence interval, override count); a threshold for each signal; the trigger claim; and the response, which MUST be suspension of that rule version to its declared fallback (UNB-SMP-ARX-001). The system MUST open a reassessment case for the rule owner when any threshold is crossed and MUST open a trigger-reassessment case when no threshold has been crossed for 12 consecutive months while override or hold counts rose by more than a declared amount. Batching MUST NOT carry approval authority (UNB-XIN-EVA-011).

release_scope: R1
text: A recommendation to a foreign recipient MUST be routed deterministically to exactly one InternationalRoute: (1) RoutineListed — recipient holds a US IRS determination as §170(b)(1)(A) organization; (2) EquivalencyDetermination — current ED per UNB-XIN-NPG-001; (3) ExpenditureResponsibility — sponsor offers ER and UNB-RCN-GRT-003 case completes; (4) Intermediary — donor accepts an IntermediaryCatalog alternative (UNB-XIN-NPG-002); (5) Decline. Routes 2 and 3 additionally require the ForeignNexusDeclaration (UNB-XIN-NPG-009), sanctions screening of the payment chain (UNB-RCN-GRT-007) and, where a program applies, a SanctionsAuthorization (UNB-XIN-NPG-010). Routes offered are sponsor configuration; route selection is never made by AI. Repository-sourced equivalency determinations follow XID-NPG-001.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Charity due diligence SHALL be tiered. Tier A: for every grant, deterministic recipient-class, status and sanctions checks SHALL run against common evidence that is within the FreshnessPolicy (UNB-RCN-GRT-014), reusing evidence already verified for any grant, account or sponsor where sharing is lawful (UNB-CHAR-036). Tier B: when all Tier A checks pass and the sponsor's delegated policy permits (REQ-X-017, OD-01), the diligence result SHALL be recorded as approved by the policy version with no human task. Tier C: missing, stale or conflicting evidence SHALL first trigger bounded automated evidence gathering (refresh from source, entity-type matrix UNB-RCN-GRT-013). Tier D: only rule-defined Hold outcomes, non-standard recipient classes (ERRequired, CounselReview, foreign without ED) and suspected fraud SHALL route to a qualified human, deduplicated per charity rather than per grant (UNB-GEX-021). Human diligence work SHALL NOT be required for a grant solely because of its amount unless the sponsor's board-approved policy names an amount threshold.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each custody account that supports more than one DAF MUST declare one attribution method, either PerFundLotSubAccounting (every position lot carries exactly one fund owner) or Unitized (governed by UNB-NAV rules). For PerFundLotSubAccounting, income, corporate actions and realized results MUST follow lot ownership, and the sum of fund-owned lots MUST equal the custodian position after known in-transit items.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: In-kind contribution workflows MUST, before acceptance of a non-publicly-traded or complex asset, record: asset classification, completed-gift rule, gift-acceptance decision, excess-business-holdings test result (UNB-RCN-FIN-004), Form 8283 Section B donee-signature task where requested, and liquidation policy. Any disposition of property for which the sponsor signed a Form 8283 Section B MUST create a Form 8282 obligation record with deadline unless a counsel-approved exception applies.

release_scope: R1-conditional
text: AI or rule-based features MAY compute drift, risk metrics, liquidity forecasts and conformity to sponsor-approved models, and MAY propose actions that implement a sponsor-approved model or committee-approved parameter. They MUST NOT generate individualized securities selections or allocation advice for a donor, advisor or sponsor beyond approved models unless counsel has recorded the Advisers Act status of the party providing it (sponsor personnel acting under §203(b)(4), a registered adviser under mandate, or another basis). Every proposal MUST name the approved model/parameter it implements and MUST pass deterministic mandate and pre-trade checks before any human approval. The operator MUST NOT provide individualized investment recommendations, and operator compensation MUST NOT vary with assets or trades (XID-INV-004).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Valuation states MUST be Calculated, ExceptionHold, Approved, Published, Superseded and Rejected. An in-tolerance valuation MUST move Calculated -> Published by policy (RR-UNB-NAV-008-r1); Approved MUST be used only on the exception path. Publishing MUST remain a controlled act, never a side effect of calculation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each pool MUST publish a calculated NAV by deterministic policy, without prior human approval, when every pre-publication check of UNB-NAV-007 passes and the NAV change and every price input are within sponsor-approved tolerances; a different authorized person MUST review a seeded random sample of policy-published NAVs on the next business day. Any NAV outside tolerance, any privileged override and any manual price MUST be approved by an authorized human who did not prepare it before publication. AI MAY propose resolutions but MUST NOT approve any NAV, price or override.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every fee accrual MUST be computed from a declared FeeBase contract recording: measurement basis (average daily balance or point-in-time), period, included and excluded components, NAV/valuation version, tier method (marginal or whole-balance), minimum and waiver rules, and fee recipient type. The base MUST exclude accrued unpaid fees and any fee already embedded in a pool NAV for the same service; a DAF-level fee and a pool-level fee for the same service MUST NOT both accrue.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The relationship model MUST provide distinct role types, each independently assignable, overlapping only by explicit grant: contributor; advisory-privilege holder (original or additional); authorized viewer; administrative contact; professional advisor; successor advisor; successor-designate; legal representative (subtypes: agent under power of attorney, guardian/conservator, personal representative/executor, trustee, entity authorized signatory); and sponsor staff. Each role type MUST declare its permitted commands, the evidence required to grant it, an expiry rule, and whether it can delegate.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Participant onboarding MUST record identity-related checks as four separately classified obligations, each with an authority type and owner: (a) sanctions screening; (b) identity proofing at a sponsor-configured assurance level for authentication and fraud control; (c) any customer-identification or AML program, enabled only when counsel records that it applies, by law or by contract with a custodian or payment provider; (d) source-of-funds or gift-acceptance diligence under sponsor policy. The system MUST NOT label any check 'KYC' or 'legally required' without a linked applicability record.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The payment model MUST define explicit handling for rail outage, failure, ACH return, lost, voided and stale checks, partial payments, holds, Blocked, and unclaimed-property disposition, with states, ledger effects, configured thresholds and owners, as specified in RR-REQ-X-083-r1 and UNB-RCN-GRT-005.

release_scope: R1
text: Production enablement of any rail for any sponsor MUST pass a RailGoLive gate that requires: (a) all binding RailObligation rows for that rail and sponsor role mapped to implemented, tested controls (UNB-XIN-BNK-001); (b) provider selection evidence of idempotent submission and status query (TVR-PAY-002); (c) documented fraud-monitoring program for ACH origination (UNB-XIN-BNK-002); (d) debit authorization and account validation controls where debits are accepted (UNB-XIN-PAY-001, UNB-XIN-PAY-002); (e) daily unmatched-debit control for linked accounts (UNB-XIN-BNK-003); (f) funds-flow legal review recording Originator of record and whether any vendor holds funds; and (g) sponsor approval of limits and rail eligibility (UNB-XIN-BNK-004). Items not listed remain future decisions.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Authoritative business history MUST be stored by an Unbound-owned Ledger/Event Store component on managed PostgreSQL, in which authoritative tables are insert-only for the application role (no UPDATE/DELETE grants), corrections and reversals are new linked records, and each append is assigned a per-stream sequence number checked under optimistic concurrency. Strata MUST be used as the schema governance layer: every schema object for the authoritative store, including grants, triggers and row-level-security policies that enforce append-only and tenant isolation, MUST be declared in Strata source, deployed only through Strata plans, and checked for drift before each release; a 'not-compared' or 'unverifiable' Strata state for any such object MUST block release.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST isolate each tenant's authoritative and derived data by binding every data access to exactly one VerifiedTenantContext. The platform MUST support Profile B (dedicated database per tenant on shared managed infrastructure) as the default. Profile A (schema per tenant in a shared database) and Profile C (dedicated deployment cell) MAY be activated per tenant only after an approved TenantIsolationDecision citing a contractual or regulatory requirement and a passing isolation test suite for that profile. All profiles MUST run the identical release of the same codebase.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST define recovery objectives per data class, not per capability, in one versioned table, at minimum: (C0) acknowledged authoritative financial/security commits (ledger, reservations, approvals, holds, payee/destination versions, authority, payment send intents): RPO 0, RTO <= 4 hours, restore to a single consistency point across all C0 stores; (C1) issued document artifacts and evidence: RPO 0 for issued artifacts, RTO <= 24 hours; (C2) operational records (cases, notes, communications history): RPO <= 15 minutes, RTO <= 24 hours; (C3) rebuildable projections, search indexes, caches, embeddings: no backup required if rebuild from C0 is tested, RTO <= 24 hours; (C4) telemetry and non-evidentiary logs: best effort. Each tenant contract MUST reference this table; a tenant MAY buy stricter RTO only with a matching isolation profile. Every class MUST have a restore drill at least annually per isolation profile in use, including tenant-selective restore where the profile claims it, and payment release MUST stay blocked after any restore until C0 consistency and provider reconciliation pass (REQ-X-006).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before a platform-maintained policy-pack version is published, the system MUST shadow-evaluate it against each adopting sponsor's decisions of at least the prior 90 days using pinned evidence, and MUST produce a per-sponsor diff of changed outcomes. Publication MUST require sign-off by the pack owner when any sponsor's changed-outcome share exceeds a declared threshold. Activation MUST be staged: the version becomes effective for at most one sponsor (or one declared cohort) first and for others only after a declared observation period without a reassessment trigger. Each pack parameter MUST declare either an ordering (so "tighten only" is checkable) or an enumerated set of approved alternatives. Rollback to the prior version MUST be a single versioned action.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A successor allocation MUST be computed by a deterministic, versioned algorithm. Inputs: the approved plan; one sponsor-designated valuation point; the fund's available capacity net of reservations, accrued fees and approved-unpaid grants; and per-position divisibility. The algorithm MUST express shares in the fund's unit of account. It MUST assign any rounding residual by a declared rule. It MUST post one balanced allocation journal whose successor credits sum exactly to the origin debit, and MUST hold the split for sponsor decision when any constraint (minimum, restriction, illiquidity, open commitment) cannot be met.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST split authority transition on a death or incapacity notice into three independently recorded steps. (1) ProtectiveHold, on any notice: blocks new recommendations, recurring-instance releases and contact or payee changes for rights derived from the subject party. (2) DerivedRightsSuspended, on verified evidence: suspends every session, credential binding, delegated agent principal and privilege derived from the subject party. (3) SuccessionActivated, on sponsor approval: grants successor rights. Steps 2 and 3 MUST each be atomic within the authoritative store. Rights of other participants that do not derive from the subject MUST remain in force.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The TenantConnectionBroker MUST derive the tenant for every request from the authenticated principal's server-held entitlement set. A client MAY submit an opaque tenant selection token only if it was issued by the server from that entitlement set for the current session; the broker MUST revalidate membership and delegation validity on every request and MUST ignore any schema, database, host or raw tenant identifier supplied by a client, partner API, widget host or AI agent.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each tenant MUST have one TenantLifecycle state machine: Prospect > Contracted > Provisioning > Configured > ReadinessValidated > Live > (Suspended <-> Live) > ExitNoticed > ExportDelivered > ReadOnlyRetention > DestructionAuthorized > Destroyed. Transition to Live MUST require recorded evidence of: executed SponsorOperatingAgreement (REQ-X-064), sponsor board/delegation evidence, isolation profile decision, approved configuration version, provider integrations passing contract tests, and named sponsor approvers. Suspended MUST stop new commands from non-sponsor principals while accepted commands, holds, statements and retention continue. DestructionAuthorized MUST require no active legal hold, expiry of the contractual and legal retention computed by the retention engine, and dual authorization.

release_scope: Deferred
text: On sponsor exit, Unbound MUST deliver within 30 days of ExitNoticed (or the contract period) an ExitPackage containing: the tenant's complete authoritative event history and current projections in the documented export schema, issued document artifacts with hashes, policy and configuration versions, audit and evidence records, and a manifest signed with SHA-256 digests plus record counts and ledger trial balances per fund and period that reconcile to the live system at the export watermark. The sponsor MUST be able to verify the package independently. After delivery the tenant MUST enter ReadOnlyRetention for the contractually agreed period, during which authorized sponsor users can query and export. Destruction MUST be performed by destroying tenant-scoped encryption keys under dual control after retention and hold checks, and Unbound MUST issue a destruction certificate stating what was destroyed, what persists (e.g. immutable backups until their expiry, with dates) and which records were retained by legal obligation. Distribution partners MUST receive only data the sponsor authorizes, never by default. Decided timings (XID-REC-001): the sponsor is records custodian after exit; ReadOnlyRetention lasts 90 days after the reconciled ExitPackage is delivered; backups expire on their normal schedule, no more than 35 days thereafter; legal holds override deletion and are listed on the destruction certificate.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every screen, widget, notification and document MUST display a subject's status using the authoritative domain state from that subject's state machine, including Unknown/Uncertain and Failed where the state machine defines them. UI technical states (loading, stale, offline, error) MUST be shown separately from domain state. The UI MUST NOT display a terminal success state until the authoritative command result and evidence confirm it.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each requirement classified risk-bearing MUST link to at least one normal, one exception and one adversarial acceptance scenario meeting UNB-RCN-PLT-009; each other requirement MUST link to at least one acceptance scenario; CI MUST report requirements without the required links.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A donor-recommended transfer of all or part of a fund to another sponsoring organization MUST be processed as a sponsor distribution through the standard grant lifecycle, with purpose code DAF_TRANSFER_OUT, unless counsel records a different classification. It MUST include: receiving-organization eligibility; the sponsor's discretion to approve or decline; cash as the default, with in-kind only where both custodians accept and policy allows; carrying over donor-stated restrictions as non-binding recommendation text; a transfer history package to the receiving sponsor when the donor consents; and, for full transfers, fund closure under UNB-RCN-ENT-006.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Fund inactivity MUST be governed by a sponsor-approved, versioned dormancy policy. Parameters: the activity events that reset the clock; Quiet, Inactive and Unresponsive thresholds; required outreach channels and attempts; and the default disposition (charitable default to sponsor-designated purposes or charities, transfer to a donor-named charitable beneficiary under UNB-SUCC-011, or continued holding). The lifecycle is Active > Quiet > Inactive > Unresponsive > DispositionPending > Disposed or Reactivated. Any disposition distributing assets MUST be an A4 sponsor decision run through the normal grant lifecycle. Escheat handling MUST NOT apply to fund balances unless counsel records it as applicable.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every external and inter-component command, query and event contract MUST be defined once in F# types from which OpenAPI 3.1 (HTTP) and JSON Schema (events) are generated; generated schemas MUST be versioned and checked for breaking changes in CI; the AI-assistance contract for each operation (see RR-REQ-X-051-r1 or its successor) MUST be generated from the same source.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST resolve all user-facing domain terms (e.g., 'fund', 'grant', 'advisor') through a versioned, sponsor-scoped terminology catalog applied identically in UI, documents, email, IVR prompts and AI assistant output; legally significant phrases (e.g., the exclusive-legal-control acknowledgment statement) MUST be non-overridable.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The program MUST maintain a versioned requirements-gate record listing each CHARTER gate criterion with owner, measure, denominator, evidence path and status, a named gate approver, and an overall PASS or FAIL. FAIL is the default until the approver signs.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The program MUST define a release-1 scope as an outcome slice, with every requirement family classified as in, deferred or excluded and given an owner. Requirements outside release 1 MUST NOT block the release-1 gate.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every workflow, failure-mode and gap identifier MUST carry a registered namespace prefix (LS-WF, E2E-WF, ADM-WF, CW, SIM-FM, LSGAP). The traceability checker MUST reject bare WF-nn, FM-nn and GAP-nnn references in new text.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: On verified death or incapacity of a party, the system MUST suspend, in one transaction, all rights, sessions and delegated agent principals that derive from that party, independently of and before succession activation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST implement the sponsor-parameterized dormancy lifecycle in RR-UNB-WF-015-r1. Escheat processing MUST be limited to payment instruments unless counsel records otherwise.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Fund closure MUST be a state machine (ClosureRequested > ObligationsResolved > FinalFeesPosted > ResidualDisposed > Closed > Archived) with typed triggers (donor request, zero balance, dormancy disposition, succession split, full outbound transfer, sponsor exit). Closed MUST require: no open reservations; every payment attempt terminal or transferred to an outstanding-instrument liability; and a recorded destination for trailing receipts (OD-11).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Outbound transfers to another sponsoring organization MUST follow RR-UNB-WF-014-r1, and inbound transfers MUST be classified by a counsel-approved rule covering contributor of record, acknowledgment, restrictions and successor plans.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST support sponsor-approved fund split and merge outside succession (for example, co-donor separation or family division), reusing the RR-UNB-SUCC-004-r1 allocation algorithm. A dispute between participants MUST hold consequential actions until sponsor resolution.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each contribution MUST record a contributor of record (the acknowledgment recipient), determined by a CPA- and counsel-approved rule for joint accounts, third-party payers and entity payers. It MUST NOT default to the fund's advisory-privilege holder.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The role catalogue MUST include legal-representative subtypes with evidence, scope and expiry, per RR-UNB-PART-003-r1.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST maintain a counsel-approved register classifying every account and product type (standard DAF, workplace account, campaign pool, designated or field-of-interest fund, etc.) as a donor-advised fund or not. That classification MUST drive excise-tax control applicability and annual reporting.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST produce the DAF annual reporting data package defined in RR-REQ-X-060-r1.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: An advisory-privilege holder MUST be able to export the fund's grant, contribution and statement history in a documented machine-readable format, limited to data they are authorized to see.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST maintain an applicability register for identity-related regimes (sanctions, identity proofing, customer-identification/AML, source-of-funds) per sponsor, role and channel, each with authority type and counsel status, as specified in RR-UNB-PART-007-r1.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Fees paid from fund assets to any professional advisor with a personal advisory relationship with the donor, or to any holder of advisory privileges, MUST be blocked until a counsel-approved rule for that arrangement is recorded. Tracking of the 2023 proposed DAF regulations MUST trigger re-review on finalization.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Donors and charities MUST be able to request reconsideration of a sponsor decision through a case with a defined outcome set, owner and response time. Staff-assisted actions MUST record channel, assurance level and staff identity, and MUST be confirmed through the donor's verified channel before any consequential effect.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST issue DAF contribution acknowledgments only through a gated IssueAcknowledgment command that validates a counsel-approved, versioned sponsor template containing every element counsel designates as mandatory (including the statement that the sponsoring organization has exclusive legal control over the contributed assets, the goods-or-services statement, cash amount or noncash description, donor and sponsor identity, and contribution date), and MUST block issuance when any element is missing.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: When the sponsor signs a donor's Form 8283 Section B, Unbound MUST record the signature event, the property description, the lot identifiers, and the date of receipt, and MUST record that the signature acknowledges receipt and not value.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Any sale, exchange or other disposition of a lot linked to a Form8283Signed record within the counsel-configured reporting window MUST create a Form8282Obligation with due date, owner and donor-copy task, unless a counsel-approved exception rule applies; obligations MUST be tracked to filing-receipt evidence and escalate before the due date.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST maintain business-enterprise identities and related-person holdings declared at gift acceptance, MUST compute combined holdings for each fund and its donors/advisors/related persons per counsel-configured rules before accepting a business interest and on each later related transaction, and MUST track any disposal period with escalation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every fee schedule MUST declare a FeeBase contract (measurement basis, inclusions/exclusions, valuation version, tier method, minimums, waivers, recipient type, service identity), and every accrual MUST store the computed base and be deterministically recomputable; accrued unpaid fees and fees embedded in pool NAV for the same service MUST be excluded from any base.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Posting policies MUST declare balancing segments; for DAF books, fund and restriction MUST be balancing segments, and internal fund transfers MUST use net-asset transfer or internal-transfer clearing lines that net to zero sponsor-wide per currency.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every multi-fund custody account MUST declare one attribution method (PerFundLotSubAccounting or Unitized); undeclared accounts MUST NOT accept multi-fund allocations; lot-owned positions MUST reconcile per security to custodian positions.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The grant lifecycle MUST include FundingPlanned, LiquidationPending, Funded and FundingShortfall states, and PaymentInstructionAuthorized MUST require Funded or an approved, limit-checked liquidity advance recorded as an interfund receivable.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Capacity used to authorize reservations MUST be computed within the reservation transaction from authoritative records for all constrained ancestors with deterministic lock order; asynchronous projections MUST be labelled display-only and MUST NOT authorize.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before any advisor or manager compensation accrues from DAF assets, Unbound MUST record the counsel-approved classification of the advisor's relationship to the fund's donors/advisors and the applicable compensation policy, and MUST hold accrual when the classification is missing or indicates a donor-advisor relationship pending counsel decision.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For assets traded continuously, every valuation MUST record an exact UTC timestamp, the sponsor-configured valuation convention, and the price source; contributed crypto above counsel-configured thresholds MUST be flagged as requiring donor qualified appraisal per counsel-approved guidance.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST determine the completed-gift date from a versioned, counsel-approved rule table keyed by asset type and rail (e.g., DTC transfer, physical certificate, check, ACH, card, wire, crypto, real property), and MUST hold the contribution when evidence required by the rule is missing.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: After sponsor acceptance, value MUST leave a DAF only through the grant lifecycle to an eligible grantee or a governed sponsor-to-sponsor transfer; any 'refund' to a donor or other natural person MUST be rejected unless a counsel-approved exception (e.g., return of property never accepted, or payroll over-withholding before acceptance) applies and is cited on the command.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The journal fixture set MUST include line-level entity, currency, fund and restriction columns, MUST be validated by an executable balance check per entity x currency x balancing segment, and MUST cover fund-to-fund transfer, interfund fee with elimination, unit subscription and redemption, FX, returned contribution, noncash gift with fees, and correction of a correction.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Donor-facing annual summaries and AI assistance MUST use counsel-approved, effective-dated tax disclosures and MUST NOT state or imply that DAF contributions qualify for the nonitemizer charitable deduction or any specific deductible amount.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before sponsor approval and again at payment release, the system MUST classify every grant recipient into a counsel-approved RecipientClass. Classes are: (a) 170(b)(1)(A) public charity not a disqualified supporting organization; (b) disqualified supporting organization; (c) private non-operating foundation or other recipient requiring expenditure responsibility; (d) foreign organization; (e) government unit; (f) natural person; (g) non-charitable or unknown. The system MUST deterministically map each class to Permitted, ERRequired, Prohibited or CounselReview under a versioned rule. It MUST reject classes (f) and (g) in every tier, with no human override unless counsel later approves a lawful exception route. It MUST NOT let AI output set a class.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST block, as a nonwaivable hold, any grant or payment whose payee legal entity, destination account owner or declared beneficiary matches a donor, advisor or related person in the fund's related-party registry. This applies to reimbursements, tuition, travel and fees paid to an advisor's firm from fund assets, unless counsel has approved that payment class. Evidence of the match MUST be recorded, and only independent compliance authority may release the hold, based on counsel's determination.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For every grant classed ERRequired, the system MUST track an ExpenditureResponsibilityCase with: pre-grant inquiry evidence; a signed agreement containing the counsel-approved terms; a reporting schedule; receipt and review of each report; and the reporting inputs for the sponsor's return. It MUST block payment until the inquiry and agreement are complete, and block further grants to that grantee while a report is overdue past the configured period. An ER determination MUST NOT be reused across sponsors unless counsel approves a reliance agreement.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each recurring occurrence MUST have the idempotency key (scheduleId, scheduleVersion, periodKey). An occurrence held for eligibility, sanctions, authority or funding MUST stay Held until the configured OccurrenceHoldWindow ends. If it clears within the window, it proceeds once. If not, it becomes Skipped with a reason. There is no automatic catch-up payment in a later period unless the schedule's sponsor policy explicitly allows catch-up. After ConsecutiveAdverseHolds held or skipped occurrences for an adverse reason, the schedule MUST move to Suspended and needs donor reconfirmation and a fresh affirmation to resume. The donor MUST be notified on every hold, skip and suspension.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The check rail MUST model the states Issued, Outstanding, AgedOutreach (at configurable day thresholds), StaleDated, VoidRequested, VoidConfirmed (positive-pay void acknowledged), Cleared, and UnclaimedPropertyReportable. Each state MUST have a defined grant, reservation and ledger effect. Reissue requires VoidConfirmed, verified recipient eligibility and destination, and a linked replacement chain. When a check reaches the jurisdiction-specific dormancy rule, the system MUST either produce unclaimed-property report and remittance evidence or record the counsel-approved alternative disposition. It MUST NOT silently release the funds to the fund.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The payment model MUST include Blocked in the provider-knowledge and settlement dimensions, and the ledger MUST include a BlockedProperty classification. A sponsor-side true match, or an intermediary or provider blocking notice, MUST move the payment to Blocked, stop retry, reissue and capacity restoration, open a sanctions case with reporting deadlines, and record report evidence. Release requires license or delisting evidence and independent compliance authority. AI and non-compliance roles cannot release.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST maintain a counsel-approved ScreeningScope matrix (subject type x list x trigger x match rule x owner). Subjects cover at least: recipient legal entity, fiscal sponsor and project, payee account holder, intermediary and beneficiary banks for cross-border payments, destination country, donor and advisor. Triggers are onboarding, approval, release, and any list update. A list update MUST rescreen every unreleased payment chain and every Outstanding check before its next transition.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For each rail, the system MUST define an UnknownResolutionProtocol: a provider status query by idempotency key at defined intervals; a reconciliation against bank statements after the rail's settlement window; and the evidence combination that permits declaring NotReceived (for example: provider attests no execution, plus no statement debit after the window, plus recipient confirms non-receipt). Declaring NotReceived requires independent approval and creates the linked reissue chain. Unknown items MUST age into escalation tiers at configured thresholds. They MUST NOT be retried or reissued outside this protocol.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Pledge handling MUST be a sponsor L3 policy with values Prohibited, NonBindingOnly or NoticeConditions, on a counsel-approved baseline. Under NoticeConditions, the system MUST: (1) suppress pledge identifiers and pledge vocabulary from every sponsor-issued outbound artifact (check memo, ACH addenda, remittance advice, recipient portal, webhooks); (2) run the other-benefit gate; (3) include the no-deduction remittance statement. Inbound pledge references MUST be kept only as internal evidence.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every grant submission MUST carry an AffirmationEvidence record: actor; authority; sponsor; fund; draft hash; disclosure version and content hash; locale and presented text; channel; time; idempotency key; and explicit affirmative action, with no pre-checked or inferred consent. The server MUST reject submissions, including widget and API submissions, without valid evidence for the current disclosure version. A material change of amount, recipient, purpose or policy version MUST invalidate the affirmation. Recurring schedules MUST use a standing affirmation with a sponsor-configured validity and its own refresh triggers.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Sponsor-issued remittance and recipient-portal grant records MUST state the sponsoring organization as the legal donor and MUST include a counsel-approved statement that the donor or advisor may not claim a charitable deduction for the grant. Recipient CRM attribution exports MUST label the donor as an advisor-recommender, not the legal donor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Embedded and API checkout requests MUST declare a typed HostContext: Donation, EventTicket, TableOrSponsorship, Auction, MembershipWithBenefits, Other. Contexts that carry a benefit MUST be rejected or routed to the benefit gate per sponsor policy. Widgets MUST be certified, and the server MUST cross-check the declared context against the host's registered page classification.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The system MUST maintain a counsel-approved EntityTypeEvidence matrix, giving accepted evidence for: government units; churches and conventions not required to file; group-exemption subordinates; disregarded entities of an eligible parent; and newly recognized organizations not yet in bulk files. Satisfying the matrix MUST produce a common verification status equivalent to an IRS-listed entity, recorded with its evidence class.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Common verification freshness MUST be configured as a versioned FreshnessPolicy: fact type, maximum age, monitoring source, refresh lead time, execution-time recheck flag, owner and legal-basis classification (statute, regulation, guidance, or policy). It MUST be published under independent governance. Sponsors MAY impose stricter values for their own grants only. No requirement, gate or state machine may hard-code a numeric interval.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Returned, recalled, refunded or recipient-declined grant funds MUST be re-credited to the originating fund via a linked compensating entry. They MUST NOT generate a contribution acknowledgment or tax receipt. Capacity is restored only after reconciliation, and the donor is notified. A recipient MUST be able to decline a grant before release, which cancels the reservation. Accounting treatment is subject to CPA approval.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: When an adverse common-status, sanctions or authority event affects a payment that has been dispatched but not settled, the system MUST automatically: request stop, recall or void where the rail allows; record the request outcome as externally uncertain; open a linked case; and notify the sponsor. The grant MUST NOT be marked complete until the outcome is reconciled.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Treasury MUST publish a versioned DestinationEvidence table per rail. It names evidence types (for example bank-originated account-owner match, prenote or return absence, independent callback using a contact sourced separately from the change request, positive-pay reconciled clearing), assigns each an evidence class, and sets the minimum combination for automated release. Rails or providers that cannot meet the minimum MUST be ineligible for automated release.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST define Tenant, LegalSponsor, DistributionPartner, Program, Fund and DeploymentCell as distinct typed entities, and MUST publish for every data class its isolation key (tenant or sponsor) and whether it may be shared across partners of the same sponsor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST maintain a versioned notification event catalog: event, class (mandatory-legal, security, transactional, service, optional), channels, consent basis, whether sponsor may disable, recipient eligibility rule, dedup key and quiet-hours policy. Mandatory and security classes MUST NOT be suppressible by user preference.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every global hold MUST carry a strictly increasing HoldPublicationVersion, and every payment release and dispatch MUST record and verify the version observed (see RR-REQ-X-020-r1).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: All context retrieved for an AI assistance session MUST be read through the public query layer under the initiating principal's VerifiedTenantContext and role; retrieved resource IDs MUST be logged with the session.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST publish one authority matrix mapping each action class to A0-A5 and to permitted actor types (deterministic policy, AI agent, human role), with the human approval boundary per class; all other AI level/tier vocabularies MUST reference it.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST measure, per sponsor and workflow, straight-through-processing rate, human touches per completed outcome and WorkItems created per rule, and MUST require each new WorkItem-creating rule to state its expected volume and the decision only a human can make.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Brand Kit publication MUST validate terminology overrides against a protected-term registry of legally meaningful terms (e.g. grant recommendation, sponsoring organization legal name, tax acknowledgment wording) whose meaning may not be altered; violations block publication.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every risk-bearing requirement MUST have a reviewed control link or reviewed gap; candidate links do not count (see RR-SOC2-007-r1).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: An ADV/DKS scenario MUST specify expected domain state, rejected command and error code where applicable, required audit record and financial invariant before it may be cited as acceptance evidence; CI MUST reject duplicate scenario IDs.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every issued document MUST be available in an accessible form (tagged PDF or accessible HTML generated from the same snapshot) at issuance, with the same integrity reference.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The persona-by-journey matrix MUST classify each task as phone-complete, phone-review-and-approve or desktop-first, with rationale, and acceptance tests per class.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A TenantIsolationDecision MUST cite the contractual/regulatory clause requiring a non-default profile, the risk accepted, cost, and the passing isolation test suite before activation.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The assurance scope MUST state, per service, whether SOC 1 Type II (ICFR-relevant fund accounting) and/or SOC 2 applies, agreed with a CPA, and the control register MUST tag each control with the report(s) it supports.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Donors and advisors MUST be able to search the canonical charity registry by name (including known aliases), EIN, city/state and cause category, with results showing legal name, EIN, location and the current platform eligibility state (Eligible, Held, Ineligible or Unknown) with its as-of date. Selecting a result MUST bind the recommendation to the canonical charity identity, never to free text. Results MUST NOT show sponsor-private notes or holds of other sponsors. A recipient not found MUST be submittable as an identity-resolution request, not as a free-text grant.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The sponsor compliance owner MUST maintain a regulatory-change watch list including REG-142338-07 (proposed §4966 regulations), the 2026–27 Priority Guidance Plan item on §§4966/6033 DAF arrangements, OFAC rule changes, and state charitable-solicitation changes. Each item MUST link to the requirement IDs it would affect. A status change MUST open a requirements impact review within 10 business days (sponsor-configurable).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before approving a grant to a Type I, Type II or functionally integrated Type III supporting organization, the system MUST hold a current certification (from the grantee or the donor/advisors, per counsel-approved form) that no donor, advisor or related person controls the organization. A missing or expired certification MUST place the grant on Hold.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: When an authorized human confirms a sanctions true match involving property in the sponsor's possession, the system MUST record the property as blocked, prevent any movement, generate the blocked-property report data due to OFAC within 10 business days, track the annual report, and retain all related records for at least 10 years.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each inbound collection rail (ACH debit) and each outbound refund or redelivery of never-accepted property MUST have an Unknown-resolution protocol equivalent to UNB-RCN-GRT-008. Re-initiation after proven NotSubmitted MUST reuse the original idempotency key.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A contribution intent with no receipt MUST lapse after the sponsor window (default 60 days, RCD-046) and notify the declarant. A receipt after lapse MUST be treated as unannounced.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A multi-lot securities intent MUST close as partial after the sponsor window (default 30 days) or on donor confirmation. Acknowledgment and Form 8283 then cover only the received lots.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The sponsor MUST configure acknowledgment timing for reversible rails (OnAcceptance | AfterFinal; default AfterFinal, RCD-032). OnAcceptance requires a void-and-correction path on return.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each intermediary agreement MUST record its counsel-approved structure (donee model for release 1, RCD-034), which determines the donee of record and the acknowledgment, Form 8283/8282 and §4943 duties.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The annual reporting obligation MUST track due date, extension and escalation tiers.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: An amended annual package MUST pass the same distinct prepare, review and sign states as the original.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A mandatory-legal document whose delivery failed MUST be retried on another verified channel before it is closed as portal-only.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Program activation MUST be an A4 sponsor-officer command requiring: a current contract; current board delegation; the legal-sponsor disclosure; a passing tenant isolation suite; tied-out opening balances; and finance readiness certified by a different principal.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: On contract lapse the program MUST suspend new funds, contributions and approvals, while in-flight payments complete under their own workflows.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Rights suspended for incapacity MUST be reinstated only by an A4 reviewer on capacity-restoration evidence, with credentials re-issued through the verified channel.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A protective hold MUST pause standing contribution debits from accounts held by the subject.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Revocation and expiry MUST take effect at the next authorization check and in no case later than 60 seconds (RCD-041), including sessions, widget tokens and agent tokens.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Closure MUST define the policy for contributions received while closure is pending, withdrawal of a donor-requested closure before the residual is committed, and an A4 default residual disposition when the donor gives no recommendation within the policy window.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Returns, voids and receipts for a Closed or Archived fund MUST route to its recorded trailing destination (RCD-040) and MUST NOT reopen the fund.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Policy versions that depend on a board delegation MUST suspend when the delegation lapses, and routine approval MUST revert to human A4.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Work items MUST escalate on SLA breach, MUST be decided only by a principal who is not the preparer and holds authority for the action class, and MUST reopen when execution of the decision fails.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Reconsideration MUST have a request window (default 60 days), the outcome set {Upheld, Overturned, Modified, Referred}, a reviewer independent of the original decider, and a response time (default 30 days).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Invitations MUST expire after the policy period (default 14 days) and MUST become invalid if the inviter's authority ends before acceptance.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: If a migration fence outcome is Unknown, Unbound MUST NOT post until the fence is confirmed. A migration run MAY be abandoned before cutover, with staging evidence retained.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each sponsor policy parameter MUST be classified platform-safety or not. Changes to platform-safety parameters MUST receive platform-risk clearance, which grants no sponsor authority.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Where NotReceived evidence cannot be obtained within the final aging tier, two independent treasury approvers MAY resolve by recorded decision with duplicate-risk acceptance and recovery plan (RCD-042).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A payment whose destination evidence is ineligible for automated release MAY be released only by an independent A4 treasury approver; holds, sanctions and stale eligibility are never overridable.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A confirmed sanctions match without property in possession MUST refuse the transaction and produce OFAC rejected-transaction report data within 10 business days (RCD-044).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Draft lifetime, confirmation, re-affirmation, evidence-request, sanctions-disposition SLA and destination-verification windows MUST be versioned policy parameters with owners (defaults RCD-046).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The CFO MUST approve the default funding ShortfallRule (reduce | waterfall top-up | hold; default hold, RCD-046).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Positive-pay exception pay/return decisions MUST be in the payment authority model, with default Return (RCD-046).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Destination activation MUST follow a cooling-off period (default 3 business days) and notify both the previous and the new verified channels.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A grant that fails capacity at approval MUST wait in CapacityShort for at most the sponsor CapacityWaitWindow (default 30 days), then be declined with a reason.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: A fund under continued holding after dormancy outreach MUST be re-reviewed every 12 months (default, RCD-046).

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each automated decision path (policy grant approval, charity status refresh, automated reconciliation matching, automated contribution acceptance) MUST declare a fallback mode of Hold or HumanQueue and an expected human minutes per item. When the path is suspended or its inputs are stale, the system MUST apply the declared fallback, MUST notify affected donors/advisors/charities with a reason class and an expected next-update time, and MUST compute and display the projected backlog clearance time against the rostered capacity for the reviewing role. The system MUST NOT release, approve or match any held item solely because of its age or backlog size.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Sponsor onboarding MUST collect configuration through a versioned Outcome Questionnaire of at most 15 questions about the sponsor's legal identity, operating model, approval delegation, donor types, mission restrictions, money-in rails, grant payment methods, investment offering, fees, service model, brand and voice, risk appetite and statement cadence. Each answer MUST map, by a published deterministic derivation rule, to configuration items in the configuration register (UNB-SMP-CFG-003); every item not derived MUST take its policy-pack default (UNB-SMP-CFG-002). The resulting configuration MUST be presented as one reviewable draft with the derivation trace for each value, and MUST enter the normal policy lifecycle (draft, validate, simulate, approve). No item of disposition 'eliminate' or 'platform-owned' may be presented to the sponsor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST provide versioned Policy Packs, each a set of configuration item values with: pack ID and semantic version; reviewing authority (counsel, CPA, treasury) and review date per item; legal basis citation per item; default rationale; override direction per item (tightenOnly | lengthenOnly | sponsorChoice | none). A sponsor MUST adopt a pack version by an attestation command (A4, sponsor officer) that records attestor, pack hash and date. A sponsor override MUST be accepted only if it satisfies the item's override direction as evaluated by a deterministic comparator; any other override MUST be rejected unless approved through a recorded counsel deviation. When a new pack version is published, every attested sponsor MUST receive the diff, consequence simulation and effective date; adoption behaviour MUST follow SPD-CFG-001. Transactions and issued documents MUST pin the pack version in force.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST maintain a Configuration Register in which every sponsor- or platform-configurable item has: item ID; source requirement IDs; owner; who needs it and why; change frequency; default and whether it satisfies most sponsors; derivation rule if derivable; policy pack; conflicts; test and support cost (low | med | high); AI-assistance safety; disposition (eliminate | derive | default-in-pack | controlled-override | retain-configurable); and, for retain-configurable, the preserved reason (white-label, terminology, sponsor grant rules, affirmations, fees, operating-model difference). A new configurable item MUST NOT be merged unless its register entry exists and its disposition is approved by the product owner; items with disposition eliminate or platform-owned MUST NOT be exposed on sponsor surfaces or sponsor APIs.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: The platform MUST maintain a roster of authorized workforce principals per sponsor by role and calendar day (including holidays and declared absences) and MUST compute, for each SoD-constrained command class, whether at least two eligible, mutually independent principals are available on each day of a forward horizon of at least 30 days. A day with fewer than two eligible principals for any SoD-constrained role MUST be reported as a coverage gap to the sponsor operations owner. During a gap, commands requiring the uncovered role MUST be held rather than executed under an SoD waiver.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every policy-pack element, rule version and accounting-treatment setting MUST record the decision identifiers it relies on and each decision's basis status (provisional, confirmed, superseded). A version whose basis includes any provisional decision MUST NOT be activated in a production sponsor environment. When a decision is superseded, the system MUST list every active version, sponsor and record class that relies on it and MUST open a change case for each.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound MUST maintain a versioned Interaction Register with one entry per customer-facing input, confirmation or wait step (donor, advisor, charity, sponsor officer, partner). Each entry MUST declare: persona, journey, data requested, necessity basis (law | consent | donor-control | security | convention) with citation, whether the data is already held or retrievable with authorization, inference or default rule, and the notification catalog event (UNB-RCN-PLT-002) that ends each wait step. A step with basis 'convention' MUST name an accountable owner and a review date. A wait step without a catalog event MUST NOT be released. A UI flow MUST NOT render an input whose register entry is absent.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every Next Best Action (NBA) shown on a dashboard, work queue or customer home MUST be generated from a registered Intervention type that declares: triggering condition (deterministic rule or metric threshold from the metric registry); evidence fields cited; expected outcome; ranking inputs (harm avoided or value protected, deadline proximity, legal clock, customer impact, effort) combined by a published deterministic ranking rule; the domain command it opens and that command's authority class (UNB-RCN-PLT-005). An NBA MUST be shown as actionable only if the viewer currently holds authority for the command; otherwise it MUST be shown as unavailable with the reason and the role that can act. Selecting an NBA MUST open the authoritative command with re-checked state and MUST NOT execute A3 or higher actions directly. AI MAY explain or draft evidence for an NBA but MUST NOT change its rank.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Each fee-schedule version that sets a minimum annual fee, a minimum opening balance or a minimum fund balance SHALL reference a CostBasis record for each servicing class it applies to, stating marginal variable cost per account-year, fully allocated cost per account-year (sponsor-level and fund-borne costs shown separately, never included), their confidence grade and P10/P50/P90 range, and the ratio of the minimum to the fully allocated P50. Publication of the schedule version SHALL be rejected when the CostBasis is missing or older than 13 months, or when the ratio exceeds a configured ceiling (default 1.5) unless an approver records a non-cost rationale category (cross-subsidy policy, distribution cost, risk) that is disclosed in the donor fee disclosure.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Before activating a sponsor onboarding, an inbound book migration or a growth campaign that adds more than a configured share (default 10%) of active accounts within any 60-business-day window, the platform SHALL run the capacity forecast (UNB-XIN-ECO-017) including the added steady-state volume and the declared one-off migration work, and SHALL require an approver acknowledgment recording the projected SLA attainment per queue, projected peak backlog and days to clear whenever any queue's projected SLA attainment is below its configured floor (default 90%) or projected backlog does not clear within 30 business days. Reductions in cost per account attributable to account growth SHALL be reported separately and SHALL NOT be credited as verified savings under UNB-XIN-ECO-015/019.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For each ServicingClass, the platform SHALL compute an expected marginal cost per account-year as the sum of (a) registered recurring-obligation cost (UNB-XIN-ADV-001), (b) expected payment-rail cost from the class's funding and grant rail mix, (c) expected human minutes (contacts, exceptions after determination reuse, ACH returns, reconciliation breaks) multiplied by the applicable capacity cost rate (UNB-XIN-ECO-006), and (d) expected AI and infrastructure unit costs, each with grade and P10/P50/P90. Publishing a DigitalMinimal program configuration SHALL be rejected when the expected marginal cost P50 exceeds the program's declared expected revenue per account-year (excluding fund-borne costs) unless a sponsor-approved subsidy source and amount are recorded. ServicingClass SHALL NOT be an input to eligibility, sanctions, approval, grant priority or payment timing.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Unbound's charges SHALL be computed from a typed list of fee components. In release 1 only two types are enabled: (A) a per-account licence fee by ServicingClass and (B) a per-sponsor annual tenant fee. Quotes, invoices and cost-to-serve reports SHALL itemize A and B for each sponsor, including when an Administrator is billed for several sponsors. Adding a new component type later (for example operator-supplied staffing under SPR-ADV-009) SHALL require only configuration and a recorded owner decision, and SHALL NOT change any existing customer's charges until their contract is amended. Fee components and amounts SHALL NOT be inputs to eligibility, sanctions, approval, grant priority or payment timing.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every WorkItem, human approval task and human touch recorded against an outcome MUST carry exactly one primary HumanInterventionClass from the versioned taxonomy {LegallyRequiredJudgment, FiduciaryGovernance, IndependentControl, MaterialFinancialRisk, AmbiguousEvidence, NovelCircumstance, CustomerRequestedAssistance, SystemFailure, AvoidableAdministrative}, assigned deterministically by the creating rule (not by the assignee), plus the rule id and the authority-matrix action class (UNB-RCN-PLT-005). 'AI involvement', 'AI confidence' or 'AI-generated' MUST NOT be a class or a sufficient creating condition; a rule that routes AI output to a human MUST cite one of the nine classes (normally AmbiguousEvidence or NovelCircumstance) with the evidence condition. A creating rule whose items are classed AvoidableAdministrative MUST declare a prevention owner; when such a rule produces more than the configured volume (default 25 items) in each of two consecutive periods, the platform MUST open a REQ-X-042 InterventionProposal. Reporting MUST show human touches per 1,000 outcomes by class, rule and sponsor.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: For each reserved decision class in the authority matrix (UNB-RCN-PLT-005) that has a service-level clock, the platform MUST compute daily, for the next 20 business days (configurable), an AuthorityCoverage record: the set of principals holding a valid DoA entry for that class (UNB-XIN-ERP-005) who are scheduled available, minus those excluded by recorded absence; and it MUST test whether the class's distinctness requirement can be met (e.g. two approvers excluding the releaser for NotReceived; payee approver ≠ releaser) using per-item SoD history rather than fixed role-per-person assignments. When coverage fails for any day, the platform MUST open a CoverageGap work item (class FiduciaryGovernance) for the accountable executive at least 10 business days before the day (or immediately if later), listing pre-authorized backup delegates that would close the gap. The platform MUST NOT relax SoD, auto-approve, or extend an approver's authority to close a gap; items that cannot be decided wait with their SLA status and customer notice per their profile.

release_scope: unassigned (default initial-implementation unless a clause defers)
text: Every principal MUST be recorded with an employing Organization of type Sponsor, Administrator or Vendor, and with the sponsors each Administrator is contracted to act for. A delegation-of-authority entry at level A3 or above for a sponsor (UNB-XIN-ERP-005; UNB-RCN-PLT-005) MUST be refused unless the principal belongs to that sponsor's DecisionTeam and holds no active A3+ entry for any other sponsor. In release 1 a DecisionTeam member MUST be employed or board-appointed by that sponsor: principals of Administrator or Vendor organizations MUST NOT hold A3+ authority. Administrator principals MAY perform non-reserved work (service, operations, evidence assembly, case preparation) for the sponsors they are contracted for; Vendor principals MAY perform only platform support under the access controls. Reserved work items MUST be routed only to the owning sponsor's DecisionTeam; no queue, assignment pool, delegate list or AI agent may route a reserved item to anyone else. Each sponsor MUST carry a StaffingModel value; only SponsorStaffed is enabled. The values OperatorDedicated and AffiliatedSponsor MUST exist in the schema but stay disabled, and enabling one MUST require a recorded owner decision and a release flag, without schema change.

release_scope: R1
text: Every account type in the account-type register MUST carry a CPA-approved AccountingTreatment of exactly one of {Contribution-WithoutDonorRestriction, Contribution-WithDonorRestriction, AgencyLiability, PassThroughLiability}. Receipts into an AgencyLiability or PassThroughLiability account MUST post to a liability (funds held for others) and MUST NOT increase contribution revenue, DAF counts or Schedule D Part I aggregates; payouts from such accounts MUST reduce the liability and MUST NOT be recorded as grant expense. An account type without an approved AccountingTreatment MUST NOT accept receipts. Default treatments are fixed by XID-INV-002: a donor-advised account type whose program version records variance power maps to Contribution-WithoutDonorRestriction; an account type where a nonprofit transfers assets naming itself beneficiary without granting variance power maps to AgencyLiability (designated/agency fund, not a DAF, per XID-CRM-004); Contribution-WithDonorRestriction applies only where a gift instrument imposes a time or purpose restriction beyond advisory privileges.

release_scope: R1
text: Each sponsor book MUST declare one GrantRecognitionPoint from {ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee (default), PaymentReleased}, effective-dated and CPA-approved; PaymentReleased MAY be declared only where payment is the first communication of the grant to the grantee. The platform MUST send the approval notice to the grantee automatically on sponsor approval, and the posting rule MUST recognize grant expense and grants payable for an unconditional grant only when the communication record (timestamp, channel, recipient) or, for PaymentReleased, the payment release ID exists. Sponsor approval without communication MUST NOT be recognized (an intention, not a promise to give). A grant whose terms contain both a barrier and a right of return or release, or whose terms are ambiguous, MUST be recorded as ConditionalGrant with no expense until a recorded BarrierMet or Waived event. At each period end, Unbound MUST produce a cutoff register listing grants approved but not communicated, communicated but not paid, and conditional, with their recognition status.

release_scope: R1
text: Posted journals MUST be persisted as authoritative records and MUST NOT be regenerated from source events. Unbound MUST run a scheduled re-derivation that recomputes, under each journal's recorded posting-rule version, the expected journals for a sample or full population of source events and compares them line by line to posted journals; any difference MUST open a reconciliation exception with both versions and MUST NOT modify the ledger. Re-derivation under a newer rule version MUST be reported only as an impact analysis feeding UNB-XIN-ACC-004.

release_scope: R1
