text: Every posting-rule version change and every correction of a posted error MUST carry an AccountingChangeRecord classified by an authorized controller as ChangeInPrinciple, ChangeInEstimate or ErrorCorrection, with materiality assessment and CPA approval reference. ChangeInPrinciple MUST produce a cumulative-effect adjustment to opening net assets of the earliest presented period and recast comparative reports as separately versioned 'as adjusted' reports while preserving 'as originally issued' reports; ChangeInEstimate MUST apply prospectively from its effective date with no adjustment to prior periods; ErrorCorrection MUST be booked either as a prior-period adjustment with restated comparatives or in the current period, as recorded in the classification. No classification MUST cause existing posted journals to be edited or re-posted.

release_scope: R1
text: Each fiscal year MUST have an AuditAdjustment period after period 12 that accepts only journals linked to an AuditFinding (auditor reference, proposer, controller decision). Each auditor-proposed adjustment MUST be recorded as Booked or Passed with amount and rationale; Passed items MUST appear in a summary-of-unadjusted-differences report. Audited financial statements MUST be generated from period 12 plus AuditAdjustment journals, and fund statements already issued from period 12 MUST NOT be reissued unless a Booked adjustment changes a fund balance above the sponsor's restatement threshold, in which case a correction notice per REQ-X-040 MUST be produced. The AuditAdjustment period remains soft-closed until the audited statements are issued; after issuance it is hard-closed and late items follow UNB-XIN-EVA-002 (XID-ADV-005).

release_scope: R1
text: For each sponsor and fiscal year Unbound MUST produce a DAF bridge that reconciles (a) Schedule D Part I line 4 aggregate value, (b) the sum of year-end fund statement values, and (c) the DAF component of net assets in the audited statements, and similarly line 2 contributions and line 3 grants to the statement of activities, using only typed reconciling items: InternalTransfersAmongFunds, GrantsApprovedUnpaid, AccruedFeesUnpaid, UnsettledTrades, AgencyOrPassThroughExcluded, ValuationBasisDifference, TimingOfLateItems, Other(requires note). Any unexplained residual MUST block sign-off of the package. Line 4 MUST use the same fair-value measurement as the audited statements; line 3 MUST include all distributions from DAFs including transfers to other funds of the organization, on the grant recognition basis of UNB-XIN-ACC-002 (XID-INV-005).

release_scope: R1
text: Every investment holding at each reporting date MUST carry a FairValueLevel in {Level1, Level2, Level3, NAVPracticalExpedient} with source and approver for Level3/NAV-PE; every financial asset MUST carry a LiquidityAvailability class (available within one year for general expenditure, DAF, agency, donor-restricted, board-designated, contractually restricted); and every investment expense MUST be recorded gross with a flag indicating whether GAAP presentation nets it within investment return, so that both the netted GAAP figure and the gross 990 figure are reproducible from the ledger.

release_scope: Deferred
text: At acceptance, every noncash asset MUST be classified UBTIExposure in {None, SCorpStock, PassThroughWithUBTI, DebtFinanced, Unknown}; SCorpStock acceptance MUST require a counsel-approved rule reference; for any exposure other than None, the donor's carryover basis and holding-period evidence MUST be recorded. Unbound MUST accrue estimated UBIT quarterly in the sponsor's books in the period the unrelated business taxable income is earned (ASC 740), MUST allocate the estimate to the fund(s) that held the income-producing asset in proportion to attributed UBTI, MUST reduce those funds' capacity by a recorded UBIT hold equal to the allocated estimate before any grant reservation, and MUST true up the accrual, allocation and hold when Form 990-T is filed.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Where Unbound's operator performs or hosts fund accounting, NAV or reconciliation for a sponsor it does not control, the operator MUST maintain a control catalog mapping each financial-reporting control to its requirement IDs and automated evidence, MUST obtain a SOC 1 Type II report covering ledger posting, NAV/unitization, reconciliation, change management and logical access before the first such sponsor's fiscal year end, and MUST publish to each sponsor a list of complementary user-entity controls derived from that sponsor's configuration.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each legal entity Unbound MUST record a BookOfRecord designation per function (GeneralLedger, FundAttribution, UnitRegister, InvestmentPositions, FundStatements) with value Authoritative, Shadow or NotUsed and the external system named for Shadow. In Shadow mode Unbound MUST NOT post to that function's authoritative records; it MUST ingest the external records, reconcile daily (or per the sponsor's frequency) and raise breaks. Changing a designation MUST require a cutover record with opening-balance tie-out.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every account type MUST be assigned exactly one ServicingClass (Standard or DigitalMinimal) by sponsor policy. Every requirement-driven recurring per-account obligation (attestations, recertifications, outreach letters, printed statements, manual reviews not triggered by a legal or risk rule, vendor-priced checks) MUST be registered in a RecurringObligation register stating trigger, frequency, unit cost estimate with grade, legal basis class (statutory/regulatory, fiduciary, contractual, sponsor policy, risk control, convention) and per-class applicability. For DigitalMinimal accounts, obligations whose legal basis class is convention or sponsor policy MUST be event-triggered (on change or on a risk signal) rather than calendar-recurring, MUST use electronic delivery where consent exists, and the configured sum of expected recurring obligation cost per account-year MUST NOT exceed the sponsor-approved budget; publishing a program configuration that exceeds the budget MUST be rejected with the offending obligations listed. Obligations with legal basis statutory/regulatory, fiduciary or risk control MUST apply identically to all servicing classes, and ServicingClass MUST NOT be an input to eligibility, sanctions, approval, grant priority or payment timing.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For a fund whose FundAttribution function is designated Shadow under UNB-XIN-ACC-010, grantable capacity MUST be computed as: the fund's available balance in the latest external snapshot accepted as complete under UNB-XIN-EVA-004 (with its as-of watermark) minus all Unbound reservations and released-unsettled grants committed after that watermark minus accrued-unposted fees reported by the external system. Reservations MUST be committed in Unbound's reservation table under the same locking rules as Authoritative funds. When the snapshot watermark is older than the sponsor-configured staleness limit (default 1 business day) the system MUST block capacity increases and new reservations above a sponsor-configured de minimis amount, while permitting protective actions. Each daily reconciliation break between the external balance and (prior snapshot - Unbound-originated settled outflows since) MUST open a reconciliation case and MUST freeze new reservations for the affected fund until resolved or accepted by the controller.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST maintain a versioned RailObligation register with one row per (rail, direction, sponsor role ∈ {Originator, ThirdPartySender, Payee, Merchant, Holder, BankCustomer}, obligation), each carrying source (statute, regulation, network rule, bank contract, sponsor policy), citation, effective date, binding class, linked control ID, owner and counsel status; the PAY-DEF-001 production gate for a rail MUST fail while any binding row for that rail and role lacks an implemented, tested control. Default roles (XID-BNK-005): the sponsor is Originator of record on sponsor-titled accounts under its own ODFI agreement; the platform operator is a Third-Party Service Provider, never a Third-Party Sender, and holds no funds.

release_scope: R1
text: For each sponsor that originates ACH entries (directly or via a Third-Party Sender), the system MUST maintain a documented FraudMonitoringProgram covering at least: destination-change after-the-fact review, first payment to a new destination, payment-amount anomaly versus the recipient's history, request-channel provenance for any bank-detail change, and debit-origination anomalies; each rule MUST have a version, owner, risk rationale and outcome metrics; the program MUST record a completed review at least every 12 months and block new ACH origination when the last review is older than 12 months plus a configured grace period.

release_scope: R1
text: Every business day the system MUST ingest bank activity for each sponsor disbursement, clearing and operating account linked to Unbound and match every debit to exactly one authorized platform instruction or to a configured expected-debit class (bank fee, sweep, return); any unmatched debit MUST open a high-severity incident within one hour of ingestion, notify two independent sponsor roles and place a protective hold on further releases from that account until an authorized human classifies it; ACH debit block or filter status for disbursement accounts MUST be recorded and attested quarterly. Grant disbursement accounts MUST carry an ACH debit block allowing only named bank-fee company IDs; processors MUST settle to a separate contribution clearing account where only the processor's company ID may debit (XID-BNK-008).

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST maintain a versioned RailEligibility matrix keyed by (payment class ∈ {Grant, SponsorToSponsorTransfer, ReturnOfUnacceptedProperty, ProcessorRefundOfDuplicate, VendorPayment, InternalFeeTransfer, InvestmentSettlement}, rail, direction) with fields Allowed, IrreversibilityClass {Reversible, RequestOnly, Irrevocable}, per-payment and daily limits, and extra controls; commands MUST reject any payment whose class/rail is not Allowed; Irrevocable or RequestOnly rails MUST require independent destination confirmation per UNB-RCN-GRT-017 for each payment above the configured threshold; instant rails (RTP/FedNow) MUST default to not Allowed for Grant until a sponsor decision enables them; InternalFeeTransfer MUST be a ledger journal with no external rail.

release_scope: R1
text: Every contribution, payment, return, dispute, reissue and payment exception event MUST emit a CostDriver fact {sponsor, payment class, rail, provider, external fee amount and source (actual invoice/report vs schedule vs illustrative), physical items (checks printed, postage, lockbox items), manual touch count and handling minutes, exception type} that the economics component consumes; CostDriver facts MUST NOT alter ledger balances and illustrative costs MUST be labelled as such.

release_scope: R1
text: A check MUST NOT move from Printed to Released-for-mail until the bank has acknowledged an issue file containing its number, amount, issue date and (where the bank supports it) payee name; positive-pay exception decisions MUST default to Return; a Pay decision on an exception MUST require an authorized human who did not issue the check and recorded evidence; voids MUST be transmitted and acknowledged before reissue (per GRT-005).

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST maintain a counsel-approved UnclaimedPropertyRule table per state {owner type (organization/individual), property type (vendor/grant/refund check), dormancy period, business-to-business or charitable exemption flag, due-diligence notice window and content, report and remittance dates}, MUST determine the state by the payee's last known address (with the sponsor's state of incorporation as fallback, per counsel), MUST send due-diligence outreach before StaleDated items become reportable, and MUST either produce report and remittance evidence or record the counsel-approved alternative disposition (e.g., exemption) for each item; an item with no applicable rule row MUST remain in UnclaimedPropertyReview and MUST NOT be re-credited to a fund. Outstanding uncashed grant checks MUST be presumed reportable property owed to the payee charity; before dormancy the system MUST make two outreach attempts including an offer to reissue by ACH; void-and-re-credit to the fund is permitted only if the grant was cancelled before cashing with notice to the charity and the state row records that cancellation defeats the holder obligation (XID-BNK-003).

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each processor payout batch MUST be reconciled three ways (individual contributions ↔ processor transaction report ↔ bank credit) on the business day after the bank credit; contributions MUST NOT move from Received to Settled until their batch reconciles; unreconciled batches older than a configured age MUST escalate.

release_scope: Deferred
text: The system MUST compute, for each disbursement account and each of the next N business days (rail calendar aware), projected opening balance, scheduled outflows by rail and settlement date, expected check clearing (outstanding checks with a configured clearing curve, labelled estimate), projected inflows (settled liquidation proceeds at T+1, reconciled contributions), and shortfall; a projected shortfall MUST alert treasury before the earliest affected release cut-off and MUST block releases that would overdraw the account unless an approved liquidity advance exists (UNB-RCN-FIN-008).

release_scope: R1
text: A reconsideration Case MUST: (a) be accepted only within a sponsor-configured filing window (default 90 days from decision notice) and at most once per decision unless new material evidence is supplied; (b) be decided by an authorized reviewer who neither made nor prepared the original decision and does not report to the person who did; (c) re-evaluate on current policy and all evidence including new submissions, without deference to the original outcome, while preserving the original decision record unchanged (SM-0); (d) have a decision-time target from its profile (default 30 calendar days) with notice of extension; (e) end in one of: upheld, reversed, modified, withdrawn; (f) where the original decision concerned shared charity vetting, be decided on the platform vetting record by the vetting authority and only then re-run sponsor grant gates, never altering a sponsor's discretionary decision without sponsor action.

release_scope: R1
text: Every decline, hold longer than its profile's notice threshold, or conditional approval communicated to a donor, advisor or charity MUST include: a reason code from a counsel-approved public reason catalog mapped from gate outcomes; a plain-language explanation; the public policy reference (clause ID); what evidence or action, if any, could change the outcome; the reconsideration path and deadline where available; and the decision date. Notices MUST NOT disclose sanctions match details, investigation existence, or other restricted reasons; such cases MUST use a neutral catalog code. The notice content and catalog version MUST be stored with the decision record. The public reason catalog version 1 is: ELIGIBILITY_NOT_CONFIRMED, ORGANIZATION_STATUS_CHANGED, PURPOSE_NOT_PERMITTED_BY_POLICY, IMPERMISSIBLE_BENEFIT, INFORMATION_NOT_RECEIVED, PAYMENT_DETAILS_UNVERIFIED, COMPLIANCE_REVIEW (all restricted reasons map here), FUND_BALANCE_INSUFFICIENT, DUPLICATE_REQUEST, SPONSOR_DISCRETION (XID-CLM-003).

release_scope: R1
text: Every request for information to a donor, advisor, charity or provider MUST be an InformationRequest with: requested facts (typed), reason, due date, reminder schedule, effect on the decision clock (pause until response or deadline), and disposition on expiry (close as incomplete with notice and reopen right, or proceed on available evidence, per profile). Before issuing, the system MUST check the evidence registry and MUST NOT request any fact already held with a freshness status of Fresh for that purpose; staff override requires a reason. Responses MUST be matched to the request and auto-resume the case.

release_scope: R1
text: Suspected fraud, related-party diversion, account takeover and sanctions potential-match matters MUST be handled in Cases with access class restricted-investigation. Such cases MUST be visible only to principals holding an investigation role for that sponsor; MUST be excluded from unified search, customer-facing timelines, standard staff timelines and AI assistant context for non-investigators; MUST NOT be disclosed by existence in any channel; and service staff MUST be given only a neutral status script. The investigator of a case MUST NOT make the resulting sponsor decision on the subject transaction. Holds arising from the investigation MUST be placed and released in the owning domain under its authority, not by closing the case.

release_scope: R1
text: Each month Unbound MUST draw a stratified random sample of closed grant approvals (straight-through and human), charity vetting determinations and gift acceptances, sized by a counsel/compliance-approved plan, for independent review by a qualified reviewer who did not make the decisions. Results MUST record error type and severity; any error MUST open a remediation case for the affected item and a learning signal (REQ-X-042). The error rate with confidence interval MUST be reported alongside the STP rate.

release_scope: R1
text: A representative (agent under power of attorney, guardian, conservator, family delegate) MUST act only within the scope recorded in the delegation (ADM-005). An authorized staff member who records specific facts supporting a reasonable belief that a representative is exploiting or endangering the donor MUST be able to place a ProtectiveSuspension that blocks new recommendations and contact/payee changes by that representative, notifies the sponsor's designated reviewer within 1 business day, expires after a counsel-set maximum unless renewed, and MUST NOT disclose the suspicion to the representative. Pending payments are governed by existing hold rules. Durations (XID-CLM-002): a ProtectiveSuspension expires after 15 business days unless an independent reviewer extends it once by up to 10 business days, after which it must be referred to counsel or the appropriate authority; no money moves during suspension; the principal is notified unless notice would endanger them.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Cases and notes MUST support access class privileged-legal, assignable only by counsel role. Privileged items MUST be excluded from ordinary exports, auditor evidence packs (unless counsel releases), AI context for non-counsel principals and customer disclosures, and MUST carry a privilege log entry (author, date, recipients, basis). Legal holds MUST bind subjects and thereby every case and note referencing them.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Unbound MUST model outsourced service staff as principals of type VendorStaff linked to a ServiceVendor and sponsor scope, with a permission profile limited to the vendor's contracted action set; every action MUST be attributable to the individual and vendor; QA and error metrics MUST be reportable per vendor; terminating a vendor or individual MUST revoke access within 1 hour; vendor staff MUST NOT hold approval authority for A3+ decisions.

release_scope: R1
text: Party identity MUST consist of a minimal core (internal PartyId, legal name, identifiers needed for screening, verification state). All other personal and financial attributes MUST be stored on a capacity-specific profile (contributor, advisory-privilege holder, professional advisor, charity contact, sponsor staff) with its own visibility rule. A user authorized for one capacity of a party MUST NOT see another capacity's profile or the existence of that capacity unless their role grants that capacity explicitly. Cross-capacity linkage MUST be available to deterministic screening (prohibited benefit, sanctions, conflicts) and to compliance staff only.

release_scope: R1
text: Onboarding of every advisory-privilege holder and annual attestation MUST capture declared affiliations (officer, director, employee, substantial contributor) with charities and other entities, as capacity edges with evidence and effective dates. When the contributor or advisory-privilege holder of a fund is itself a charity, the fund MUST carry a counsel-approved account-type classification (UNB-RCN-ENT-011) and grants to that charity or its affiliates MUST follow the classification's rule. Any recommendation whose recipient matches a declared or detected affiliation MUST be routed to TVCTL-14 review. A fund where a charity names itself beneficiary is classified designated/agency (UNB-XIN-ACC-001); if an organization-advised fund is a DAF, grants to the advising organization are permitted when it is a §170(b)(1)(A) organization other than a disqualified supporting organization, with the affiliation recorded (XID-CRM-004).

release_scope: R1
text: Each message type MUST declare a primary-purpose class (Commercial, TransactionalOrRelationship, MandatoryLegal, Security) and a sender legal entity with its entity type (tax-exempt nonprofit or other). Every Commercial email MUST carry the sender's valid physical postal address and a functioning opt-out that remains operable for at least 30 days after sending; an opt-out MUST be applied to all Commercial sends for that sender entity within 10 business days, and suppression lists MUST be keyed by sender entity. Automated or prerecorded voice or SMS messages that include an advertisement MUST NOT be sent without consent recorded at the level required for the sender's entity type (prior express written consent unless counsel records the nonprofit rule applies). Opt-outs MUST NOT suppress MandatoryLegal, Security or TransactionalOrRelationship messages. Decided defaults: promotional email about DAF services is Commercial; in white-label programs the sender is the entity named in the From line, contractually designated as the single sender (XID-CRM-001). Automated or prerecorded calls and texts sent by or on behalf of the tax-exempt sponsor require at least prior express consent; those sent on behalf of a for-profit partner or advertising a for-profit's services require prior express written consent (XID-REG-003; 47 CFR 64.1200).

release_scope: R1
text: Segment definitions used for communications, analytics shared outside compliance, or partner reporting MUST draw attributes only from a versioned allowlist. Attributes derived from grant recipients' religious, health, political/advocacy, sexual-orientation or similar categories MUST NOT be used unless the subject has given recorded opt-in consent for that purpose. Segment publication MUST be validated against the allowlist, and segment membership MUST NOT be exported to partners at person level without that consent.

release_scope: Deferred
text: A sponsor MAY assign each fund a servicing model (SelfService, AdvisorLed, DedicatedManager) and, for DedicatedManager, a primary and backup servicing owner. Work items for such funds MUST route to the primary owner, and to the backup when the primary is marked unavailable or the item exceeds 50% of its SLA without a touch. A servicing-owner assignment MUST NOT grant any data access or authority beyond the assignee's existing role grants; an assignment to a user lacking the needed role MUST be rejected.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each fund MUST record its referral attribution (referring party and capacity, channel, date) as an immutable informational fact. Unbound MUST NOT compute, accrue or export any referral compensation based on contributions, balances or grants unless a counsel-approved compensation rule for that referral arrangement and jurisdiction set is recorded; until then attribution MUST be usable only for reporting. Decided rule (XID-CRM-002): referral compensation MUST NEVER be paid from fund assets; flat fair-market-value fees from sponsor operating funds are permitted only under a written agreement, only to persons who are not advisors or related parties of the referred fund, only in states recorded as satisfying paid-solicitor rules, and never per grant or per dollar granted.

release_scope: R1
text: A professional-advisor relationship MUST be scoped to the pair (individual advisor, firm). When the firm or a verified HR/SCIM feed reports the advisor's departure, or the advisor reports a new firm, all grants under the old pair MUST end at the next authorization check, any advisor compensation accrual under the old pair MUST stop at the effective date, and the donor MUST be notified. Access by the advisor at a new firm, or by a replacement advisor at the old firm, MUST require a new grant consented by an advisory-privilege holder.

release_scope: R1
text: The platform SHALL maintain operational cost attribution as a management-accounting projection (CostAttribution read model) derived from GL actuals, vendor cost records and domain events. Cost attribution records SHALL NOT create, modify or reverse any journal entry, fund balance, NAV, reservation, fee accrual or available-to-grant amount. Any economic consequence that must reach the books (fee invoice, chargeback, functional expense allocation) SHALL be raised only through the existing authorised accounting command for that purpose (UNB-ACC-010 fee/billing, UNB-ACC-019 functional allocation) with its own approval. Management attribution and the GAAP/Form 990 functional expense allocation MUST use the same activity dataset with separately versioned mappings; only the functional mapping, approved annually by the controller and external CPA, may reach financial statements (XID-ECO-005).

release_scope: R1
text: The platform SHALL implement typed entities CostPool (GL account set + period + bearer + pool type in {Labour, Vendor, Infrastructure, AIInference, PaymentRail, CustodyBanking, Verification, FailureAndRecovery, Overhead}), CostDriver, Activity, ActivityEvent (domain event reference + activity + cost-object keys + touch minutes where captured), CostObject (kind in {Tenant, Sponsor, Account, Fund, Grant, Contribution, Case, CharityVerification, AIRun, Contact} with typed id), AttributionRule (versioned, effective-dated, approved), AttributedCost, UnallocatedResidual, ReconciliationRun and RevenueRecord, with the fields defined in the EOE report section "Cost attribution and profitability model". Every AttributedCost SHALL reference exactly one AttributionRule version, one CostPool and one CostObject.

release_scope: R1
text: Every AttributedCost and every derived unit-cost figure SHALL carry method in {DirectMetered, TimeDriven, DriverBased, ResidualPolicy}, confidence grade in {A, B, C, D, U} and a low/expected/high range. Defaults: A DirectMetered by event-linked invoice or meter (range +/-2%); B TimeDriven with measured unit times (sample >= 30 per activity in the last 90 days) (+/-15%); C DriverBased proxy (+/-35%); D ResidualPolicy (+/-60%); U unattributable (reported only in UnallocatedResidual). Derived figures SHALL take the worst component grade unless >= 80% of the value is from better grades, in which case the dominant grade is shown with a "mixed" flag. Ranges SHALL aggregate by linear sum unless independence is documented on the rule.

release_scope: R1
text: For each closed accounting period and sponsor scope, the platform SHALL execute a ReconciliationRun that compares the sum of AttributedCost plus UnallocatedResidual plus reported UnusedCapacity with GL operating expense actuals for mapped accounts, per CostPool. The run SHALL (a) require the identity sum(attributed)+residual+unused = GL actual for each pool to within $0.01, (b) record UnallocatedResidual explicitly by pool and reason (UnmappedGLAccount, MissingDriverData, NoEligibleCostObject, LateInvoice), (c) never distribute residual to cost objects except through a ResidualPolicy rule whose output is grade D and separately labelled, and (d) mark the run ExceedsTolerance when residual exceeds the configured tolerance (default 2% of pool or $5,000, whichever is greater), requiring controller sign-off before economics reports for that period are published as final. Tolerance is fixed by XID-ECO-003: per pool |residual| ≤ max(2% of the pool's GL actual, $5,000) and in aggregate residual ≤ 1% of in-scope GL operating expense; any residual with reason UnmappedGLAccount fails regardless of size until the account is mapped.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every external provider adapter that incurs cost SHALL emit VendorCostRecords in a FOCUS-aligned schema (BilledCost, EffectiveCost, ListCost, BillingCurrency, ChargeCategory, ChargePeriodStart/End, SubAccountId=sponsor/tenant where known, ConsumedQuantity/Unit, Tags including cost-object keys, x_Bearer in {Fund, Sponsor, Platform, Partner}, x_SourceInvoiceRef). Where a provider meters per request, the adapter SHALL attach the domain correlation id at call time so the cost is DirectMetered. Monthly invoices SHALL be ingested and reconciled to metered sums; differences go to residual.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each Labour CostPool the platform SHALL compute a capacity cost rate = pool cost / practical capacity minutes, where practical capacity = paid hours x configured practical-capacity factor (default 0.80) x 60. Each human Activity SHALL have a versioned time equation (base minutes + sum of driver increments, e.g. +12 international, +25 rework), with unit times sourced from touch-time samples or event-derived estimates and labelled with source. Attributed labour cost = time-equation minutes x capacity cost rate. Unused capacity cost = (practical capacity - used minutes) x rate SHALL be reported as a separate line per pool and SHALL NOT be loaded onto cost objects. Elapsed waiting time SHALL NOT be counted as touch time.

release_scope: R1
text: The metric registry SHALL contain versioned definitions (numerator, denominator, eligible population, inclusion/exclusion, time basis, grade rule) for at least: cost per account-month; cost per settled grant by rail; cost per settled contribution by type; cost per charity verification (new vs reuse); cost per resolved case (all touches until resolved); cost per contact; cost per manual exception by type; cost per human approval; cost per AI run and per model invocation; cost per automated workflow completion; custody/banking cost per $1m AUM; failure-and-recovery cost per 1,000 settled grants; operating cost in bps of AUM. Any cost-per-account figure SHALL be displayed with at least one transactional denominator and balance band.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For operations whose estimated cost exceeds a configured threshold (defaults: AI agent run > $2; international grant ED/ER review; wire or check where ACH is available to the recipient; complex-asset liquidation), the platform SHALL produce a CostQuote {operation, estimate low/expected/high, components, bearer, rate-card versions, validUntil} before execution. CostQuotes SHALL be advisory: they SHALL NOT block, skip or reorder any legally or policy-required control step, SHALL NOT change recipient payment method selection, and SHALL NOT alter sponsor decisions. Where a configured service charge will be charged to a fund, the donor-facing quote SHALL be shown before affirmation and the charge SHALL not exceed the quoted high value without new affirmation.

release_scope: R1
text: Every model invocation SHALL record {AIRunId, model id/version, input/output tokens, tool calls, EffectiveCost, latency, cost-object keys, purpose}. Each AIRun SHALL roll up to its Grant/Case/Contact. When an AIRun reaches its budget the run SHALL stop issuing model calls, persist its partial state, mark result Incomplete-BudgetExhausted (never Pass), and route the work item to the appropriate human queue with the partial evidence; deterministic controls SHALL continue unaffected. Cost per AI run SHALL be alerted when exceeding 3x its 30-day median for the purpose.

release_scope: Deferred
text: The platform SHALL mine domain events per workflow (grant, contribution, charity verification, case, statement) weekly and report per sponsor and platform-aggregate: variant count and top variants by frequency and attributed cost; rework rate (activity repeated on same object); wait share (elapsed minus touch time / elapsed); touches per outcome; handoffs per case; and conformance to the modelled workflow. Each step SHALL be tagged with its PRINCIPLES classification (statutory/regulatory, fiduciary, contractual, sponsor policy, risk control, convention, unnecessary); steps tagged statutory, fiduciary or risk control SHALL never be reported as "waste" or "rework" candidates, only as "control cost". Findings above configured cost impact SHALL be emitted as REQ-X-042 LearningSignals.

release_scope: Deferred
text: AI-generated cost improvement recommendations SHALL be created only as REQ-X-042 InterventionProposals containing: target activity/variant, evidence links to mined events and AttributedCost rows, expected saving range with grade, affected counter-metrics and projected direction, PRINCIPLES classification of every step proposed for removal, and an explicit "AI-generated, unverified" label. AI SHALL NOT change any policy, configuration, routing rule, fee, threshold, staffing or control; proposals touching Tier C areas SHALL route to independent governance.

release_scope: Deferred
text: The platform SHALL derive RevenueRecords only from posted revenue (fee revenue, service charges, contract/SaaS fees, revenue share, float income where policy assigns it to the sponsor) with cost-object and service-model keys, and SHALL compute contribution margins CM1 = revenue - grade A/B direct cost; CM2 = CM1 - driver-based cost (grade C); CM3 = CM2 - residual-policy allocated overhead (grade D), by sponsor, service model (the 10 sponsor models), balance band and product. Fund- or donor-level profitability SHALL be visible only to finance roles and SHALL NOT be an input to grant approval, charity verification, compliance routing, queue priority or service-level assignment.

release_scope: Rejected-recommended
text: The platform SHALL provide a ScenarioRun capability that takes a versioned parameter register (each parameter tagged Measured with ReconciliationRun reference, SourcedBenchmark, Assumption or Illustrative, with low/expected/high) and a candidate fee schedule or service model, and reports expected, one-at-a-time sensitivity, adverse/favourable corners, December surge case and a verdict in {robustly-superior, superior-at-expected, inferior-at-expected, robustly-inferior}. Scenario outputs SHALL be labelled Scenario and SHALL NOT activate fees, policies or staffing; activation SHALL go through REQ-X-045 policy lifecycle and sponsor approval.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Sponsors and the platform SHALL configure CostThresholds {metric, scope, level or trend rule, owner, minimum grade, effectiveDate, approver}. A breach SHALL create a work item for the owner with evidence. Thresholds SHALL only alert or open proposals; they SHALL NOT automatically throttle, defer, skip or downgrade any grant, contribution, verification, control or SLA. Level thresholds SHALL apply only to metrics of grade A or B; C/D metrics SHALL use trend rules.

release_scope: Deferred
text: The platform SHALL support CostImprovementInitiatives with states Proposed -> Baselined -> Approved -> InExperiment -> Verified|Refuted -> Ratcheted|RolledBack, each with owner (operations), independent verifier (FP&A, not the owner), baseline (metric, period, grade >= B, seasonality-matched comparison period), target, counter-metric floors (ECO-016) and stop conditions. Verification SHALL compare like-for-like periods (same month prior year or matched cohort) and require the saving low bound > 0. Ratchet: next-period target = max(structural floor, min(current target, verified actual x (1 + configured buffer, default 5%))) and only when all counter-metrics stayed within floors for two consecutive periods. Targets SHALL never be set below the configured structural floor (SoD/minimum staffing per UNB-ECO-003).

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each CostImprovementInitiative and each CostThreshold-driven proposal SHALL declare counter-metrics from a mandatory set with configured floors: (1) control effectiveness - detection coverage and seeded-control test pass rate (floor default 100% for P0 controls); (2) compliance - sanctions/eligibility false-negative incidents (floor 0 known), §4966 referral rate change within +/-20% unless explained; (3) SLA - p90 grant approval-to-settlement within contracted SLA; (4) accuracy - correction/reversal rate per 1,000; (5) donor friction - task abandonment and repeat contacts; (6) accessibility - failures in accessible-flow tests; (7) staff safety - backlog per eligible reviewer. A floor breach SHALL halt the experiment, block ratchet, notify Compliance and create a rollback review; reductions in detected incidents SHALL be accompanied by stable or increased detection coverage before being credited.

release_scope: R1
text: The platform SHALL produce a rolling 13-week and next-December capacity forecast per sponsor and skill pool: forecast arrivals by work type (daily), expected handle minutes from time equations, eligible-staff hours net of absences, and a discrete daily backlog simulation that reports projected backlog, days to clear, p90 aging and staff-hours needed to meet each configured SLA. Forecast inputs SHALL be labelled (measured history, sponsor giving plan, assumption) and forecast accuracy (MAPE by week) SHALL be tracked. Forecasts SHALL inform staffing decisions by humans only and SHALL NOT reduce review depth or auto-approve.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For every configured service charge (e.g. international ED/ER review, wire, stop-payment/reissue, complex-asset handling, expedited grant), the platform SHALL report monthly recovery ratio = posted charge revenue / attributed cost of the corresponding activity, with grade. A service charge to a DAF fund SHALL be permitted only when it is listed in the fee schedule disclosed before the request, the donor affirms it, and a recorded cost-basis memo supports it. Where the annual recovery ratio of a charge exceeds 1.10, the price SHALL be reduced at the next schedule version (XID-ECO-002). Waivers SHALL be recorded with reason and counted separately.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each automation (deterministic rule, AI agent, workflow change) the platform SHALL compute realised net benefit per period = baseline attributed cost - (post-change labour + AI/compute + vendor + oversight review + rework + failure-and-recovery cost + amortised build cost), using a frozen baseline and matched comparison period, with low/high bounds. An automation SHALL be reported as "saving verified" only when the low bound > 0 and counter-metrics met floors; otherwise "unverified" or "negative".

release_scope: Rejected-recommended
text: For each SLA tier offered to sponsors/partners the platform SHALL report incremental staffing cost to meet the tier at forecast December peak (from ECO-017) and service-credit exposure; for each sponsor/partner contract it SHALL report contract-level lifetime value = sum of projected CM2 over contract term discounted at a configured rate, labelled Scenario, with retention assumptions sourced. Donor-level LTV SHALL NOT be computed for or exposed to operational services.

release_scope: R1
text: Cost views SHALL be scoped: sponsor users see only their sponsor's attributed costs plus their share of shared-platform costs with the allocation method disclosed; cross-sponsor benchmarks SHALL require at least 5 contributing sponsors and suppress any cell where one sponsor exceeds 60% of the total; labour costs SHALL be shown at pool/team/activity level with minimum group size 5 and SHALL NOT be shown per named worker or used to rank individuals.

release_scope: R1
text: The platform SHALL provide the Operational Efficiency dashboards defined in report section "Operational efficiency dashboard requirements" (Economics Overview, Unit Cost Explorer, Attribution & Reconciliation, Capacity & Staffing, AI Spend, Process Efficiency, Improvement Loop, Profitability, Scenario, Thresholds) using pinned Forma widgets, with every cost figure showing grade, range, as-of, rule version and drill-down to AttributedCost rows and source events within the user's scope; and a Folio monthly Operating Economics pack issued only after the ReconciliationRun is within tolerance or signed off. Exports (CSV/XLSX and PDF) SHALL include grades, definitions and non-posting disclaimer.

release_scope: R1
text: The fee engine MUST compute every fund-level fee daily on the daily balance of the declared FeeBase, using actual/365 (actual/366 in leap years) unless the schedule version declares otherwise, and MUST post the computed fee once per assessment period declared in the schedule (monthly or quarterly), not daily. The computation MUST segment at each of: fund activation, schedule-version effective date, program transfer, successor split or merge, closure trigger and migration cutover; each segment uses the schedule version and fee base in effect for that segment. A minimum fee MUST be prorated by the same day count over the days the fund was billable. Grantable capacity MUST subtract fees computed but not yet posted. The assessed amount MUST NOT exceed the fund's available balance net of reservations and approved-unpaid grants at assessment; any shortfall MUST be recorded as a waived amount with reason MinimumShortfall and MUST NOT create a receivable from any donor or participant. Recomputing any assessed fee from stored inputs MUST reproduce it exactly. The daily computation MUST run in chunks so that no transaction locks more than 5,000 fund rows, and concurrent grant approvals MUST stay within their latency SLO while it runs (benchmark report 18: a single-transaction batch stalled approvals up to 347 ms at 100,000 funds and about 12 s at 1.42 million).

release_scope: R1
text: Every fee schedule MUST declare exactly one payer source from {FundAssets, DonorExternal, PartnerInvoice, SponsorAbsorbed}. FundAssets fees MUST post only as fund-level fee entries under an approved schedule. DonorExternal fees MUST be recorded outside every fund ledger as a payment for services, MUST NOT be accepted through the contribution workflow, MUST NOT appear on any contribution acknowledgment, and MUST NOT be offset against a fund balance. PartnerInvoice fees MUST create an accounts-receivable invoice to the partner legal entity. A fee schedule with a missing or ambiguous payer source MUST NOT activate. DonorExternal fees are payments for services, receipted as service fees and booked as program service revenue outside fund ledgers (XID-ERP-002).

release_scope: Deferred
text: Charges by the platform operator to a tenant sponsor (subscription, implementation, per-account, basis-point or usage fees) MUST be computed and invoiced in the operator's own billing system of record and MUST NOT be posted to any tenant sponsor ledger by the operator. The tenant ledger MAY record the sponsor's resulting expense only through the sponsor's operating-finance export. Any recovery of operator charges from fund assets MUST exist only as a sponsor-approved FundAssets fee schedule that cites the executed program-agreement clause and the donor-facing disclosure version.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST keep grant-recipient payment profiles separate from any operating-vendor payee data it receives or exports, and MUST NOT allow a grant payment instruction to reference a payee that is registered only as an operating vendor. When a grant recipient's EIN or verified bank account matches an operating vendor of the same sponsor, or a vendor of a party with privileges on the granting fund, the grant MUST be routed to the prohibited-benefit/related-party review queue before approval. Fund and restricted ledger segments MUST NOT be debited by any operating-expense journal; the only non-grant debits permitted are approved fee schedules and governed sponsor-to-sponsor transfers.

release_scope: R1
text: Each delegation-of-authority entry MUST declare decision type, monetary limit per item, cumulative limit, aggregation window, aggregation key (approver x counterparty, where counterparty is the recipient for grants and the fund for fee waivers), source board or officer resolution, and expiry. An approval MUST be rejected when the item exceeds the per-item limit or when the sum of the approver's approvals for the same aggregation key within the window, including the item, exceeds the cumulative limit; the item then escalates to the next authority level. A DoA entry whose holder is inactive in the workforce feed, or whose source resolution is superseded, MUST become invalid at the next authorization check.

release_scope: R1
text: Every work item and case MUST carry the tenant, program, servicing model and fund-balance band of its subject at creation, an effort category from a sponsor-independent catalog, and queue timestamps (created, first touched, each hand-off, resolved). Unbound MUST compute monthly, per program and balance band: completed outcomes, human touches, elapsed handling time, and AI-assistance invocations. These metrics MUST NOT be used as inputs to grant eligibility, grant priority or authority decisions.

release_scope: R1
text: The event catalog MUST classify every fee, billing and relationship event as AuthoritativeFinancial, AuthoritativeAuthority, or Informational. Only the fee engine may emit AuthoritativeFinancial fee events (FeeScheduleApproved, FeeAccrued, FeeAssessed, FeePosted, FeeWaived, FeeReversed, PartnerInvoiceIssued, PartnerPaymentApplied). Informational events (e.g. RelationshipOwnerAssigned, SegmentMembershipChanged, CampaignMessageSent, ReferralAttributed) MUST NOT change any ledger, authority or fee state, and consumers MUST NOT derive ledger state from them. An inbound integration message MUST NOT be accepted as an AuthoritativeFinancial event.

release_scope: R1
text: For each sponsor legal entity and for every function for which Unbound is designated book of record (UNB-XIN-ACC-010), fund balances, reservations, capacity inputs and every financial report figure MUST be computed only from the insert-only journal and reservation tables, less fees computed but not yet posted (XID-ERP-001). Every domain fact with a declared financial effect MUST carry the JournalBatchId (or ReservationId) committed in the same database transaction, and the system MUST NOT maintain any other log from which balances can be derived or treated as a source on replay; re-derivation under UNB-XIN-ACC-003 is a comparison whose output never posts. Posting rules MUST be applied once at posting time and MUST NOT be re-applied on replay. Where an external system is book of record (Shadow mode), capacity MUST be computed under UNB-XIN-ADV-002.

release_scope: R1
text: Every posting command MUST read the accounting period row for its posting date with a shared lock (or run SERIALIZABLE) in the posting transaction; HardClosePeriod MUST take an exclusive lock on that row. An ordinary posting whose posting date falls in a hard-closed period MUST be rejected with PERIOD_CLOSED, and the economic event MUST instead be recorded through a PriorPeriodAdjustment command that posts in the first open period, carries relates_to_period and effective_at of the original event, and requires controller approval above a sponsor-configured threshold. Routing is fixed by XID-EVA-002 and XID-ADV-005: before the audited statements for a year are issued, adjustments found in audit post in that year's AuditAdjustment period (UNB-XIN-ACC-005); after issuance, a late item posts as a PriorPeriodAdjustment classified Immaterial (current-period correction with disclosure) or Material (formal restatement of comparatives, originally issued statements preserved) against the sponsor's annual materiality setting agreed with the auditor; a hard-closed period MAY be reopened only before its statements are issued and only with controller and CFO approval. Donor fund statements already issued MUST show the correction as an explained adjustment on the next statement, and an amended statement MUST be issued whenever an acknowledgment or tax-relevant figure changes.

release_scope: R1
text: Every financial report, fund statement, regulatory data package and management financial dashboard figure MUST be computed from a FinancialSnapshotSealed identified by (sponsor legal entity, period or as-of instant, ledger commit watermark) and MUST record that identifier. Computing the same report twice with the same identifier MUST produce identical figures. Reports MUST NOT read event streams, outbox records or asynchronously maintained projections for financial figures.

release_scope: R1
text: For each external source (bank statement/return files, custodian position and transaction files, card/ACH processor reports, IRS exempt-organization extracts, sanctions list publications) the system MUST maintain an expected-delivery calendar and a per-source completeness watermark (last complete business date or source sequence). A batch MUST be accepted as complete only when its control totals (record count, amount sum, or source-declared trailer) match. When a source is behind its calendar by more than its sponsor-configured tolerance, the system MUST open a SourceFeedGapDetected case and MUST hold automated actions that depend on that source's freshness (capacity increases from that custodian, contribution availability, eligibility clearances) while still permitting protective actions.

release_scope: R1
text: Each external observation type MUST have a registered business idempotency key derived from source data (e.g., ACH return: original entry trace number + return reason code + return entry trace number; check: bank account + check number + item sequence; custodian transaction: custodian + account + transaction reference + version/cancel indicator; provider callback: provider event id). Ingestion MUST store the key and a payload hash. A record with an existing key and identical hash MUST be acknowledged without effect; a record with an existing key and a different hash MUST NOT be applied and MUST open a DuplicateKeyConflict case. Internal commands MUST use stable business keys (GrantId + installment, PaymentIntentId, ScheduleId + occurrence) rather than transport retry identifiers. Intermediary fees on partially returned wires and bank fees on returned payments MUST post as sponsor operating expense unless the fee schedule disclosed a pass-through to the fund before the grant was recommended (XID-EVA-003).

release_scope: R1
text: Every authoritative fact, derived event, case, AI observation, notification and external observation item MUST carry (a) correlation_root: the business root id (ContributionId, GrantId, FundId-lifecycle id, CorrectionCaseId, TransferProgramId) it belongs to, (b) causation_id: the id of the fact, observation or command that directly caused it, and (c) a business_keys set of typed ids (SponsorId, FundId, CharityId, PaymentIntentId, ContributionId) it touches. Where one root spawns another (a succession notice spawning holds on many grants), the child root MUST record parent_root. The system MUST answer 'all records with root R or descendants' from indexed data without text search.

release_scope: R1
text: Each long-running business workflow MUST be implemented as a process manager persisted as a versioned row in the owning module's schema with: current step, expected next facts, next_due_at timer, attempt counts, and the ids of commands it has issued. A process manager MUST advance only by consuming authoritative facts or timer expiry, MUST issue commands with stable idempotency keys so re-execution after a crash has no duplicate effect, and MUST NOT hold database locks across external calls or AI invocations. Timers MUST be polled from the database (no in-memory-only timers). A process manager with no progress past its step SLA MUST create a ProcessManagerStalled item in the human-resolution queue with its state and last facts; humans resolve it only through domain commands. Outbox and fact-stream consumers MUST NOT infer missing events from gaps in database sequence values, and MUST NOT advance a read cursor past a position whose writing transaction may still commit (use claim-and-mark delivery with row locks, or a commit-ordered position such as a transaction-snapshot horizon).

release_scope: Deferred
text: Domain events MUST be classified private (consumed only inside the monolith) or published (delivered to partners, widgets or webhooks). Published integration events MUST be a separately versioned contract derived from authoritative facts by an explicit mapping, MUST expose only partner-safe states (e.g., Submitted, Approved, Paid-settled, Returned; never provider-acknowledged or internal exception states) and MUST be supported for a declared compatibility window. Stored events MUST carry schema_version; readers MUST upcast known older versions and, on an unknown version, authoritative consumers MUST stop processing that stream and quarantine the record (no skip), while informational consumers MAY skip with an alert.

release_scope: Deferred
text: A bulk transfer of funds from one legal sponsor to another MUST run as a TransferProgram process manager that issues, per fund, an independent DAF_TRANSFER_OUT distribution in the source sponsor ledger and an independent inbound contribution in the destination sponsor ledger, each with its own authorization, idempotency key (TransferProgramId + FundId) and reconciliation. Source history MUST remain in the source sponsor's books; the destination MUST receive a signed, hashed predecessor-history package recorded as non-authoritative reference evidence, with a fund-identifier crosswalk. Before a fund's transfer posts, its in-flight items (reserved grants, Unknown payments, open returns, pending contributions) MUST be resolved or explicitly assigned by the program's approved rule; a fund with an Unknown payment MUST NOT transfer. Legal form (XID-EVA-005): each transfer is a grant to the receiving sponsoring organization under a master agreement recording each fund's advisory terms; the source keeps its records and the destination receives a reference copy, with donor notice before personal data transfer.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST model at least these distinct hold types with a declared set of blocked commands: ProtectiveHold(charity|recipient|destination) blocks release and dispatch to that subject; FundProtectiveFreeze blocks outflow commands from the fund (grants, transfers, and fee accrual only if sponsor policy says so) but MUST NOT block inbound contributions, dividends, valuation, statements or records access; SanctionsBlock moves affected funds to a blocked-property account and blocks unblocking without a licence/authorization record; RecordsLegalHold blocks only retention disposition and deletion. Each hold MUST record type, scope, authority, reason and release authority, and no hold type MAY be released by AI. During a dispute FundProtectiveFreeze (XID-EVA-004): fees continue to accrue; investments follow the standing policy but advisor-directed allocation changes are rejected; recurring and new grants are held; contributions may be accepted; nothing is distributed until the sponsor resolves the dispute.

release_scope: R1
text: A batch (recurring-grant run, payment file, statement run, fee run) MUST be a container of independent item commands and MUST NOT carry approval, release or dispatch authority itself. Each item MUST be committed in its own transaction with its own idempotency key and MUST record the HoldPublicationVersion it checked at release; the dispatcher MUST re-check each item immediately before transmitting it, including items already placed in an outbound file not yet transmitted. A hold published mid-run MUST stop all items not yet transmitted; the batch MUST end PartiallyCompleted with per-item outcomes.

release_scope: R1
text: Each advisor instruction MUST carry a conflict scope key (fund, instruction kind, and target: charity, schedule, investment allocation or transfer). On commit, the handler MUST, in the same transaction, check for open instructions with the same scope from a different principal that request an incompatible outcome; if found, both MUST move to HeldConflict and a case opened for the sponsor, unless the fund's versioned instruction-authority policy (any-one, all, designated primary) resolves it deterministically. A one-off instruction for a scheduled occurrence MUST take precedence over the standing instruction only for that occurrence when sponsor policy says so. Every consequential command MUST compare the fund's authority epoch at commit with the epoch at recommendation; if it advanced (revocation, death notice, successor activation), unapproved recommendations MUST be held, and approved-reserved grants MUST follow the sponsor's in-flight policy.

release_scope: Rejected-recommended
text: A message broker, separately deployed service or second authoritative store MUST NOT be introduced unless an ADR presents reproducible measurements on the selected managed PostgreSQL showing at least one of: (a) required peak authoritative commit rate exceeds 50% of benchmarked sustainable capacity of the largest sponsor database after indexing, partitioning and connection pooling; (b) p99 outbox dispatch lag exceeds 60 seconds for three consecutive peak days after tuning; (c) a contractual or regulatory clause requires an isolation profile that cannot be met inside the sponsor database (UNB-RCN-PLT-012). The benchmark MUST model the year-end peak of the largest expected sponsor using the documented volume method.

release_scope: R1
text: Relationship data MUST be classified as either (a) authority facts — advisory privilege grants and revocations, successor designations, contributor of record, anonymity and recognition elections, legal-representative evidence, consent records — owned by Identity & Delegation, stored append-only with effective/recorded times and checked synchronously by command handlers; or (b) engagement data — contact details, preferences, interests, interactions, segments, relationship-manager notes — owned by Donor & Sponsor Administration, stored as mutable rows with system-versioned history, eligible for privacy erasure/redaction, and NEVER read by a command handler to authorize or route money. Contact details used for mandatory notices MUST be read at send time with their version recorded.

release_scope: R1
text: Every notification derived from a fact MUST record the fact id and version it describes. Immediately before external send, the delivery worker MUST re-read the fact's current version and the recipient's anonymity/consent state; if the fact was superseded, reversed or returned, or the election changed so that the message would be false or disclosing, it MUST suppress the message (NotificationSuppressedAsSuperseded) and, for mandatory notices, enqueue the corrected notice instead.

release_scope: R1
text: Records of different authority classes MUST be stored in physically separate tables (or schemas) with distinct database privileges: journal and reservation tables (financial facts, balance CHECK constraints), per-module authoritative fact tables, ai_observation (AI principal INSERT only here), external_observation (raw ingested evidence), outbox and process-manager tables (operational coordination, mutable), and engagement tables (mutable with history). A generic event or JSON-document table MAY be used only for outbox/integration delivery, and MUST NOT be the source of truth for any authoritative fact.

release_scope: R1
text: Every counsel-approved rule version that encodes an authority with worked examples MUST ship with executable golden fixtures transcribing those examples (e.g. Rev. Proc. 2017-53 §7) and expected outcomes approved by counsel; publication MUST fail if any fixture fails. Every rule whose authority has an expiration date MUST carry it, and on expiry the rule MUST evaluate to CounselReview (never to its last Permitted outcome) and open a regulatory-watch item 90 days before expiry (sponsor-configurable).

release_scope: R1
text: Every principal MUST belong to exactly one realm: PlatformWorkforce, SponsorWorkforce (per tenant, federated or local), PartnerWorkforce (per partner, federated), Customer (donor, advisor, successor, charity user) or Workload (service and AI agent principals). Staff and administrative endpoints MUST reject Customer and PartnerWorkforce tokens. A human holding roles in two realms MUST have two principals, linked only by an audited RealmLink that confers no privilege. Customer principals created through partner federation MUST be offered enrolment of a sponsor-direct authenticator at first login. A Customer principal MUST be scoped to one tenant; the same person at two sponsors has two principals.

release_scope: R1
text: Platform-workforce access to a tenant's non-public data MUST be permitted only (a) under an OperatorAccessDelegation pre-approved by the sponsor for listed task classes, scopes and maximum duration, or (b) under a per-case approval by an authorized sponsor approver. Platform-workforce principals MUST NOT perform domain commands that are sponsor decisions (grant approval, payee change, authority change, fund closure) unless the sponsor delegation explicitly names that command class. Every operator access session MUST be recorded and visible to the tenant's administrators within 15 minutes in an access transparency view including who, when, scope, reason, case and records touched.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST maintain one StepUpPolicy matrix mapping action classes (authenticator/recovery change, authority or delegation change, payee or destination change, data export, grant recommendation above a sponsor threshold, API client/credential creation, sponsor policy publication) to required assurance (AAL2 with phishing-resistant authenticator, or AAL3 for platform and sponsor workforce privileged actions) and maximum authentication age (default 5 minutes). The step-up MUST be performed by a sponsor-controlled verifier, not delegated to a partner IdP, and the step-up event id MUST be bound to the command; a command without a fresh bound step-up MUST be rejected.

release_scope: R1
text: Access recertification MUST run at least quarterly for privileged and workforce roles and at least annually for delegated customer roles (advisors, authorized viewers, agents), covering Unbound roles and registered third-party authority registers (bank portal users, custodian trading authorities). A reviewer MUST NOT certify their own access. Access not certified within 14 days after the review due date MUST be suspended automatically, and suspension MUST be recorded and notified.

release_scope: R1
text: Break-glass access MUST use sealed credentials independent of the workforce IdP, require two-person activation, expire automatically within 4 hours, page the security owner and notify affected tenants' administrators within 1 hour. Break-glass sessions MUST be limited to read, protective actions (global/tenant payment freeze, hold, credential revocation) and infrastructure recovery; they MUST NOT perform domain transitions (grant approval, payee change, authority change, ledger posting) or remove holds. Any authoritative state change without a matching command event MUST block affected payments until reviewed.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every advisor-managed account MUST link to a sponsor-approved AdvisoryMandate recording client=sponsor, agreement version, fee schedule, billing frequency, advance/arrears convention and valuation basis. For each billing period Unbound MUST recompute the expected fee from the mandate and the sponsor's valuation snapshot and compare it with the custodian-reported debit; a debit with no active mandate, or exceeding the recomputed fee by more than the sponsor tolerance, MUST open an exception, place a hold on further advisor fee debits for that account where the custodian supports it, and be recoverable through a recorded refund request. Fee debits MUST post as investment-management expense of the fund, never as contribution reductions.

release_scope: R1-conditional
text: Every investment pool MUST record a counsel-approved LegalBasis (statutory exclusion or registration relied upon), the charitable organization that maintains it, its trustee/administrator and the sponsors whose assets it may hold. Unbound MUST reject subscriptions from a fund of a sponsor not listed, MUST reject creating a pool whose maintainer is not a charitable organization unless the LegalBasis cites a different counsel-approved basis, and MUST re-require approval when the maintainer or sponsor list changes. For release 1 only single-sponsor pools maintained by the sponsor itself under the charitable-organization exclusion are permitted; multi-sponsor pools and pools maintained by the operator MUST be rejected, and donors MUST receive the pool's written disclosure before first allocation (XID-INV-003).

release_scope: Deferred
text: For every directly held security (SMA, lot-owned or held gift), Unbound MUST record the voting and election authority (sponsor, named manager under mandate, or none) from sponsor policy. Each voluntary corporate action or proxy notice ingested MUST create an election task with the custodian deadline, the policy default, and the authorized decider; if no decision is recorded 1 business day before the deadline, the policy default MUST be submitted or the task escalated per policy. Donor or advisor input MUST be stored only as a recommendation and MUST NOT be submitted directly.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each litigation recovery or trailing income receipt MUST be attributed using the as-of position history for its eligibility period: for unitized pools, credited to the pool on receipt (current unitholders); for lot-owned positions, allocated pro rata to the funds that held the security during the class period; amounts attributable to closed funds MUST follow the OD-11 destination. The allocation MUST be reproducible from recorded position history and the receipt evidence.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each alternative holding valued from a manager statement with a statement date earlier than the reporting date, Unbound MUST compute the reported value as last statement NAV plus capital contributions minus distributions between statement date and reporting date, MUST record statement date and lag days, MUST mark the value Provisional when lag exceeds the sponsor maximum, and before close MUST require a recorded check for material events after the statement date (market index move threshold or manager notice). Provisional values MUST be haircut in grant capacity per policy.

release_scope: R1
text: Every cash-bearing account MUST declare its sweep vehicle, yield source and an IncomeAttribution rule (to funds pro rata by daily cash balance, to pool, or to sponsor operating) approved by the sponsor; daily the unattributed income MUST be zero. Unbound MUST report, per legal entity and bank, deposits exceeding the sponsor's insured-deposit threshold, and MUST record whether the sweep provider is affiliated with the sponsor or a partner for conflict disclosure.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Any in-scope crypto asset held at a reporting date MUST be measured at fair value from the sponsor-designated principal-market price at the sponsor's cutoff timestamp, with the change in fair value posted to the change in net assets, and MUST be presented as a separate line from other investments; NFTs and assets out of scope MUST be flagged for CPA treatment. Where sponsor policy is liquidate-on-receipt, Unbound MUST report every crypto position open longer than the policy window.

release_scope: R1
text: Every report, invoice, filing extract or API field that presents an assets figure MUST reference a named, versioned AssetMeasure definition (inclusion rules, valuation snapshot type, netting of payables/accruals, treatment of pending contributions, agency funds and NAV-embedded fees); unlabeled asset totals MUST NOT be published. At minimum the definitions FeeBase, ScheduleDValue, GAAPNetAssetsDAF, PartnerServicedAssets and PerformanceBase MUST exist.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For a foreign recipient without an IRS determination, the system MUST permit the routine (non-ER) path only when an EquivalencyDetermination record exists for the sponsor with: practitioner identity and type (attorney, CPA or enrolled agent) and attestation of Circular 230 standing; advice date; grantee taxable-year end; taxable year of the latest factual information relied on; public-support test period where used; law-version reference; and the advice document hash. The system MUST compute CurrentUntil deterministically per a counsel-approved rule encoding Rev. Proc. 2017-53 §3.03(1) (default: end of the grantee taxable year following the year of the factual information; for public-support advice, end of the second grantee taxable year after the five-year test period) and MUST treat the determination as expired on the earlier of CurrentUntil or a recorded law-change event affecting its basis. Approval and release MUST each re-check currency. Advice obtained by another grantor or through a repository MAY be relied on when it is current under §3.03(1), the practitioner or repository has authorized reliance by the sponsor in writing (reliance-letter reference recorded), and the sponsor has no contrary knowledge (XID-NPG-001).

release_scope: R1
text: When a recommendation names a foreign recipient for which the sponsor has no current EquivalencyDetermination and does not offer expenditure responsibility, the system MUST present the sponsor's configured IntermediaryCatalog entries (each a domestic §170(b)(1)(A) organization with recorded counsel-approved purpose wording) as alternatives, and MUST convert an accepted alternative into a domestic grant to the intermediary whose remittance purpose uses only the catalogue's approved wording (e.g. 'for the intermediary's program supporting <country/cause>'), never language requiring payment to the named foreign organization. The original foreign recommendation MUST be preserved as donor intent evidence. Wording MAY express a non-binding preference for the intermediary's work in a country or program and MUST NOT name a foreign grantee as a required recipient or require pass-through; the intermediary retains discretion and control (XID-NPG-002).

release_scope: R1
text: A grant naming a project hosted by a fiscal sponsor MUST record a FiscalSponsorshipEvidence item with: arrangement type (comprehensive/project-of-sponsor, pre-approved grant relationship, or other); evidence source (sponsor-published project list, signed attestation by the fiscal sponsor, or agreement copy); the fiscal sponsor's attestation that it has discretion and control over the funds; project legal form (internal project, unincorporated group, individual, for-profit entity). The payee MUST be the fiscal sponsor. Project legal form 'individual' or 'for-profit entity' MUST route to CounselReview. Evidence MUST be reusable for later grants to the same project until its sponsor-configured expiry or a change event.

release_scope: R1
text: Each grant MUST carry, at approval, the attributes needed for Form 990 Schedules I and F as mapped in a CPA-approved, form-year-versioned data dictionary: recipient legal name, address, EIN (or foreign identifier), IRC section, cash amount, noncash amount and description, purpose text, and for foreign grants the Schedule F region, manner of cash disbursement (wire, ACH, check, other) and route (ED, ER, government, other). The system MUST produce, per legal sponsor and tax year, recipient-level aggregates using the dictionary's threshold rules and a reconciliation from those aggregates to total grants in the locked ledger, with unexplained difference equal to zero.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST apply a counsel-approved, versioned OrganizationChangeEffect table to every open grant and active schedule when a change event is recorded for the recipient: NameChangeSameEIN -> continue, update remittance name, no hold; AddressChange -> continue, re-verify destination only if destination changed; EINChange or MergerIntoSuccessor or SuccessorDesignated -> hold, require sponsor approval of payee substitution with new eligibility evaluation of the successor and donor notification; Dissolution or BankruptcyFiled -> cancel unreleased grants and suspend schedules, route dispatched-unsettled payments to UNB-RCN-GRT-016; Revocation -> hold; ReinstatementRetroactive -> re-evaluate held grants, release only if the reinstatement effective date covers the grant date and all other checks pass. Every effect MUST be recorded with the event evidence and table version. A same-purpose eligible merger successor receives open and recurring grants after sponsor approval with donor notice (no reconfirmation); a change of purpose or recipient class, or an ineligible successor, cancels the grant and asks the donor to re-recommend (XID-NPG-005).

release_scope: R1
text: Every sponsor discretionary hold or decline not required by law MUST cite a criterion from a board-approved, versioned DiscretionaryGrantPolicy, record the evidence class (allegation, pending matter, adjudicated finding or regulator action per UNB-EXT-005), the approving authority, scope (recipient, purpose, period) and a review date no later than the policy's maximum, and MUST produce a donor-facing reason class from the policy's approved wording. On review date the hold MUST either be renewed by the same authority with new evidence or released automatically. The system MUST produce on demand a consistency report listing all discretionary holds by criterion, evidence class and duration.

release_scope: Deferred
text: The RecipientClass rule MUST include a class 'Section530AGeneralFundingContribution', disabled by default per sponsor, mapping to Permitted only when: a Treasury acceptance agreement reference identifying the sponsor as eligible donor is recorded; the qualified or approved class definition is recorded; the grant date falls within the rule's applicability window (taxable years beginning on or after 2026-01-01) and before its expiry (2029-09-30) or a successor rule; and the BenefitAndPurposeGate confirms the class is not defined by reference to the donor's or advisor's family. Absent any condition the class MUST map to CounselReview. Payments MUST go only to the Treasury-designated channel, never to an individual account holder. The class MUST remain disabled for every sponsor until the decision XID-NPG-003 is revisited.

release_scope: R1
text: When any rule, audit or human report identifies a completed payment as a possible taxable distribution (§4966), prohibited benefit (§4967) or excess benefit (§4958), the system MUST open an ExciseTaxIncident with: affected grants and amounts; suspected provision; parties (sponsor, fund managers who approved, donor/advisor, benefited person); knowledge evidence (approval records); recovery actions (repayment request, receivable); and a filing-inputs record for Form 4720 and, for §4958, Form 990 Schedule L Part I. Determinations of whether a violation occurred and who is liable MUST be made only by authorized counsel/CPA roles. The incident MUST block further grants to the same payee from the same fund until counsel disposition and MUST be reported to the sponsor's board-designated committee within a sponsor-configured period. Because §4966 and §4967 first-tier taxes are qualified first tier taxes abatable under §4962 on reasonable cause and timely correction, each incident MUST record reasonable_cause_evidence, correction_steps and correction_deadline, and MUST track filing of Form 4720 by each liable person (XID-NPG-007).

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every direct foreign grant MUST, before approval, hold a ForeignNexusDeclaration from the grantee covering: whether the grantee is a government body or instrumentality; whether any officer, director or key employee is a foreign government official or close relative; and whether grant funds will pass to any government official. Any affirmative answer or missing declaration MUST route to CounselReview. Foreign government grantees MUST NOT use the routine path until final regulations or counsel approve their classification.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Any grant whose recipient, destination country or payment chain falls within a sanctions program MUST be held unless a SanctionsAuthorization record exists citing a specific license number or a general license (program, section, version) with counsel's applicability determination and its conditions (e.g. recordkeeping, excluded parties). Release MUST verify the authorization is unexpired and its cited version is current; a list or license change MUST re-evaluate all unreleased grants relying on it. AI and non-compliance roles MUST NOT create authorizations.

release_scope: R1
text: For every check reaching AgedOutreach, the system MUST determine the reporting jurisdiction by a counsel-approved priority rule (default: state of the payee's last known address in the sponsor's records; if none or foreign, the sponsor's state of incorporation), look up that state's dormancy period, due-diligence-letter window, reporting deadline and any business-to-business or charitable exemption in a versioned UnclaimedPropertyRuleTable, and schedule the due-diligence letter and report accordingly. Where the table records an applicable exemption, the system MUST record the exemption citation and follow the counsel-approved alternative disposition. The priority rule is fixed by XID-BNK-003 (payee's last-known address state, else sponsor state of incorporation).

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each program, Unbound MUST generate from active configuration a versioned ProgramDescription (legal sponsor, administrator, distributor, minimums, fee schedule with FeeBase, investment options with expense ratios, grant minimums, policy summary, effective date) in human-readable and JSON form, republished automatically within 1 business day of any change to a source configuration.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every MigrationRun with a write freeze MUST publish a TransitionWindow at least 30 days before freeze start, listing frozen and permitted actions, start, maximum end, and how pending items are handled, to all affected donors, advisors and active grant recipients via their channels. The UI and APIs MUST return TRANSITION_WINDOW with the window reference for frozen actions. If the window exceeds its maximum end, affected parties MUST be notified within 1 business day with a new estimate. A TransitionWindow MUST NOT overlap the platform peak freeze period without sponsor approval.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Grant payments MUST flow from a sponsor-controlled account directly (or via a contracted payment-provider adapter acting as the sponsor's agent) to the verified charity destination. No distribution partner, embedding host, registered third-party app or advisor firm MUST appear as payee, intermediary account or settlement account for a grant or for a contribution after it is received by the sponsor.
