The payee graph of every payment instruction MUST be validated against this rule before release.

release_scope: R1
text: Every print/mail batch MUST carry a manifest of piece ids (check number or document artifact id) and the print vendor MUST return a disposition per piece (Printed, Spoiled, Reprinted-with-new-piece-id, Inserted, Mailed); the platform MUST reconcile the manifest within 1 business day and open a WorkItem for any unaccounted or duplicated piece, and a spoiled check number MUST be voided in positive pay before reissue. Where the vendor supports a serialized Intelligent Mail barcode, mail scan events MUST be stored as transit evidence only; they MUST NOT set a check or grant to Received or Settled. Returned or undeliverable mail MUST suspend further mailings to that address, flag the payee or party address as unverified, and route to address verification.

release_scope: R1
text: Before the first recurring debit from a consumer account (ACH or debit card), the system MUST capture an authorization signed or similarly authenticated by the consumer that states amount (or range), frequency, start date, debiting entity name and revocation method; MUST deliver a copy to the consumer and record delivery evidence; MUST send notice of any varying amount outside the authorized range at least 10 days before the debit; MUST honor revocation for all occurrences not yet sent to the ODFI; and MUST retain the authorization for at least 2 years after termination or longer per retention policy.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST validate a consumer account number with a configured commercially reasonable method (prenote, micro-entry, or third-party/API validation) before the first WEB debit to that account number and before the first debit after any change to it, MUST record the method, result and timestamp, and MUST NOT originate the WEB debit while the validation result is absent or failed.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For card contributions the system MUST model DisputeLifecycle {Inquiry, DisputeOpened(provisional debit), EvidenceDue(deadline), Represented, Won(re-credit), Lost(final), Accepted} linked to the original contribution; on DisputeOpened it MUST record a ReturnedContributionExposure per RR-REQ-X-009-r1, reduce capacity by the disputed amount, and open an acknowledgment-correction task if acknowledged; it MUST classify the event as InvoluntaryReversal (not a refund under UNB-RCN-FIN-013); a decision to represent MUST be made by an authorized human when amount ≥ the sponsor ContestThreshold, else follow the sponsor default (Accept or Represent); card contributions MUST remain Provisional for capacity purposes for the sponsor-configured card window.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Every public or embedded card contribution endpoint MUST enforce configurable velocity limits on authorization attempts per instrument fingerprint, device/session, IP range and receiving fund, MUST impose a sponsor-configured minimum card amount, MUST step up friction (challenge) after a configured number of declines, and MUST auto-suspend the card channel for a fund or host when declines exceed a configured rate within a window, notifying the sponsor; suspensions MUST lift only by authorized human action.

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST compute, per Originator identity, rolling 60-day unauthorized (R05, R07, R10, R11, R29, R51), administrative (R02, R03, R04) and overall debit return rates; MUST alert at configurable fractions of Nacha thresholds (0.5%, 3.0%, 15.0%) and suspend new debit origination for a channel exceeding a sponsor-configured hard limit; MUST permit reinitiation only for returns coded R01 or R09 (and R02/R03/R04 only after corrective action), with identical Company Name, Company ID and amount and 'RETRY PYMT' description, within the configured count and window; and MUST NOT reinitiate any unauthorized-coded return without a new authorization.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For every processor-settled contribution the system MUST record gross amount charged to the donor (including any donor-elected fee coverage), the processor fee actually assessed, and net settled, linked to the payout batch and bank credit; the contribution credited to the fund and stated on the acknowledgment MUST be determined by a CPA/counsel-approved FeeCoveragePolicy (default: gross charged is the contribution; processor fee posted as sponsor or fund expense per policy); and a payout batch MUST NOT reconcile unless Σgross − Σfees − Σreversals = net payout = bank credit. Default FeeCoveragePolicy (XID-BNK-002): the gross amount charged is the contribution and the acknowledged amount; the fund is credited gross and the processor fee posts as a separate fund expense line.

release_scope: R1
text: Securities gift intake MUST collect a GiftIntent (donor, fund, security identifier, quantity, delivering DTC participant number, expected date); incoming custody receipts MUST be matched deterministically on (security identifier, quantity, delivering participant, date window); exactly one match MUST auto-link; zero or multiple matches MUST place the position in Unidentified suspense with no fund credit or acknowledgment; partial quantity MUST link as PartiallyReceived; user-facing copy MUST NOT describe gifts as 'ACATS transfers'.

release_scope: R1
text: A LegalHold MUST list, at creation and on any scope change, every registered processor, distribution partner and deployment cell holding in-scope data, and MUST send each a preservation notice through the outbox with acknowledgment tracking; unacknowledged notices MUST escalate after 5 business days. Partner and processor offboarding, tenant migration and tenant exit MUST check active holds and MUST NOT complete deletion or destruction of in-scope data while a hold is active. Hold release MUST send release notices to the same parties.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST produce, on an authorized LegalProductionRequest scoped to one tenant, a production package containing the selected records and documents in original and rendered form, a manifest with SHA-256 per item, the query/scope used, the as-known-at time, redaction log with reason codes, and chain-of-custody entries for every access and transfer. Production MUST be read-only against authoritative stores and MUST NOT include another tenant's data.

release_scope: R1
text: Every deployment MUST record a FundsFlow declaration naming, for each account that holds contribution or grant money, the legal title holder and every party with instruction authority. Accounts holding charitable money MUST be titled to the legal sponsor (or a custodian for the sponsor); the platform operator MUST have instruction-only authority under the sponsor's delegation. A deployment whose FundsFlow shows the operator or an affiliate as title holder or receiving funds into its own account MUST NOT activate until operator counsel records a money-transmission/MSB analysis covering the states served. Changes to FundsFlow MUST re-trigger this gate. The operator MUST NOT take title to or possession of contribution or grant money in any deployment, and no embedded or white-label deployment that touches money MAY go live until a multistate money-transmission memo is recorded (XID-REG-001).

release_scope: R1
text: The system MUST maintain an OperatorStatusRegister mapping status-relevant features to the legal question they raise: (a) operator-provided investment model portfolios, recommendations or advice for compensation -> investment-adviser analysis; (b) any operator compensation tied to securities transactions or order routing -> broker-dealer analysis; (c) donation pages soliciting for multiple charities -> charitable-platform registration (e.g. Cal. Gov. Code §12599.9); (d) operator title or transmission of funds -> UNB-XIN-REG-001; (e) operator processing of consumer financial information as a for-profit -> GLBA/FTC Safeguards analysis including 16 CFR 314.4(j) notification. Activating a mapped feature for a deployment MUST require a recorded counsel determination for that question, deployment and jurisdiction set. Default dispositions (XID-REG-002): investment advice or model construction for compensation is disabled; compensation varying with securities transactions or custody is prohibited (operator fees are fixed); a feature whose status question is unmapped cannot be enabled.

release_scope: Rejected-recommended
text: Each notification event type MUST carry a counsel-approved legal classification: email class (commercial, transactional/relationship, other) and SMS/voice class (informational requiring prior express consent, telemarketing requiring written consent, not permitted). Commercial email MUST include sender identification and a working opt-out honoured within 10 business days; SMS consent and revocation (by reply keyword or any reasonable means recorded by staff) MUST be stored per number with timestamp and source and applied before the next send. A template whose content is classified commercial MUST NOT be sent under a transactional event type.

release_scope: R1-conditional
text: Unbound MUST maintain a versioned, effective-dated CapabilityEntitlement record per tenant and program that lists each optional capability as Entitled or NotEntitled with the contract reference. Authorization MUST deny a command that requires a NotEntitled capability with a stable error code. Removing an entitlement MUST NOT cancel, block or alter any command already accepted, any protective hold, statement, acknowledgment, retention obligation or regulatory output; those fiduciary capabilities MUST be marked NonRemovable in the catalog. Entitlements MAY be scoped by jurisdiction: D2C own-brand app and charity-side giving button capabilities MUST be NotEntitled for California users until a California opinion is recorded (XID-SAS-005).

release_scope: R1
text: Every feature flag MUST have an owner, creation date, expiry date no more than 90 days after creation (extension requires architecture approval), and a declared kind (ReleaseToggle or KillSwitch). A flag MUST NOT select different financial, legal, eligibility or approval semantics for different tenants; tenant variation MUST use policy or entitlements. The flag values in effect MUST be recorded with every authoritative command so replay reproduces the decision. A KillSwitch MAY only disable a capability toward a safe state (stop new commands) and MUST NOT bypass holds or approvals.

release_scope: R1
text: Each release MUST be deployed in declared rings (synthetic/sandbox cells, then a canary production cell, then remaining cells) with automatic halt when any health or invariant check (ledger balance, outbox backlog, Unknown-rate, error-budget burn) breaches its threshold. Schema changes MUST be expand-then-contract so that release N and N-1 can both run against the schema during rollout; destructive contract steps MUST ship no earlier than the release after all cells run N. A cell MUST NOT remain on a release older than N-1 for more than 14 days without an approved exception. Production deployments MUST be frozen during sponsor-declared close windows and a platform-declared peak window (default 15 Dec - 5 Jan) except for security and P0 fixes.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Unbound MUST maintain a Subscription registry: subscriber principal, tenant, program, event types, scope predicate, endpoint, signing key id, status (Active, Suspended, Terminated). Deliveries MUST be thin notifications (event id, type, resource reference, tenant-scoped sequence, occurred-at) and subscribers MUST fetch details through authorized APIs. Delivery MUST be at-least-once with exponential retry for at least 72 hours, a dead-letter state visible to the subscriber, and subscriber-initiated redelivery by event id within a 30-day window. Subscription status MUST follow the subscriber's registration and authority: termination or authority revocation MUST stop delivery at its effective time. Status events MUST use the canonical grant/payment status vocabulary and MUST NOT label a payment Settled before reconciliation.

release_scope: R1
text: Every authoritative event, outbox message, inbox record, audit record and telemetry span MUST carry an immutable envelope with TenantId, LegalSponsorId, ProgramId (where applicable), a tenant-scoped sequence number, CorrelationId and CausationId. CorrelationId and CausationId MUST be generated within the tenant and MUST NOT reference an event of another tenant; the only permitted cross-tenant references are declared inter-cell contract messages (global holds, shared charity facts, sponsor-to-sponsor transfers) which carry both tenants' references explicitly. Persisting an event without a TenantId MUST fail. Tenant migration MUST preserve event ids, tenant sequence and envelope values unchanged.

release_scope: Deferred
text: A third-party application MUST be registered before calling partner or public APIs, with publisher, purpose, requested scopes, data classes, redirect origins and certification status. An application MUST be enabled per sponsor by an authorized sponsor administrator for a subset of its requested scopes; donor- or advisor-level consent MAY further narrow but never widen the sponsor grant. Disabling at sponsor level MUST revoke all tokens for that sponsor within 5 minutes. Applications MUST NOT receive scopes that approve grants, move money or change payees (UNB-API-002).

release_scope: Deferred
text: A distribution-partner exit MUST be processed as a PartnerExit case with states Notified > DonorOutreach > ElectionsCollected > TransfersProposed > SponsorDecided > TransfersExecuted > Reconciled > Closed. Funds MUST move to another sponsor only as individual outbound transfer grants under RR-UNB-WF-014-r1, each with a recorded recommendation from an authorized advisor of that fund and a decision by sponsor A (which MAY be a sponsor-approved batch policy); no fund MUST change LegalSponsorId by data migration. Funds whose advisors do not recommend transfer MUST remain with sponsor A, with access through a sponsor-direct credential provisioned before the partner's federation ends, and with servicing reassigned to sponsor A or a successor partner. Partner access, subscriptions and API clients MUST terminate at the exit effective time while accepted recommendations continue under sponsor review. The case MUST reconcile: count and value of funds elected, transferred, declined and remaining, with zero unexplained difference. A sponsor-approved batch policy is the written exercise of sponsor A's discretion and MUST be applied per fund: each transfer has its own decision record citing the policy and its hold and sanctions checks; sponsor A MAY decline or condition individual transfers; a contractual pre-commitment that removes sponsor discretion MUST NOT be accepted (XID-SAS-002).

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST define SLIs and SLOs for at least: grant recommendation acceptance latency and availability, donor portal availability, partner API availability, statement availability by deadline, payment dispatch timeliness after release, and webhook delivery latency; each measured per tenant and in aggregate over rolling 28 days. Each SLO MUST have an error-budget policy: when a budget is exhausted, non-security feature releases to the affected cells MUST halt until the SLO recovers. Financial-integrity invariants (balanced journals, no duplicate payment, hold observance) MUST NOT be expressed as SLOs with budgets; any violation MUST be an incident. Contractual SLAs MUST be set no tighter than the corresponding internal SLO.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST emit an append-only UsageRecord per tenant and program for: authoritative storage bytes, document/object storage bytes, API calls by tier, background compute seconds, AI model calls with input/output tokens and model id, external provider calls by provider and billable unit, outbound messages by channel, and human work minutes on WorkItems. Shared infrastructure cost MUST be allocated monthly to tenants by declared allocation keys versioned per period. Monthly metered totals MUST reconcile to infrastructure and provider invoices within 5 percent or create a finance exception. Usage records MUST NOT be inputs to authorization or to fund-level fee accrual; fees remain governed by sponsor fee policy.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Each tenant MAY have Sandbox tenants that run the same release. A Sandbox tenant MUST contain only synthetic or explicitly de-identified data, MUST be bound to mock provider adapters only, and MUST be unable to resolve or authenticate to any production payment, custody, bank or email-to-real-recipient endpoint. Copying records from a production tenant to a Sandbox MUST be impossible through any API or operator tool. All Sandbox outputs (documents, emails, webhooks) MUST carry a visible TEST marker.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Unbound MUST publish to each tenant a current register of subprocessors that process that tenant's data (name, function, data classes, location) generated from the vendor inventory, and MUST notify tenant administrators at least 30 days before adding or replacing a subprocessor for that tenant's data, except emergency replacement which MUST be notified within 72 hours with reason.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST record every inbound or outbound human interaction as a Contact (channel, principal or 'unidentified', assurance level, reason code, linked subjects, outcome, linked case if any). A Contact MUST be promoted to a Case if and only if it (a) cannot be resolved within the interaction, (b) creates a Commitment, (c) is classified as a complaint, reconsideration request or dispute, or (d) reports suspected fraud or unauthorized activity. Financial transactions (contribution, grant, payment, journal) MUST remain in their own aggregates and MUST NOT be modelled as Cases; a Case MAY reference them. An operational Exception is a Case of kind exception created only by a rule under RR-REQ-X-048-r2. Each promotion MUST record the rule that caused it.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST implement one Case kernel shared by all case kinds, holding: case ID, kind, profile version, sponsor scope, subject references, owner, assignees, routing decisions, timeline, evidence references, commitments, links (parent/child/duplicate) and audit. Each case kind MUST declare a versioned CaseProfile specifying: allowed states and closure rule; clock policies (response, resolution, decision) with pause and stop events; access class (standard, restricted-investigation, privileged-legal); retention class and how legal holds on subjects bind the case; permitted outcome set; independence rule (who may not act); whether system auto-close is allowed; reopen window. Domain states (grant, payment, charity determination) MUST remain in their aggregates. A case kind MUST NOT be activated without a profile, and a profile change MUST NOT alter clocks or access of open cases without a recorded migration decision.

release_scope: R1-conditional
text: Unbound and its telephony adapter MUST NOT record, transcribe or machine-analyze any voice interaction unless (a) a sponsor-approved disclosure was played or read to every party before recording began and (b) consent was captured (continuation after disclosure only where counsel approves that as consent; otherwise explicit DTMF/verbal acceptance). The same disclosure MUST apply regardless of caller or staff location. A caller who declines MUST be served without recording or offered an equivalent channel. Recording MUST pause during DTMF entry of secrets. Each recording or transcript MUST store disclosure version, consent evidence, parties, start/stop times and retention class. Outbound staff calls to charities or custodians follow the same rule. Release-1 setting (XID-SVC-002): recording and machine transcription of voice interactions are disabled for every sponsor; enabling later requires explicit all-party consent captured at the start of each call and a transcription vendor contracted as a service provider with no training use.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST maintain a versioned ContactAssuranceMatrix mapping (channel x achieved assurance level x principal role) to permitted disclosure classes (public, account-summary, transaction-detail, personal-data) and permitted action classes (none, draft-only, change-pending-confirmation). Knowledge-based answers alone MUST NOT achieve more than the lowest assurance level and MUST NOT permit disclosure beyond public information or confirmation that a case exists for the caller's own reported reference. Account-summary or higher disclosure MUST require a possession factor bound to the principal's registered device or verified channel, or an authenticated portal session handoff. Staff tools MUST enforce the matrix and MUST record the assurance level on the Contact; staff MUST NOT be able to override it.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST classify as a complaint any Contact in which a party expresses dissatisfaction with the sponsor's or platform's service, decision, communication or conduct, regardless of channel or wording, and MUST open a Case of kind complaint. The complaint profile MUST define: acknowledgement within a sponsor-configured period (default 2 business days); substantive response target (default 15 business days) with extension notice; mandatory taxonomy code; flag regulator-originated (state AG, IRS, other) which routes to counsel and cannot be closed by service staff; closure requiring outcome, customer response sent, and root-cause code. Complaints MUST NOT be closed by AI. A complaint about a decision MUST offer the reconsideration path where one exists.

release_scope: R1
text: Any statement to a customer that a person or the system will do something by a time MUST be recorded as a Commitment (what, to whom, owner, due time, channel, linked Contact/Case). Commitments MUST appear on the customer timeline visible to staff, MUST alert the owner and backup before breach (configurable lead time), and on breach MUST notify the customer proactively with a new time. A Commitment MUST NOT promise a decision outcome or payment date that authoritative state does not support.

release_scope: R1
text: Unbound MUST maintain a sponsor-scoped, versioned Answer Corpus of approved clauses (ID, version, text, approver, effective dates, topics, locale). Any staff script, help page or AI answer that states policy MUST cite clause ID and version; any account-specific fact MUST cite the read-model field and as-of time. The system MUST store the cited versions with each delivered answer so it can be reconstructed. When a clause is superseded because it was wrong, the system MUST be able to list Contacts that received it.

release_scope: Deferred
text: For each sponsor or shared service pool offering live channels, Unbound operations MUST maintain a seasonal capacity plan computing required staff per interval from forecast arrivals, handle time and a declared service level using an Erlang-C (or abandonment-aware) model for real-time channels and backlog-clearance arithmetic for deferrable work. The plan MUST include a surge playbook activated by forecast thresholds: proactive year-end notices (gift-date rules, cut-off times), in-queue scheduled callback, shifting live chat to asynchronous messages, and temporary suspension of non-urgent outbound work. The platform MUST expose interval arrival, handle-time, abandonment and callback data needed to calibrate the model.

release_scope: R1
text: Transcripts and AI summaries of interactions MUST be labelled machine-generated, MUST be stored as notes linked to the Contact, and MUST NOT be accepted as input to any command that submits a grant recommendation, changes payee, contact or authority data, or approves anything. Such commands MUST require the principal's own authenticated affirmation (UNB-RCN-GRT-010) or, for staff-entered requests, verified-channel confirmation (UNB-RCN-ENT-016). A summary MUST NOT be promoted to case evidence until a human verifies it against the transcript or recording, and the verifier is recorded.

release_scope: R1
text: Every charitable beneficiary designation MUST be validated against eligibility at designation and re-validated at activation using current registry facts. If at activation a named beneficiary is ineligible, dissolved or unmatched, Unbound MUST apply, in order: (1) a sponsor-approved successor organization only where ONT-5 identity evidence links it; (2) the designation's contingent beneficiaries; (3) the sponsor policy default. Each step MUST be recorded with the evidence used, and no distribution may occur until the sponsor approves the resulting allocation.

release_scope: Deferred
text: Unbound MUST store donor legacy-intent statements as versioned, non-binding intent records linked to the fund and carried to successor funds. They MUST be displayed to successor advisory-privilege holders with a label stating they are non-binding, and MUST NOT be evaluated as restrictions or eligibility rules unless the sponsor separately accepts a restriction under the restriction hierarchy.

release_scope: Deferred
text: When an organization or trust holds a fund role, the role MUST attach to the organization's PartyId; individuals MUST exercise it only as authorized signatories evidenced by organizational documents with effective dates. A change of signatory or trustee MUST be processed as a signatory update, not as DAF succession. Dissolution, merger or termination of the holder entity MUST be a succession trigger handled under UNB-SUCC-006/007.

release_scope: R1
text: A legal representative MUST NOT exercise advisory privileges on behalf of a principal unless (a) the instrument's verified scope covers charitable recommendations or the principal's DAF advisory privileges and (b) sponsor policy permits representative exercise; otherwise the representative receives view-only access where policy allows. Restoration of a principal's authority after incapacity MUST require verified evidence of capacity and MUST end representative grants derived from the incapacity at the same effective time. A power of attorney qualifies only if it expressly grants authority to make gifts or charitable donations; guardians and conservators act only under a court order covering charitable gifts (XID-TRS-001).

release_scope: R1
text: A succession policy MUST declare a successor response window and a default action. After a verified trigger, if no designated successor accepts within the window following documented notice attempts, Unbound MUST propose the next contingent designation, then the charitable beneficiary or sponsor default, each as a sponsor decision.

release_scope: Deferred
text: A family-office or consolidated-reporting recipient MUST receive data for a fund only under a grant consented by an advisory-privilege holder of that fund, scoped to declared data classes, revocable, and delivered through the same export contract as UNB-RCN-ENT-013.

release_scope: R1
text: Every deadline-bearing obligation MUST be persisted as a DueObligation record in the tenant's authoritative store, in the same transaction as the state change that creates it, with subject, obligation type, due instant computed per TIME-1 calendar and time zone, policy version, and idempotency key. A single scheduler per cell MUST fire due obligations by submitting an ordinary domain command keyed by the idempotency key; firing MUST be idempotent and MUST re-check the subject's current state before acting. After a restore, obligations whose due time passed during the outage MUST fire once, in due order, after reconciliation gates (REQ-X-006) are satisfied. Obligation counts by state MUST be monitored and an overdue obligation older than its tolerance MUST create a WorkItem.

release_scope: R1
text: Each long-running process instance (grant, payment attempt, migration run, partner exit, disposition case, fund closure) MUST record the state-machine definition version at creation. A release that changes a definition MUST declare, per version pair, either compatible continuation or an explicit InstanceMigration that maps every non-terminal state; a release without such a declaration for a non-terminal state with live instances MUST fail CI. Instances MUST NOT be silently re-interpreted.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Grant approval SHALL reserve the approved amount atomically in the same transaction that records the approval, moving through Reserved, FundingPlanned and Funded. Each fund's investments at the external manager SHALL be backed by a sponsor-approved liquidity buffer (a cash allocation at the custodian) derived from a documented stress model (net outflow over the settlement horizon including the December peak). A fixed percentage MAY be used only while labelled as a placeholder and only until twelve months of the pool's own outflow data exist. A percentage grant SHALL be fixed in dollars at approval and SHALL change only through a new approval. The buffer's stress model SHALL include the manager's settlement times for liquidating investments to fund grants.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each fee schedule version SHALL declare basis (end-of-day market value default; average daily, period-end or quarter-average options), day count, accrual and settlement cadence, minimum, payer source and treatment of reserved-but-uncommunicated grants. Fees SHALL be computed daily and posted per the schedule. Fees a sponsor charges its own funds SHALL be recorded as internal transfers (fund-level charge and operating-fund recovery) eliminated in entity statements; fees from external payers SHALL be recognized as revenue as the service period elapses. No closing-period minimum fee or proration SHALL be applied unless the schedule version states it.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every contribution SHALL record GiftCompletionDate (tax rule by instrument), AcceptanceDate (accounting recognition), AvailabilityDate (sponsor risk rule, explicitly not finality) and AcknowledgmentDate. A returned ACH debit or card chargeback SHALL reverse the contribution as never completed and SHALL void or amend the acknowledgment. Availability holds SHALL be labelled as risk policy; return and claim windows (consumer ACH unauthorized returns 60 days and warranty claims up to two years; business ACH returns 2 banking days and claims one year; card chargebacks per network, up to 540 days) SHALL drive exposure limits per donor across all reversible un-matured amounts. Per-donor exposure SHALL be the sum over return classes of amount times a treasurer-approved risk weight that decays with age (full weight inside the unauthorized-return window, small weight in the warranty tail). With no donor ACH debit origination in release 1, the per-donor exposure cap applies to reversible contributions received through the sponsor's processor. Unless the treasurer approves other weights, the weight SHALL be zero after the applicable return window and the warranty-claim tail SHALL be covered by the sponsor's loss provision instead.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Reconciliation SHALL run continuously; exact matches SHALL auto-pass; a risk-stratified sample of auto-passed items SHALL be independently attested at a size set by the controller from an error-bound method (any numeric starting value labelled configurable and illustrative). Unexplained cash breaks SHALL block statements only for affected funds. Tolerances SHALL be absolute and relative per source, currency and asset class, calibrated from actual feeds; no silent write-offs. The controller SHALL sign off reconciliation completeness monthly. A new source SHALL start in ProvisionalCalibration: zero tolerance (exact match only), every non-exact item to the human queue and 100% review for at least one full close cycle of parallel run, after which the controller approves tolerances from the observed data. A break SHALL be attributed to funds through its unmatched items; an unattributable break SHALL open a controller decision, due within a sponsor-set number of business days, choosing between publishing affected statements marked 'provisional — reconciliation pending' and withholding them with notice, and statutory or contractual delivery deadlines SHALL prevail. The controller decision on an unattributable break SHALL be due within a sponsor-set number of business days not exceeding the next statement publication date.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: In-tolerance NAVs SHALL publish by deterministic policy only under a recorded investment-committee delegation that approves tolerances and pricing sources. Out-of-tolerance, stale, missing or manually overridden prices SHALL route to a human approver before publication; a risk-based independent sample SHALL be reviewed the next business day; unresolved breaks SHALL block affected publication; the delegation SHALL be reviewed at least annually. Without a delegation, every NAV SHALL require a human checker. Because investment management is delegated to an external manager (OD-M-07), values for each fund SHALL come from the manager's or custodian's positions and prices (or unit values the manager publishes) and SHALL be reconciled to the custodian; the deterministic-publication delegation in this clause applies only to fund-level valuations Unbound derives from those inputs, and a missing or stale manager price SHALL block the affected statement rather than be estimated.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Recognized grants payable and, by default, reserved grants SHALL rank ahead of fees. A fee shortfall SHALL be a fund-level memo claim against future capacity, not an entity-level asset; it MAY be waived by an authorized approver with a reason and SHALL be written off on fund closure.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each sponsor book SHALL declare an effective-dated GrantRecognitionPoint from {ApprovalCommunicatedToGrantee (platform default), SponsorApproval (permitted only with a documented sponsor accounting policy that approval creates the obligation and the sponsor reserves no free rescission right), PaymentReleased (only where payment is the first communication)}. Approval, communication, condition and rescission evidence SHALL always be captured, and a period-end cutoff register SHALL list approved-but-uncommunicated, communicated-but-unpaid and conditional grants. This supersedes the prohibition of SponsorApproval in UNB-XIN-ACC-002 AC-D2, which rested on Codification text not verified and conflicts with audited sponsor practice. 'Communicated' SHALL mean a notice made available to the grantee through a durable channel (portal posting or recorded delivery to the grantee's verified address) at a recorded timestamp; recognition SHALL use that timestamp, and approved-but-undelivered notices SHALL appear on the cutoff register.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each account type SHALL carry one AccountingTreatment determined from its transfer-instrument terms: contribution without donor restrictions (variance power granted, no redirect or refund right, no restriction beyond advisory privileges); contribution with donor restrictions (binding time or purpose restriction); liability (resource provider names itself or an affiliate as beneficiary regardless of variance power, retains a redirect, revocation or refund right, or controls the recipient); equity transaction (financially interrelated entities). Classification SHALL NOT follow marketing labels. Release 1 SHALL support only the standard donor-advised account type (contribution without donor restrictions, variance power granted); agency, organization-advised, pass-through and restricted account types SHALL be architecturally supported but disabled until enabled by a later decision (OD-P-FIN cut E).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Schedule D Part I SHALL be produced per tax year: line 2 contributions on the recognition basis; line 3 grants from DAFs on the grant-expense recognition basis plus transfers within the organization; line 4 year-end value on the books' basis net of DAF-attributed liabilities. Funds SHALL be classified DAF, similar fund or neither by the statutory definition and exceptions, not GAAP labels. The typed bridge of UNB-XIN-ACC-006 SHALL reconcile to the audited statements.

release_scope: deferred
text: Estimated UBIT SHALL accrue by default in the period earned with quarterly estimates aligned to Form 990-T installments, true-up on filing and allocation to generating funds where program terms allow; filing-basis GL recognition MAY be configured only under a documented immateriality policy; the fund-level capacity hold SHALL apply in both cases. Release 1 SHALL refuse, at acceptance, assets that generate unrelated business taxable income (S-corporation stock, pass-through interests with UBTI, debt-financed property); complex assets that a contracted intermediary sells on receipt remain accepted. The accrual rules above SHALL ship when such assets are enabled (OD-P-FIN cut D).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Effective date and posting period SHALL be stored separately; corrections SHALL post in the current open period with relates_to_period and correction class. A period 13 (AuditAdjustment) SHALL accept only AuditFinding-linked journals until statements are available to be issued (non-public NFPs) or issued (public entities). After issuance the CFO SHALL determine materiality with a recorded qualitative assessment; no numeric materiality default SHALL ship except as an illustrative, non-authoritative label. Functional expense allocation SHALL be a management policy approved annually by the CFO, reconciled to management activity-based costing from the same source facts.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each program SHALL record a role table: Originator (the sponsor), ODFI, Third-Party Service Providers (Unbound), any Third-Party Sender or grant-rail partner and the authorization holder. Unbound SHALL NOT sign an origination agreement, hold funds or execute or block a payment on its own authority; any configuration that would do so SHALL be rejected. Unbound SHALL accept TPSP obligations by contract, including Nacha risk-based fraud monitoring (Phase 2 effective 22 June 2026), security and audit cooperation. The grant rail SHALL be selected per program in the role table, with one PaymentInstruction contract shared by all rails and, for each rail, a named party that verifies destinations and handles returns. The release-1 default (OD-M-03) SHALL be a networked payment-partner rail where the sponsor has an executed partner agreement, and otherwise sponsor-originated ACH to a verified destination. Every program SHALL keep a check fallback and a stored verified-destination record so that grants to charities outside a partner network are paid without a partner enrolment.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every check account SHALL use positive pay with daily issue files including voids. NOC corrections SHALL apply within six banking days or before the next entry, whichever is later, under change control. Destination evidence SHALL exist before the first electronic payment and after any bank-detail change, and SHALL be either (a) a bank-originated account-owner match, or (b) a charity document AND an independent callback to a contact sourced from the charity registry or a prior verified record, never from the change request; a charity-signed letter alone SHALL NOT suffice. Every destination change SHALL notify the charity's previously verified channels, and the existing cooling-off period (UNB-RCN-WF-028) and independent callback (UNB-RCN-GRT-017) SHALL continue to apply. A bank-originated NOC matched on original trace, change code and COR trace SHALL count as destination evidence without cooling-off, notify the charity's verified channels and be logged under change control without a separate human approval; any charity-requested change triggered by an NOC follows the full rule. Checks SHALL void by default at 90 days (configurable, never later than the shortest applicable state window) with a recorded reason. Voiding SHALL NOT extinguish the grant obligation and SHALL NOT re-credit the fund automatically. Destination evidence combinations SHALL be exactly: (a) bank-originated account-owner match plus cooling-off plus notice on both the old and new verified channels; or (b) charity document plus registry-sourced callback plus cooling-off plus notice. The cooling-off period SHALL be the one in UNB-RCN-WF-028, which a sponsor may lengthen but never shorten below one business day. A callback contact SHALL come only from a record verified at least a sponsor-set period before the change request (30 days [policy default, owner: sponsor treasurer]) or an independent public source recorded with retrieval date; any contact or signatory change inside that period disqualifies the contact. Charity users who submit contact or bank-detail changes SHALL be authenticated at CAL3 or above (CNV-PLT-003). Destination evidence SHALL be scoped per sponsor; cross-sponsor reuse only under a written reliance policy.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: A VoidDisposition record SHALL determine Re-credit permitted, Hold as payable or Report from: grant cancellation status and grant-letter lapse terms, the priority state, a statute-derived state rule row (dormancy period, no-consideration rebuttal, timely-void rebuttal and window, business-to-business exemption scope, report date, citation, last-verified date) and the contemporaneous void reason. Unknown inputs SHALL default to Hold and report at dormancy. State rows SHALL be populated from statute text, beginning with the states where sponsors concentrate; business-to-business exemptions SHALL default to not applicable to grants.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Before the final aging tier an unknown payment SHALL have a bank trace or rail status request (ODFI trace, Fedwire IMAD/OMAD and beneficiary-bank confirmation, or paid-item file). Outcomes SHALL be classified Settled-and-accepted, Returned or Rejected, Not settled, or Unobtainable. Only Unobtainable after 30 days SHALL go to two independent approvers who record duplicate-risk acceptance and a recovery plan. No automatic retry SHALL occur; a check reissue SHALL require a confirmed stop or void first. Aging clocks SHALL use business calendars.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: ACH authorizations SHALL be retained for their active life plus two years after termination or revocation, and not deleted while warranty claims may arise. Reinitiation SHALL be limited to R01 and R09 returns, at most twice within 180 days of the original settlement, in a separate batch described 'RETRY PYMT' with the same company name, ID and amount; R08 entries SHALL be reinitiated only with new authorization. Returns SHALL match on original entry trace number + return reason code + return trace; NOCs on original trace + change code + COR trace; when addenda are missing, a fallback match (amount, effective date, company ID, account last four, individual ID) SHALL route to a queue, never auto-post. Release 1 SHALL NOT originate ACH debits from donors (OD-P-PAY cut A): contributions arrive by ACH credit, wire, check or securities transfer, or through the sponsor's existing payment processor; authorization retention and reinitiation rules apply only when donor ACH debit origination is enabled, while return and NOC matching apply to grant payments from release 1.

release_scope: deferred
text: When fee coverage is voluntary and the sponsor is merchant of record, the acknowledgment amount SHALL be the gross amount charged, the fund SHALL be credited gross and the processing fee SHALL post as an expense (to the fund only if the fee schedule discloses pass-through). Amounts paid to a non-charity (platform or mandatory convenience fees) SHALL be excluded from the acknowledgment and shown separately. Donor-paid service or membership fees SHALL be receipted as service fees with no deductibility statement; the preferred design is an additional contribution to the fund against which the disclosed fee is charged. These rules SHALL ship with card contributions (deferred, CNV-PAY-008) and are not part of release 1 (OD-P-PAY cut C).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Bank adapters SHALL support BAI2/BTRS, ISO 20022 camt.052/053/054 and bank APIs, with prior-day feeds mandatory and intraday optional; spendable capacity SHALL derive from internal reservations against the last verified balance, never from a feed balance alone, and new releases SHALL fail closed when feed staleness exceeds the approved window. Disbursement accounts SHALL carry debit blocks allowing only bank fees and explicitly approved rail partners that fund by ACH debit. Return and intermediary fees SHALL be borne by the sponsor by default, domestic wires sent with no-deduction instructions and international wires default OUR; any pass-through SHALL be disclosed. When the feed is stale, releases of grants already reserved MAY proceed on an AlternativeBalanceAttestation (bank portal balance captured and attested by two treasury staff, valid for one business day) capped at the attested collected balance less outstanding instructions; new reservations SHALL wait for a fresh feed. Release 1 SHALL ship one bank-feed adapter (a bank API or BAI2/BTRS) and one networked payment-partner adapter (Chariot first, then PayPal Grant Payments), adding further adapters on demand; staleness and debit-block rules are unchanged. The attestation window SHALL be approved by the treasurer and SHALL NOT exceed two business days; attesters SHALL be distinct from the releasing approvers; the bank-portal evidence SHALL be stored with the attestation.

release_scope: deferred
text: Card contribution acceptance SHALL be architecturally supported but disabled in release 1. When enabled for a sponsor it SHALL require an acquirer merchant agreement, a configurable per-gift cap and contest threshold, acknowledgment after settlement and correction on chargeback.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Deterministic grant, renewal and fund-acceptance policies SHALL produce recommendations (ApproveRecommended, AcceptRecommended) until a sponsor board or bylaw-authorized committee resolution is recorded that adopts the version-pinned policy, delegates final approval of conforming items to a named officer or committee and names who reviews exceptions. Only then MAY conforming items be approved by the policy under that delegate's authority. Each policy version SHALL record its §4966(d)(3) fund managers (officers, directors, trustees, the delegate and any employee with final authority). Without a delegation the operating model SHALL be individual accountable batch decisions on AI-prepared dossiers (SPD-CLR-004).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Release 1 SHALL support grants to domestic §170(b)(1)(A) public charities (including private operating foundations and §170(b)(1)(F) conduit foundations labelled 'legally excepted, unsupported in release 1' until enabled) and SHALL reject grants to natural persons. Governmental units for exclusively public purposes MAY be enabled by sponsor policy. Expenditure-responsibility grants, disqualified supporting organizations and direct foreign grants SHALL be architecturally supported but disabled. Rejection text SHALL say 'not supported by this sponsor or release', never 'prohibited by law', except for natural persons.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Status SHALL be checked at approval and at release against the latest published Tax Exempt Organization Search / Pub 78, EO BMF and auto-revocation releases, recording each source's posting date; retrieval within 24 hours of publication is an operational target, not a legal threshold. Grants SHALL be made to the listed legal name; group-exemption subordinates SHALL be flagged for additional verification. Deep review SHALL default to 180 days (sponsor may tighten) with refresh 30 days before expiry and event-triggered invalidation. Cross-sponsor evidence SHALL be reused only as input; any known adverse public fact SHALL be considered. Release-time checks MAY use cached verified evidence within the approved freshness window per source and SHALL fail safe when stale. Informational changes without eligibility, authority, payment or policy impact SHALL NOT block payment.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: The common charity registry SHALL propagate only holds derived from verified public facts (IRS revocation, Pub 78 removal, OFAC listing, published judgments) re-verified by the platform from the primary source with source and timestamp. Sponsor-private investigation content, suspicions and decisions SHALL NOT propagate. A neutral 'enhanced review recommended' flag MAY be shared only under a written inter-sponsor information-sharing agreement limited to sponsors with pending or recent grants to the charity and containing no factual allegations. Sponsor-originated corrections SHALL be re-verified before updating the registry.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Discretionary holds SHALL be permitted only under a board-approved DiscretionaryGrantPolicy listing criteria (adjudicated findings, regulator actions, official pending matters such as indictment, attorney-general or IRS action or a government investigation the sponsor is informed of; media allegations only with elevated approval and a shorter maximum). Each hold SHALL record reason, evidence, owner, review deadline (maximum 90 days, renewable once on new evidence), escalation and automatic release; legally mandatory holds SHALL be distinguished and SHALL NOT auto-release.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Donors, advisors, successors, grantees and payors SHALL be screened at onboarding, delta-screened automatically on list updates and screened before each grant release against the current list version. A confirmed match SHALL resolve to Block (a blocked person has an interest in property in the sponsor's possession or control), Reject (prohibited transaction, nothing blockable) or Proceed (licence or exemption), never automatically to Blocked. Block or reject actions SHALL produce 31 CFR 501.603/501.604 report data due within 10 business days and blocked property SHALL enter the annual report of property held on 30 June. A true recipient match before approval SHALL refuse the recommendation, open a compliance task due in 10 business days with report data prepared (default: file a precautionary report) and release the reservation only if donor, advisors and successors screen clear. Dispatch SHALL be fenced atomically at the irreversible step so a match found during release prevents transmission. Human false-positive dispositions SHALL be reusable within the deciding sponsor until a subject attribute changes, the list entry changes, a new entry matches, 12 months elapse or the officer's authority is revoked for cause; cross-sponsor reuse SHALL NOT apply to donors or advisors and SHALL apply to recipients only where the relying sponsor has adopted a written reliance policy. Donor-facing status SHALL use the neutral catalog and never show list names or scores. Every release screening SHALL record the list version and fetch time and SHALL fail closed when the list is older than a basis-tagged bound or the screening service is unavailable; list updates SHALL be distributed as versioned inter-cell messages covered by the dispatch fence; a potential match at release SHALL open a disposition task with a sponsor-set due date and escalation to the compliance officer and SHALL never auto-release.

release_scope: deferred
text: Reliance on OFAC general licences SHALL be versioned as {program, CFR section or GL number, Federal Register citation, eCFR as-of date, conditions} and re-verified unchanged at release; only targeted-program NGO licences of the December 2022 type SHALL be accepted by default, with comprehensive-embargo programs held for program-specific approval or a specific licence. Foreign-related grants (when enabled) SHALL apply risk-based FCPA diligence: grantee declaration on government ownership and official connections, sanctions and PEP screening, staged payments and use reporting for larger or higher-risk grants, and escalation on any affirmative answer.

release_scope: deferred
text: Outbound wording to an intermediary MAY name its program, country or cause and SHALL NOT name a specific foreign organization, even as a non-binding suggestion; the donor's original recommendation SHALL be retained only as internal evidence. The automatic (non-expenditure-responsibility) foreign path SHALL require current written advice received from a qualified tax practitioner (directly, or through a repository whose practitioner issues the advice or a reliance letter to the sponsor), no contrary knowledge and currency per §53.4945-5(a)(5); other advice SHALL go to sponsor review under the general good-faith standard. No agreement copy SHALL be required for a §170(b)(1)(A) fiscal sponsor that retains discretion and control, evidenced by a published project list or signed attestation; projects that are individuals, for-profits or foreign entities SHALL require agreement review. The proposed §4966 regulations SHALL be tracked as proposed (not effective) on the rule watch list.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: No compensation, referral payment or other payment SHALL be made from a fund to any donor, donor-advisor (including an advisor the donor designated with investment privileges), family member or 35% controlled entity of that fund. Grants SHALL be blocked to an advising charity from a fund that is a DAF; a fund whose sole beneficiary is the contributing charity SHALL be classified as a designated or agency fund, and reliance on the proposed definition for funds contributed and advised only by public charities SHALL be a recorded sponsor policy choice. Broad charitable classes defined by family SHALL be rejected and class grants SHALL remain disabled in release 1. Sponsor-engaged investment managers MAY be paid only under sponsor contracts with uniform program-wide fees and not designated by the donor for that fund.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Pledge handling SHALL be an explicit sponsor policy choice from {Prohibited, NonBindingOnly, NoticeConditions (IRS Notice 2017-73 §7)} with NonBindingOnly as the onboarding suggestion. Payee substitution to a merger successor SHALL require a verified legal successor passing eligibility on its own EIN in the same recipient class, sponsor approval and donor notice; recurring series SHALL carry a notice-and-opt-out window before the next disbursement and SHALL be reconfirmed when purpose, class or eligibility changes; one succession record MAY drive bulk notices. A taxable distribution or prohibited benefit SHALL open a remediation record (recovery to the sponsor, reasonable-cause evidence, Form 4720 inputs per schedule, optional Form 843 abatement request under §4962, which is discretionary).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Non-expenditure-responsibility grants SHALL route to enhanced (Tier 2) review when any of these is present: donor, advisor or family affiliation or benefit signals; Type I or II supporting organization; fiscally sponsored separate-entity project; intermediary with a stated program or country preference; equivalency-determination-based foreign recipient; governmental unit; grant large relative to recipient revenue; unusual restrictions; ambiguous or conflicting eligibility evidence. Thresholds SHALL be by risk and decision type, not amount alone; sponsor-specific amount thresholds MAY be configured. Decision quality SHALL be checked by a common risk-stratified, error-bound sampling policy with qualified independent reviewers, increasing after material errors or policy changes.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Declines SHALL use the sponsor-configurable neutral catalog: donor-facing text describes the policy outcome, never facts about a charity; sanctions, investigation and law-enforcement reasons map to COMPLIANCE_REVIEW; charity-facing communication is limited to status codes; free text is optional and drawn from approved phrases. Reconsideration SHALL default to a 60-day filing window and a 30-day response target, configurable with mandatory exceptions, decided by a reviewer independent of the original decision (contracted or board-appointed for single-reviewer sponsors); the original and reconsideration records SHALL both survive with outcomes {Upheld, Reversed, Modified, Withdrawn, Referred}. Charity corrections of shared facts and appeals of sponsor decisions SHALL be distinct paths.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Complex-asset gifts expected to credit a DAF SHALL use the agent model: the sponsor is donee of record (acknowledgment, Form 8283 Part V, Form 8282, §4943 holding) and the intermediary is the sponsor's contracted agent. The donee model SHALL be activated only where the intermediary agreement gives it discretion over proceeds and the donor is told the deduction is for a gift to the intermediary. Service charges to funds (including outsourced vendor fees netted from proceeds) SHALL be listed in the disclosed schedule, reasonable, meaning a recovery ratio at or below the review trigger supported by a cost study and never paid to the donor, advisor, family or 35% entities; a recovery ratio above 1.10 SHALL trigger review, never service denial; fund-borne charges SHALL be reported as bearer shifts, not savings.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: The platform SHALL NOT provide individualized tax advice. Donor-facing tax content SHALL be generated from verified authority with citations and effective dates: DAF contributions do not qualify for the §170(p) non-itemizer deduction; the 0.5% itemized floor from 2026; acknowledgments state the sponsor's exclusive legal control and whether goods or services were provided; grants from the fund are not deductible by the donor. Schedule F manner-of-disbursement values SHALL use the IRS wording versioned by form revision.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: The 50-state registration build SHALL be deferred, except that California Attorney General Registry status (and FTB status) SHALL be ingested as a recipient attribute and shown, with sponsor policy choosing hold or warn.

release_scope: commercial-availability
text: Evidence engineering SHALL operate from inception for SOC 1 (AT-C 320, ledger and ICFR objectives) and SOC 2 (2017 Trust Services Criteria, 2022 points of focus) readiness, with complementary user entity controls mapped. Before live reliance by a sponsor, either the sponsor's external auditor's written planned approach, or a recorded 'planned approach pending' with the sponsor CFO's written acceptance of the interim evidence pack, (rely on a SOC 1 type 2, test Unbound directly, or substantive testing) SHALL be recorded and SHALL set report scope and timing; no sponsor-count trigger and no stand-alone type 1 SHALL be required unless a contract requires it. A SOC 1 type 2 covering a full period SHALL be planned when any user auditor states an intent to rely on Unbound controls; planning one earlier for cost spreading across two or more user entities is a business-policy default owned by the Unbound CFO. Contracts SHALL include right-to-audit, an evidence pack and a named cost bearer (default: each party bears its own auditor and staff costs). Manual review procedures SHALL be replaced by continuous or generated evidence only after the auditor confirms reliance; generated reports SHALL carry information-produced-by-entity support (query definition, parameters, population counts, hash, run log). A 'planned approach pending' status SHALL expire after one sponsor audit cycle or 12 months, whichever is sooner [policy default, owner: sponsor CFO]; the interim evidence pack SHALL be generated at least monthly; expiry without a recorded approach SHALL suspend delegated automation for that sponsor.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Vendor assurance monitoring SHALL compute the gap between each relevant SOC report period end and each relying party's fiscal year-end or reliance date; a bridge letter SHALL be requested at a configurable gap (3-month default labelled practice, not standard) and a stale-report alert raised at 12 months; bridge letters SHALL be recorded as management assertions that do not extend assurance; beyond the tolerance, compensating procedures or a time-limited risk acceptance SHALL be required; coverage gaps, opinion modifications, exceptions and unmapped CUECs SHALL be tracked separately.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Segregation of duties SHALL be enforced by the engine. The deterministic release gate SHALL count as the releaser only when it runs a published, independently approved policy version, the human approvers have no authoring, publishing, deployment or administration rights over it, ITGCs are effective, and the external auditor and board or audit committee have accepted the design; until then the three-distinct-person rule SHALL apply. Reconciliation SHALL be performed outside the payment chain (internal or outsourced, chosen by cost) with daily automated matching, exception review within a sponsor-set number of business days and at least monthly independent review. Enforced leave SHALL apply where at least two trained staff exist, anomaly analytics otherwise; the CISO SHALL have direct access to the audit and risk committee; independent review SHALL be required for key and manual controls; each alternative control SHALL be documented with expiry. A change to a gate module SHALL carry a materiality class; a material change SHALL require the sponsor's acceptance (with notice to its auditor) before activation for that sponsor, and until accepted that sponsor SHALL revert to the three-distinct-person rule.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Reserved (A3+) authority SHALL be exercisable only by persons appointed by sponsor board resolution as officers or authorized agents with scope by decision class and limit, start and expiry, independence and conflict attestations, D&O or indemnification confirmation and acknowledgment of §4958 and §4966 manager status; contracted and fractional individuals MAY be appointed. Unbound vendor staff SHALL NOT hold A3+ authority. No person SHALL hold reserved authority for more than one sponsor (SPD-ADV-001); team transfers SHALL revoke old access before granting new access. Coverage SHALL be stated as roster coverage by role and day, derived from criticality, peak workload and independence, with double absence tested as a December stress scenario. While SPD-ADV-001 stands, reserved-authority holders, independent reconsideration reviewers and pre-contracted December surge reviewers SHALL each be exclusive to one sponsor; the owner decided (OD-M-01) to keep the absolute rule for release 1 and to revisit it only with evidence from an administrator deployment. The one-sponsor rule SHALL be enforced by a privacy-preserving person token in the shared store, matched exactly, returning only 'already appointed elsewhere' to the appointing sponsor.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: On credible notice of an advisor's death the platform SHALL hold new actions by that person; on verification it SHALL suspend only that person's privileges; succession SHALL start only when no living, qualified advisor remains. Successor allocations SHALL create one new fund per successor by percentage (cents rounding, remainder per sponsor rule) with a successor-response window (default 90 days after documented notice, configurable 90–365) and at least three contact attempts through every verified channel; nonresponse SHALL route to the sponsor's configured default. Approved unpaid grants SHALL proceed unless sponsor policy says otherwise. An agent under a power of attorney MAY exercise advisory privileges only if program terms permit representatives, the instrument is acknowledged and verified and it expressly grants gift or charitable authority (or references the advisory privileges); conservators act only under a court order specifically authorizing the act; guardians of the person have no authority; otherwise the instrument SHALL be treated as evidence of incapacity. A presented power of attorney SHALL be answered within 7 business days (accept, request certification or refuse on a listed ground). Protective suspension of a representative SHALL rest on program terms: trigger is reasonable belief of exploitation; up to 15 business days, one 10-business-day extension after documented independent review, and up to 30 further business days only after a report to adult protective services, law enforcement, a regulator or a court; notice within 2 business days unless it would endanger the principal; expiry without escalation SHALL release or convert to a recorded sponsor decision. On death and succession only, installments already approved and reserved SHALL proceed; future occurrences of a recurring series whose only authorizing advisor has died SHALL be suspended from the date of credible notice until a successor confirms, unless program terms say otherwise. During a protective suspension, approved-but-unpaid grants authorised by the suspended representative SHALL be held until re-confirmed by the principal or decided by the sponsor, and expiry SHALL convert to a recorded sponsor decision, never release by default.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: During a fund dispute freeze fees SHALL accrue and be collected (waiver is a separate decision), investments SHALL follow the standing policy including scheduled rebalancing, advisor-directed allocation changes and grants SHALL be held, contributions accepted, and no distribution or transfer made until the sponsor resolves the dispute or a court orders otherwise. Sponsor-initiated bulk transfers and partner-exit transfers SHALL be executed fund by fund as separate sponsor-authorized grants under a written exit policy and master agreement, each with eligibility, sanctions and hold checks; the sponsor MAY decline or condition individual transfers; a Schedule N flag SHALL be raised when the series exceeds 25% of net assets and a state attorney-general notice check when substantially all assets move. Fees and deadlines SHALL be disclosed and SHALL NOT exceed the fully allocated cost of the transfer. The sponsor SHALL be records custodian; after exit the platform SHALL keep a read-only copy 90 days after the sponsor confirms the reconciled export, backups SHALL expire no later than 35 days after that, legal holds SHALL override, held funds SHALL NOT transfer and read-only access SHALL persist until holds lift, and an exit certificate SHALL list residuals. The exit certificate SHALL list each retention class with its end date and the sponsor's signed acceptance of custody, and the export manifest SHALL cover every class including ACH authorizations.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Unbound SHALL NOT receive or hold donor or grant money (no operator, FBO or pooled accounts), SHALL NOT be able to execute a payment, and SHALL NOT prevent one except through a protective hold executed under CNV-PLT-007 (a sponsor-adopted, time-bounded hold policy that the sponsor can always override through its own bank channel), and donor payments SHALL settle directly into sponsor-owned accounts through regulated processors; a funds-flow conformance check SHALL verify each deployment against these tests and SHALL block activation where they fail (licensing or a licensed partner would then be required). Unbound SHALL NOT provide operator-authored fund- or donor-specific recommendations on securities or allocations, construct models, select managers, route orders for others' accounts, take compensation varying with assets, trades or liquidations, or hold custody; relaying donor allocation recommendations among options made available by the sponsor's external investment manager, and factual, non-evaluative reporting, are permitted. No sponsor-maintained investment pools SHALL be offered (OD-M-07): each sponsor SHALL delegate investment management of fund assets to an external registered investment manager or custodian platform under a written agreement, and the sponsor board SHALL keep the duties to select the manager, set its scope and investment policy, and monitor performance and cost (prudent delegation under applicable state law, for example UPMIFA §5 where enacted; interpretation). Unbound SHALL ingest the manager's positions, transactions, units and valuations and reconcile them, and SHALL NOT select or recommend investments or managers. Sponsor-maintained pools (lawful under Investment Company Act §3(c)(10)(B) with §7(e) disclosure, including multi-sponsor pools) are not offered and would require a new owner decision; no per-donation compensation SHALL be paid to solicitors. Customer identification program rules SHALL NOT be assumed to apply; risk-based identity proofing and OFAC compliance SHALL apply. No AI feature or agent SHALL generate fund- or donor-specific securities or allocation recommendations, and AI explanations of sponsor-approved options SHALL be generated only from approved option metadata. 'Execute' means moving funds, or releasing an irreversible instruction, using credentials or authority that the sponsor has not delegated for that instruction; relaying a sponsor-authorised instruction under the sponsor's delegation is permitted and is not execution by Unbound.

release_scope: regulatory-authorization
text: Unbound SHALL register as a charitable fundraising platform with the California Attorney General's Registry of Charities and Fundraisers (Gov. Code §12599.9) and with the Hawaii Department of the Attorney General (HRS §467B-2.3, in force 1 July 2026, annual renewal by 1 July) before activating white-label, embedded, direct-to-consumer own-brand or charity-side donation features for California users, and SHALL meet the associated disclosure and recordkeeping duties. Sponsor-direct deployments where charity listings are visible only to advisory-privileged users on the sponsor's own branded platform MAY launch in California with records evidencing sponsor ownership and branding (interpretation, moderate confidence). Referral compensation SHALL remain disabled until each compensated referrer is registered where it solicits and the arrangement passes §4958 and Exchange Act §3(e)(2) review. Release 1 SHALL ship sponsor-branded deployments only, in which charity listings are visible to advisory-privileged users on the sponsor's own branded portal; white-label consumer marketplaces, embedded checkout, Unbound-branded donor apps and charity-side donation buttons SHALL be disabled until the registrations above are recorded (OD-P-LEG). The jurisdiction table (data/evidence-backlog/evb-state-registration.jsonl) SHALL be re-verified annually and on each new deployment model. Unbound SHALL NOT author solicitation appeals or provide fundraising advice to sponsors unless the fundraising-counsel registration requirements of each affected jurisdiction (about 25 have them) have first been determined from statute text and any registrations made; sponsor-authored content in sponsor-branded deployments is not affected.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every message template SHALL be classified commercial, transactional or relationship, or other (16 CFR 316.3) before activation, including email; promotional DAF email SHALL receive commercial controls with the sponsor as sender in white-label programs, and a single designated sender only where 316.2(m) is met; suppression SHALL be keyed to the sender and opt-outs honored within 10 business days across all platforms that send for that sender. Automated or prerecorded texts and calls SHALL require prior express written consent naming the sponsor (and any for-profit partner advertised); revocation SHALL follow the FCC rules effective 25 November 2026; residential prerecorded calls SHALL be limited to 3 per 30 days with a company-specific do-not-call list.

release_scope: deferred
text: Release 1 SHALL NOT record or machine-transcribe calls. When enabled, recording SHALL require an outset disclosure to every party, affirmative consent (keypad or verbal), a no-recording path, re-disclosure and consent for any party joining later (or pausing for that segment), transfer events with consent status, and a transcription vendor contracted as a service provider without training or independent use; the uniform strictest rule SHALL apply, with a jurisdiction table kept for review.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Donor and advisor identity proofing SHALL be risk-based: validate core attributes against authoritative sources, match the funding account owner and confirm a validated address or phone; step up to document and selfie or a non-biometric live-video alternative when validation fails or risk is elevated; entities SHALL be verified by registration and signatory authority. Knowledge-based verification SHALL NOT be used for proofing and SHALL never exceed contact assurance level CAL1. Platform and sponsor privileged roles SHALL use AAL3-grade authenticators (hardware keys or device-bound non-exportable keys; no synced passkeys) with two keys per user and identity-proofed recovery; other workforce SHALL use AAL2 phishing-resistant authenticators. Contact assurance SHALL use distinct levels CAL0–CAL3, with only CAL3 mapped to an achieved AAL. Verified prefill SHALL be marked as prefill, require confirmation, never overwrite verified data silently, and never substitute for identity proofing.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Transaction-level financial records (contributions, grants, rejected or declined sanctioned transactions) and related screening results, dispositions and licence reliance records SHALL be retained 10 years after the transaction date; records about blocked property while blocked plus 10 years after unblocking; other financial and grant records at least 7 years; sponsor organizing documents and determination letters permanently; ACH authorizations per CNV-PAY-005. Legal holds SHALL override disposition. The sponsor compliance owner SHALL approve the schedule.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Statements SHALL be generated for every configured period; the default notification SHALL be a quarterly digest plus correction alerts, monthly by opt-in, paper on request or absent electronic consent, and any cadence promised in program terms SHALL override defaults (no statutory periodic-statement duty was found). A complaint SHALL mean any expression of dissatisfaction, justified or not; acknowledgment within 2 business days, substantive response target 15 business days, outer limit 60 calendar days with a holding response; regulator-originated complaints SHALL route to the sponsor's legal function within 1 business day; contractual or legal deadlines SHALL override. A deterministic classification rule set with examples SHALL separate complaints from inquiries, automatic acknowledgment is allowed, and complaint incidence SHALL be measured in the CNV-EVB-001 time study before staffing.

release_scope: architectural-support
text: The authoritative ledger and fact tables SHALL live in one managed PostgreSQL database per sponsor tenant (candidate) with a transactional outbox and durable process-manager rows; workflows SHALL use in-database state machines with a timer table, and a durable-workflow engine or message broker SHALL be adopted only on measured complexity or reliability evidence. Before architecture acceptance, capability-specific RTO and RPO, SLOs, workload and cost envelope SHALL be declared and benchmarked on a realistic managed instance including failover and contention; acknowledged financial facts SHALL NOT be lost without explicitly approved recovery semantics. A second durable protective store SHALL be built only if declared protection objectives cannot otherwise be met; the hold registry SHALL sit in a separate schema and role, isolated by failure domain. Event payloads SHALL carry references to a PII vault, with controlled immutable evidence exceptions. One codebase SHALL serve all operating models; dedicated deployments only by isolation, resilience or contract need. Measurable SLOs SHALL be defined per capability and servicing tier before the benchmark; numeric contractual SLA commitments SHALL be made only after benchmark and pilot evidence. Recovery objectives SHALL be one versioned table keyed by data class and isolation profile: authoritative financial data SHALL have RPO 0 within region through synchronous standby; cross-region recovery SHALL declare a nonzero RPO under approved recovery semantics; consistency SHALL be per sponsor cell plus the hold-registry version recorded at each dispatch. Critical command paths (reservation, release, dispatch, hold publication) SHALL have reserved connection pools and worker capacity; batch, reporting, rendering and AI work SHALL read from replicas or snapshots under statement timeouts in separately scaled worker roles of the same build, and the benchmark SHALL run statement generation concurrently with peak dispatch. After any restore or regional failover, dispatch for the affected cell SHALL stay blocked until hold publications after the restore point are re-applied, in-flight instructions are reconciled with the rail, and the cell's ledger is reconciled to the last bank feed; the recovery semantics SHALL be approved by the sponsor before production.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: The tenant unit SHALL be the legal sponsor; partner and program isolation SHALL be threat-tested. Operator access to a tenant SHALL be denied by default; read diagnostics SHALL be scoped, expiring and pre-approved by the sponsor; writes SHALL require per-case approval; revocation SHALL take effect immediately and every access SHALL be evidenced. A minimal shared party core SHALL be partitioned by role and tenant.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Protected execution SHALL reference the immutable hold-publication version and SHALL check it atomically with authorization at the irreversible dispatch step (fencing token), with idempotency keys and reconciliation of in-flight payments; freshness checks alone SHALL NOT be relied on; unknown hold state SHALL fail closed. Because each sponsor has its own database, global hold publications SHALL be replicated into each sponsor database as inter-cell contract messages with a strictly increasing version; dispatch SHALL compare, in the same local transaction, the cell's applied version with a signed registry version beacon no older than an approved freshness bound, and SHALL fail closed for new dispatches when the bound is exceeded; a registry outage SHALL therefore stop only dispatches whose freshness bound has expired, never other tenants' reads or recommendations. The residual exposure window SHALL be declared as maximum beacon age plus p99 publication-to-applied lag, both basis-tagged [method: benchmark, CNV-ARC-001]; holds classified legally mandatory (sanctions, revocation, court order) SHALL additionally be confirmed by a synchronous registry check at the irreversible step, failing closed on timeout.
