A rail table SHALL give, for each rail, the irreversible step, the fence location and the post-hand-off response to a new hold (ACH recall or reversal request, partner cancel, stop payment, positive-pay void) with a deadline. This clause depends on acceptance of the database-per-sponsor architecture decision; if that decision changes, this clause SHALL be re-opened.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each sponsor SHALL have an explicit function map naming the book of record for each financial function (program ledger, fund attribution, entity GL, payables, budgeting, payroll, fixed assets). Unbound SHALL provide DAF program reporting, reconciliation, audit exports and DAF-specific payables and receivables; entity financial statements, generic AP, procurement, budgeting, HR, payroll and fixed assets SHALL be integrations with the sponsor ERP by default (configurable, not mandatory). One authoritative book SHALL exist per entity and accounting basis, internal or external; no duplicate authoritative books SHALL be forced. Where the GL or fund attribution is external (Shadow), grantable capacity SHALL be verified balances less commitments, fees and reservations, computed atomically, failing safe on stale data; external attribution SHALL be imported for comparison, and a shadow duplicate book SHALL be built only on demonstrated sponsor demand. The common double-entry journal component SHALL serve distinct entity books with separate permissions. Fee accruals and income attributions SHALL be computed daily, posted per approved policy, and unposted accruals subtracted from capacity. Vendor master data MAY be imported with provenance and validation. The binding full-accounting scope (AP, AR, purchasing, payroll interface, fixed assets) in FULL-ACCOUNTING-SYSTEM.md SHALL be read as 'available on demand, not release 1'; the owner approved this narrowing (OD-M-02).

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Custodian adapters SHALL preserve the raw feed and normalized identifiers including delivering participant and memo; unmatched deliveries SHALL queue. Advisor fee debits SHALL be recorded as distinct transactions where feeds expose them and raised as reconciliation exceptions where they do not. Bank-specific ODFI monitoring overlays SHALL be versioned above the mandatory baseline, and activation SHALL be blocked until documented.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Instruction authority SHALL come from the recorded fund agreement, never from marital status. Absent explicit any-one authority, all authorized parties SHALL approve or the ambiguity SHALL be resolved before execution; closure, succession and authority changes SHALL require joint approval; conflicting instructions SHALL be detected and capacity reserved atomically. Changing only the funding source of an unchanged grant SHALL require notice only when recipient, amount, purpose, timing, donor costs, investment exposure, restrictions and tax or accounting consequences are unchanged and the funding instruction is authorized; otherwise approval SHALL be obtained. Fixed and percentage-of-available-capacity grants (frozen at approval), the closing sweep and recurring fixed grants SHALL ship in release 1; cash-first funding SHALL be configurable. Electronic payment to a verified destination SHALL be the default (rail per CNV-PAY-001), with checks and authorized hand delivery supported; instant rails SHALL be deferred behind the rail adapter boundary.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Policy packs SHALL be versioned and effective-dated; material changes SHALL require affirmative sponsor adoption; emergency mandatory changes SHALL use a separately authorized path with impact analysis and independent retrospective review; tightening SHALL NOT be assumed safe. Material changes to financial controls, eligibility, permissions or customer rights SHALL require independent approval regardless of direction; ambiguous or mixed changes SHALL be treated as material; author self-approval SHALL be impossible. Rollout SHALL use representative shadow replay with volume, risk coverage and rollback readiness criteria (not elapsed time alone), and cross-sponsor shadow evaluation only with privacy controls. Liability for platform-maintained content SHALL follow a contractual responsibility matrix; attestation SHALL NOT transfer liability for platform error. Each activation element SHALL map to its decision IDs and evidence dependencies, and unresolved mandatory dependencies SHALL block activation. Sponsor onboarding SHALL use plain-language outcome-based questions with examples and progressive disclosure; wording SHALL be validated by moderated sponsor usability testing with a recorded task-success criterion set before the test. Workflow timing defaults SHALL be versioned candidates overridden by statutory and contractual deadlines.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every mandatory human step SHALL record its legal, fiduciary, independent-control, uncertainty-resolution or measured economic justification, accountable owner, evidence, review date and safe automation alternative; convention-only steps SHALL be reviewed annually and on material change, and missing or expired justification SHALL trigger review, never automatic bypass. Human queues SHALL be used only for genuine exceptions, reserved authority, unresolved evidence conflicts and mandatory independent controls. Financial integrity, tenant isolation, audit, mandatory compliance and accessibility SHALL be non-removable; other features SHALL be configurable. Every existing obligation SHALL carry a basis (law, contract, policy, convention) and review date. Cost budgets SHALL be diagnostic signals and SHALL never deny mandatory service or fiduciary obligations. Recurring obligations SHALL be inventoried for all servicing classes. Delegated customer roles SHALL expire on events with risk-based recertification. Affiliation attestation SHALL be event-driven with periodic confirmation; decisions affected by a stale mandatory attestation SHALL be blocked.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: One control register SHALL be authoritative, preserving mappings and evidence of the UNB-CTRL, UNB-SCTRL, CTL and TVCTL catalogs before duplicates are retired. Cumulative delegation-of-authority limits SHALL aggregate transactions that share a fund, a related-party group (donor household or 35% entities), the requesting principal, or a sponsor-operating payable counterparty, across approvers within a 30-day window (candidate), and detect splitting; recipient-level aggregation across unrelated funds SHALL be a detective analytic, not an approval gate. REQ-X-058..077 and landscape-wave outcome records SHALL be reclassified as a non-normative capability index only after carrier coverage is verified, preserving IDs. Research tasks and hypotheses SHALL move to the evidence backlog with owners, dependencies and dates. Golden fixtures SHALL be built first for authorities with the highest decision risk, after verifying current text. Clarity and EDF outputs SHALL be evaluation methods, not proof; material changes SHALL require independent evidence. Competitive claims SHALL carry dated evidence and bounded wording; absence of evidence is not proof of absence. Technology mandates SHALL remain subject to verified capability and licence (the Echelon stack is PolyForm Noncommercial; a commercial licence SHALL be in place before commercial launch). Conditor SHALL be mandatory before implementation; the requirements-only waiver SHALL end at the implementation gate.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Cases SHALL use a common kernel with code-defined typed profiles (F# discriminated unions for invariants) and sponsor-configurable routing, deadlines and parameters. Assignment modes SHALL be configurable by case kind (skill-based for exceptions, cradle-to-grave for succession, relationship or round robin for service, restricted routing for fraud) with backup and escalation. Clocks SHALL use business calendars per channel and case, track end-to-end elapsed time alongside internal SLA, pause only for documented reasons and never pause statutory deadlines; workflow targets SHALL be versioned by step, risk and dependency, distinguishing external wait from internal delay. Prioritisation SHALL treat hard legal deadlines and imminent irreversible harm as simultaneous constraints, escalate collisions and prevent starvation; no opaque weighted score SHALL be used initially. Staff interactions with charities and custodians SHALL be recorded as contacts with audience and access classification. Live phone, callback and asynchronous channels SHALL be supported and activated per sponsor and accessibility needs.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Staffing forecasts SHALL separate incident-driven demand from routine workload while including expected surge capacity; backlog thresholds SHALL be illustrative until calibrated by severity, age and workload in a pilot. A December readiness gate SHALL require a surge plan (pre-contracted, pre-appointed qualified reviewers with activation lead time set from forecast and deadlines, five working days candidate) before 1 December, and simulated peak SHALL meet each legal deadline (TEV-001). During a platform suspension, donors SHALL see read-only access only if confidentiality and integrity remain trustworthy, otherwise a status-only channel, with no unsafe processing promises. Practical capacity SHALL be measured by role including leave, training, controls and incident load; utilization SHALL NOT be treated as productivity.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Unbound SHALL meter causal cost drivers (events, storage, compute, AI inference) and maintain non-posting cost attribution reconciled to invoices with absolute and relative residual tolerances per source; AUM-based allocation SHALL be used only when justified; showback SHALL be transparent and chargeback activated only for executed contracts, without double allocation. Finance SHALL own the attribution model and savings SHALL be verified independently; moving a cost to another bearer SHALL be reported as a transfer, not a saving. Cost ingestion SHALL map to FOCUS 1.4 as the internal target with version-aware adapters for providers on 1.2 and 1.3, preserving native invoice provenance with extensions x_Bearer, x_SourceInvoiceRef and x_CostObject, without claiming full FOCUS conformance. Cross-sponsor benchmarks SHALL use experimental suppression thresholds (at least five sponsors, at most 60% dominance) labelled as not an anonymity guarantee, with differencing, longitudinal and collusion tests, including staff metrics. Economic ranges SHALL be labelled scenarios until pilot observations replace them. Release-1 economics SHALL include initial metrics, AI metering, a monthly economics pack and reconciled non-posting attribution. Cross-sponsor benchmarks SHALL require written sponsor opt-in in the master agreement and a SharedStoreRegister entry, compute dominance per cut, and exclude staff metrics until a privacy review is recorded.

release_scope: commercial-availability
text: Donor-facing quotes SHALL be shown for charged operations; any amount above the donor's accepted maximum SHALL require consent or be absorbed by the sponsor; required accessibility accommodations SHALL carry no fee. Small-balance pricing (minimum fees, digital-minimal fees, employer sponsorship, disclosed cross-subsidy) SHALL be modelled and SHALL never deny mandatory service; minimum grant sizes SHALL be a sponsor policy, not a universal restriction. Employer-subsidized terms SHALL be advertised only after an enforceable funding commitment. High-volume low-balance books SHALL be architected for but activated only with a positive contribution margin at adverse licence scale and a mandatory service floor whose metric and minimum are defined before any number is approved (TEV-010, TEV-011). Cost targets SHALL be expressed per operating model and servicing class as base, favourable and adverse ranges separating marginal, fully allocated and bearer costs; no single universal target SHALL be approved. Unbound licence prices SHALL derive from fully allocated and marginal cost scenarios with transparent tiers by servicing class and sponsor size only where cost supports them. Shared foundation costs SHALL be allocated to a community-foundation DAF program by documented driver (TEV-002). Household fee-tier aggregation SHALL be opt-in with privacy and consent.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every surface SHALL meet WCAG 2.2 AA with reflow; donor and advisor journeys and urgent approvals SHALL be mobile-first; complex accounting workbenches MAY be desktop-optimized. Phone navigation SHALL use a tab bar with inline actions (candidate) validated by moderated usability testing with assistive technology. The default unbranded theme SHALL be the Echelon brand manifest; sponsor overrides SHALL stay within verified contrast constraints. Forma SHALL be the preferred owner of reusable application-layer components; an Unbound adapter MAY remain indefinitely where the upstream service level is not met, with no duplicated design system, each adopted Echelon component pinned by release-manifest digest and covered by Unbound contract tests. Statements and acknowledgments SHALL be rendered from shared data snapshots to accessible HTML and PDF, tested for semantic determinism, accessibility and throughput; byte-identical re-rendering only where justified (Folio provides markup only; the PDF pipeline is Unbound-owned until an upstream renderer exists). Breaking changes to supported public APIs SHALL receive 18 months' notice with a version lifecycle and migration path, and documented emergency exceptions. Authoritative business facts SHALL be separated from engagement and coordination data with relevant audit history preserved. Published service levels and accessibility conformance SHALL be measured with a stated methodology before publication.

release_scope: architectural-support
text: The following SHALL be measured before their dependent values are treated as validated: exception incidence and handling time (90-day time study), December interval arrivals, custodian and bank feed content, bank return-file layouts, practical capacity by role, employer willingness to pay, and California registry data access. Until measured, dependent values SHALL be labelled scenario assumptions and SHALL NOT be presented as observations.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: AI agents and assistants MAY recommend and prepare; they SHALL NOT execute any action reserved to a human authority or exceed the recorded authority of the principal they act for, and the API SHALL reject execution without recorded authority. Every API operation, configuration field, user input and communication template SHALL publish machine-readable assistance documentation (purpose, expected values, constraints, examples, dependencies, validation rules, common mistakes, financial and regulatory implications, required authority and permitted agent level: recommend, prepare or execute). Repeated recommendations rejected for lack of authority SHALL be rate-limited, pattern-detected and reported to the agent owner, never auto-escalated to a decision (TEV-009). AI unavailability SHALL NOT stop deterministic paths. AI SHALL NOT produce individualized investment or tax advice. Release 1's agent-executable command set SHALL contain only reversible internal actions at authority A2 or below, enumerated in the authority matrix (CNV-GOV-010). Assistance metadata SHALL be generated from typed schemas and validation rules wherever possible; regulatory-implication text SHALL have an owner, version and effective date, be sampled for review each release, and be loaded only from the signed build.

release_scope: commercial-availability
text: No licence price list, customer cost-saving claim or segment commitment SHALL be approved until (a) a shadow replay of at least 12 months of a real sponsor's grant and contribution history and (b) a 90-day time study have measured exception incidence, handling minutes, determination-reuse share, complex-gift handling hours and contact rates. Economic comparisons SHALL use the same exception definition and source for every approach, state each lever separately with its evidence and activation gate, headline Monte Carlo P50 with the P10–P90 range, and use the no-lever Unbound case (C0) as base until levers are measured. The licence used in any comparison SHALL be computed at the platform scale reachable by named target sponsors within five years, never above the addressable market. Unbound SHALL maintain a vendor P&L (revenue ramp by segment, sales and implementation per sponsor, build and maintenance capex, compliance staff, assurance fees) and a configuration SHALL be called viable only if contribution margin is positive at P90 cost and adverse licence scale. Per-tenant costs SHALL be charged on each sponsor's actual fund count. Customer-facing claims SHALL attribute savings by lever (policy delegation, determination reuse, outsourcing, software). Platform scale for licence computation SHALL be the sum over the maintained target-sponsor list of funds × stage-gated adoption probability; any run needing more than a stated share of listed sponsors SHALL be labelled share-dependent with the share shown. Viability SHALL be tested on Unbound's fully loaded annual result (amortised build capex, sales, implementation, compliance staff, assurance fees) being non-negative at P90 cost and adverse scale, naming the party whose result is tested; contribution margin alone SHALL NOT establish viability. Price-list approval SHALL additionally require measured results showing C below both B and C0 at P50 for the sponsor size band being priced, from a replay covering that band, and SHALL be approved by the Unbound board. Each enterprise configuration SHALL name whose margin is tested (sponsor, administrator or Unbound) and SHALL be called viable only if that party's margin is non-negative at P90 cost and adverse licence scale. Volumes that depend on partner distribution SHALL be labelled scenario assumptions until willingness-to-distribute records exist from at least three partners. The vendor P&L SHALL include platform registration, annual reporting and compliance costs for each jurisdiction where Unbound must register.

release_scope: commercial-availability
text: The initial target segment SHALL be mid-size national and single-issue sponsors (about 5,000–50,000 funds) and advisor-distributed sponsors, subject to CNV-ECO-003. Community foundations SHALL NOT be the entry segment: at observed sizes (median 46, p75 128, p90 313 DAFs among 802 US community foundations, DAFRC FY2024) redesign adds nothing over licensed traditional software and their systems must cover non-DAF fund types (designated, field-of-interest, scholarship, agency, endowment spending) that are out of scope; serving them requires either a partnership with community-foundation software or a separately scoped requirement set. High-volume workplace giving and outsourced-administrator models SHALL remain architecturally supported but not offered until an executed employer or administrator funding commitment covers C cost at adverse licence scale. The advisor-distributed segment SHALL be offered on sponsor admin fees only; any advisor-sponsored structure requires a sponsor-engaged-manager program defined under CNV-GRT-009. A target sponsor list with incumbents and switching triggers SHALL be maintained; no sponsor SHALL exceed 25% of annual recurring revenue after year 3 without a board-approved concentration exception. The owner approved this segment choice (OD-M-05). The decision on Unbound- or partner-supplied staffed services (SPR-ADV-009) SHALL be reopened if fewer than five sponsors with under 10,000 funds have signed within 12 months of general availability (OD-M-04; the threshold of five is a business-policy default the owner confirms at the annual review). Superseded by OD-M-08: Unbound SHALL plan two offers on one small core against the same incumbent — software licensed to sponsors and administrators (iPhi-class) and an Unbound-operated administration team (Ren-class outsourced administration); the staffed offer SHALL keep SPD-ADV-001 (Unbound staff prepare and process; each sponsor's own appointed people make reserved decisions); capabilities beyond incumbent parity SHALL be limited to those that create the control, evidence and cost advantages in report 05 section 5. Release-1 account classes SHALL be enumerated, and every enterprise mix used in economics SHALL use only release-1 classes; advisor-managed funds are a release-1 class only where the sponsor operates a sponsor-engaged investment-manager program permitted by CNV-GRT-009 (uniform sponsor contract, no donor designation); otherwise E3 economics SHALL be labelled dependent on that program. The OD-M-04 reopening trigger SHALL be expressed against the target list as the signed share of listed sponsors under 10,000 funds, with a second trigger when lost deals cite the absence of staffed services; until the target list exists, the count of five is used [policy default, owner: product owner]. The economics pack SHALL disclose sponsor concentration for years 1–3, and a concentration exception record SHALL be required whenever one sponsor exceeds 25% of recurring revenue in any quarter after year 3.

release_scope: architectural-support
text: Sponsor economics SHALL be computed for a pre-delegation phase (no deterministic approval, three-distinct-person release, manual NAV checks) of parameterised duration before steady state, and onboarding plans SHALL schedule every activation gate (board delegations, auditor planned approach, ODFI and rail agreements, controller policies). The model SHALL include stress scenarios for final §4966 regulations as proposed, a 15% contribution decline, loss of the largest sponsor, licence renewal price pressure of 20% in downturn years, revenue concentration loss (top 5% of accounts) and December surge staffing costed to meet each sponsor's approved SLA floor. Each external dependency SHALL be in an integration register with counterparty, contract status, cost bearer, lead time and fallback; a sponsor activation plan SHALL NOT be marked ready while a mandatory dependency lacks an executed contract or fallback. A fixed control-time parameter per sponsor (board, controller, compliance, segregation of duties, roster coverage) SHALL be derived from a role-by-role inventory and reported separately.

release_scope: sponsor-activation
text: Where a board has delegated approval to a deterministic policy, the platform SHALL produce a quarterly board report of auto-approved, held, declined and human-reviewed grants with sampled human reviews, evidencing that the sponsor exercises variance power and exclusive legal control, and SHALL refuse to renew a delegation whose last report was not acknowledged by the board or committee. Clauses whose resolving questions are agent-recommended SHALL be shown as unratified in the baseline index and SHALL NOT be cited in customer-facing material until the owner ratifies them. A sponsor that does not adopt a mandatory policy-pack change within its deadline SHALL have the affected feature fail safe. Every delegation SHALL carry an expiry no later than 12 months after adoption [policy default, owner: sponsor board]; board-report samples SHALL be sized by the CNV-GRT-011 error-bound method. The baseline index SHALL show each clause's approval basis, and an approved-claims register keyed to clause ids SHALL be checked before any customer-facing publication.

release_scope: commercial-availability
text: No release-1 production dependency SHALL be under a non-commercial licence without an executed commercial licence plus escrow or a fork right; a software bill of materials licence check SHALL fail on PolyForm Noncommercial components lacking such a licence. Dependency versions SHALL be pinned to tagged releases with digests through Conditor.

release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Sponsor migration SHALL import each donor's full fund history (contributions, grants, acknowledgments, documents) from the predecessor platform with a reconciliation report, so switching sponsors' systems does not degrade the donor record. Charities already enrolled with a supported networked grant-payment partner SHALL be paid through that enrolment without a new Unbound enrolment. Lawful distribution-partner incentives (fixed-fee platform partnerships; referral payments only where registered and permitted) SHALL be defined before partner channels launch. A partner rail's enrolment SHALL satisfy CNV-PAY-002 only where the partner contract carries equivalent controls (owner verification, cooling-off at least as long as the sponsor's, notice to the charity's verified channels, and a destination-change event delivered to the sponsor before the next release); a rail lacking them SHALL be subject to CNV-PAY-002 in full.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: architectural-support
text: The evidence backlog SHALL include: at least three incumbent software price points (from Form 990 contractor disclosures, RFPs or sponsor interviews) to re-run the licensed-traditional comparator; sponsor sales-cycle length and implementation cost from at least three recent platform migrations; partner willingness-to-distribute from at least three wealth platforms; employer willingness to pay; the share of target-sponsor grantees already enrolled with networked rails; and a 50-state survey of platform, fundraising counsel and commercial co-venturer registration applicable to a white-label DAF platform built from statute and regulator sources.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Every platform-originated hold or freeze (security incident, break-glass, fail-closed safety gate) SHALL execute a hold policy the sponsor adopted in its master agreement, SHALL be time-bounded (expiring or converting to a sponsor decision within a sponsor-approved window, default one business day), SHALL notify the sponsor's designated officer immediately, SHALL NOT move, reverse or redirect funds, and SHALL leave the sponsor able to pay through its own bank channel. Fail-closed safety gates that stop Unbound from relaying an instruction are within this policy. Each hold SHALL be evidenced with actor, reason, scope and expiry. This clause SHALL apply only to discretionary platform safety holds. One HoldType register (extending UNB-XIN-EVA-010) SHALL state for each hold type who may place it, who may release it, maximum duration, expiry behaviour {convert-to-sponsor-decision-task, auto-release, never-auto-release} and whether it is a dispatch-fence input; legally mandatory holds (sanctions blocks, revocation, court orders), registry public-fact holds and integrity holds SHALL never auto-release and SHALL convert to a sponsor decision task, never expire silently. An OutOfBandPaymentRecorded command (sponsor-authorised, referencing the grant and the bank transaction) SHALL cancel the matching queued instruction, register the debit as expected and not trigger the unmatched-debit hold. Operator emergency access SHALL be a two-person break-glass class limited to hold publication, credential revocation and read, auto-expiring within the existing break-glass limit, notifying the sponsor immediately and visible in the sponsor's access view; every other write keeps per-case approval (CNV-ARC-002).

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Isolation profiles SHALL be selected per legal sponsor; partner and program isolation SHALL be enforced inside the sponsor cell by typed partitioning and negative tests, and a partner needing dedicated infrastructure SHALL be served by a dedicated sponsor cell or a separate legal sponsor. An Administrator principal type SHALL hold a per-sponsor ServiceDelegation (task classes, data classes, expiry) recorded in each sponsor's cell; a federated queue projection SHALL contain only routing metadata (case id, kind, priority, due time, sponsor id) and no donor PII; opening an item SHALL authenticate into that sponsor's cell under the delegation. A normative SharedStoreRegister SHALL list each cross-tenant store with permitted fields and classification, writers, readers and inference risks; donor and advisor PII SHALL NOT enter any shared store except as a keyed token for authorized checks. The shared party core SHALL hold only a keyed token, role class and sponsor id, never names or contact details. This clause depends on acceptance of the database-per-sponsor architecture decision.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: A single normative AuthorityMatrix SHALL map each command class × actor type {deterministic policy, AI agent, staff role, appointed officer, board} × authority level, replacing the coexisting tier vocabularies; 'Tier 2' SHALL mean only enhanced human review (CNV-GRT-011). Every API command SHALL declare its class; commands absent from the matrix SHALL be refused. The matrix SHALL define one level set, map recommend, prepare and execute to levels, classify routine board-delegated grant approval (CNV-GRT-001) as the level deterministic policy may hold under delegation, identify the reserved level that replaces 'A3+' wording elsewhere, and classify every external communication and payment-instruction preparation by actor type; CI SHALL fail when any clause or API contract uses a level outside the set.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Dossiers prepared for human or batch decisions SHALL render deterministic findings (eligibility, sanctions, holds, related-party, Tier-2 triggers) in a separate section built from sources and hashes that AI cannot edit or reorder; AI narrative SHALL be labelled, SHALL quote untrusted sources only as quoted data, and SHALL never alter a finding; batch approval SHALL be refused for items whose deterministic section shows an unresolved trigger.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Unbound SHALL keep a 'service-organization evidence' class (operator access, change, deployment and IPE run records) separate from tenant records, holding only minimum tenant identifiers, for at least the longest of the SOC period plus three years, the Nacha audit horizon or the contractual period; it SHALL be listed on the exit certificate and survive tenant deletion.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: architectural-support
text: Strata SHALL be used for declarative schema governance where its supported PostgreSQL versions match production. Authoritative append-only history SHALL be an Unbound-owned ledger component on managed PostgreSQL. Strata version support SHALL be a precondition checked before each database major-version upgrade; deterministic mock interactions SHALL be Unbound-owned provider contracts until Strata virtualization exists.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Modules tagged control-relevant (gate, ledger, reservations, holds, authority, dispatch) SHALL require two approvers on every change, neither the author; builds SHALL be signed with recorded provenance; each release SHALL publish to each sponsor a notice listing changed control-relevant modules; production data access by engineers SHALL follow CNV-ARC-002. Every authorization decision, policy evaluation, eligibility gate, capacity or fee computation and state transition SHALL be computed or re-verified on the server inside the command transaction; client-side results SHALL be advisory display only and API contracts SHALL NOT accept client-computed results. Ledger digests SHALL be anchored externally at least daily so tampering is detectable, and production database administrative roles SHALL be break-glass only, with two-person activation.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: A change to any verified contact channel SHALL notify the previous channel with a self-service revert link; for a sponsor-set period (default 72 hours) afterwards, successor and beneficiary changes, authority changes and grant recommendations above a sponsor threshold SHALL be held for confirmation. An AccessibleAssurancePath SHALL offer at least a one-time code mailed to the verified address, an outbound call to a verified number, assisted video with captioning and in-person or notarized verification, each reaching a defined contact assurance level; relay calls SHALL be accepted. Where a sponsor has not configured the recommendation threshold, the hold SHALL apply to all non-recurring recommendations above an Unbound default set by the Unbound product owner [policy default], and activation SHALL record the threshold in force. The post-change hold SHALL also cover bank-detail changes and, for charities, contact and authorised-signatory changes. Contact assurance levels SHALL be defined by factor combination: CAL0 unverified; CAL1 knowledge or caller identification only; CAL2 one-time code to a validated phone or email, or callback to the number on record; CAL3 an in-session authenticator challenge at AAL2 or above; each accessible method SHALL state the CAL it yields, and relay calls SHALL reach the same CAL as voice calls.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: A normative StatusProjection table SHALL map every reachable combination of payment, grant and contribution state dimensions to a donor label, a charity label, a staff label, an approved explanation and the next expected event or date, with a staff disclosure matrix by role. Policies SHALL follow the precedence law > platform non-removable > sponsor board policy > program terms > fund agreement > donor preference, and a policy pack SHALL be statically checked at adoption against the lattice and other active packs, accepting overlapping rules with different outcomes when the lattice orders their sources (recording the winner) and rejecting them only when both sources sit at the same level.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: architectural-support
text: Every process instance SHALL record the definition and policy versions it started under; a new definition SHALL apply only to new instances unless an explicit, tested migration function records a MigrationApplied fact per instance and never shortens a statutory or contractual deadline. Fleet provisioning SHALL be declarative and version-controlled (provider-native templates permitted; no Kubernetes or Terraform requirement), schema changes SHALL be expand/contract so release N runs against schema N-1 and N, migration state SHALL be recorded per tenant, and a failed tenant migration SHALL stop the rollout and leave other tenants serving. Security or control fixes that need no schema change SHALL have an emergency release path that continues to unaffected tenants while a failed tenant is tracked as an open risk. Each tenant SHALL have a restore test at least annually and credential and key rotation evidence; a PostgreSQL major-version upgrade drill SHALL be completed before architecture acceptance.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each sponsor SHALL approve a maximum funds-in-transit exposure per rail partner, enforced on partner funding requests. A partner outage SHALL move to the fallback rail only instructions with partner-confirmed non-execution, reusing the original idempotency chain; instructions with any partner acknowledgment SHALL stay in unknown-outcome handling (CNV-PAY-004); partner insolvency SHALL trigger a recovery plan for funds in transit, recorded as a sponsor receivable. Activation of a rail partner SHALL require contract terms for instruction status queries and segregated holding of sponsor funds in transit.

approval_basis: mission-adopted from adversarial review (owner ratification pending)
release_scope: initial-implementation
text: Each baseline row SHALL carry a SHA-256 of its exact source text plus file and line, its status derived from adoption markers, and, for convergence clauses, its approval basis and resolving questions. Every clause classified as an internal control SHALL map to at least one entry in the authoritative control register, which SHALL record control operator {Unbound, sponsor, administrator, rail partner, custodian}, report relevance {SOC1, SOC2, none}, complementary user entity control id, automated or manual and the evidence query. Clause dependencies SHALL be declared and the dependency graph SHALL be acyclic. Numeric values in normative clauses SHALL carry a basis tag {authority, business-policy default, empirical target, illustrative}. Each clause SHALL carry a numeric-parameter table (value, unit, basis tag, owner) and generation SHALL fail for any number in a clause statement not listed there; counts and decision status quoted in mission reports SHALL be generated from the clause and decision files.
